title: Backend Software Engineer (Core AI)
descriptionHtml:
At Goodweek, we're building a next-generation AI tool designed to revolutionize business productivity. We are focusing on delivering a secure, scalable, and reliable system that supports real business use cases across different departments. The goal is to make AI practical, controlled, and truly embedded in how modern organizations operate.

Our team spans across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by 6 international investment funds.

To accelerate our growth, we're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and help us build an innovative product that will make a real impact on how thousands of users work every day.

Tasks

About the role

As a Backend Engineer, you'll work on the core infrastructure that makes our AI platform fast, reliable, and scalable.

You'll be joining the Core AI team, responsible for the foundational layer of our AI product, covering orchestration, memory, low-level security, and system harness.

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, thinking about latency, reliability, and model behavior all at once.

What you'll do

You'll be tackling challenges across:

  • AI orchestration: owning the core layer that coordinates AI workflows, model calls, multi-step reasoning, and multi-agent delegation, including RAG pipelines and knowledge bases
  • LLM integration: integrating and tuning new LLMs into a production-grade backend, with a focus on security, guardrails, and evaluation (latency, response quality)
  • Data ingestion & export: building robust pipelines and services to handle a variety of file formats reliably and at scale
  • Context & token optimization: designing strategies to maximize LLM efficiency, manage context windows, and keep costs in check
  • Infrastructure & observability: designing scalable APIs, automating deployment pipelines, monitoring, and testing to keep the platform reliable and performant
  • Architecture & engineering culture: participating in tech stack decisions, documenting technical knowledge, and continuously driving innovation across the AI platform

Requirements

Technical background

  • 5+ years of experience with Node.js + TypeScript stack
  • NestJS/React and PostgreSQL are a plus
  • Hands-on experience (or strong familiarity) with AI/ML integration (LLMs, RAG, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of backend architecture, scalability, and security best practices
  • Experience with databases, authentication, and cloud platforms (AWS)
  • Familiar with CI/CD, Git workflows, and agile methodologies
  • Bonus: familiarity with other backend programming languages applied to AI (Python, Go...)

Soft skills

  • Strong technical communication
  • Agile mindset focused on product and business value
  • Ability to document and defend architectural decisions
  • Balance between code quality and delivery speed
  • Technical English required

Benefits

  • Health insurance provided by the employer
  • Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Hybrid remote work
  • Daily use of English through close collaboration with teams in the US and Spain

title: Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

Part of the Product department, our team of brand designers builds a strong brand that makes every interaction with Alma memorable. In 2027, we’ll make Alma even more visible and chosen, while reinventing how we create with AI.

Want to make a real impact on a fast-growing brand? Join us!

This position is a CDI (permanent contract) based in Paris.

💼 About the job

As Brand Designer within the Brand team, you will be the driving force behind Alma's static visual storytelling across all touchpoints. Your mission is to create compelling design content that brings our brand platform to life, engaging both merchants and consumers across Europe. With high operational excellence, you'll manage projects end-to-end, maintain clear stakeholder communication, and consistently deliver on time to meet ambitious deadlines. You will report to Antoine, Creative Director.

As a business partner, you'll craft everything from sales/marketing decks, social media posts to event booths and white papers and brand campaigns.

Through your expertise in design and IA tools management, layout, you'll build scalable systems that empower teams across Alma to communicate our value proposition with impact and consistency, establishing Alma as a visually distinctive leader in European fintech.

🧰 You will work with

  • Production for design: Figma, Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Project Management: Notion, Slack, Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides)
  • AI Tools Management: Dust, Claude, Runway, Midjourney, Synthesia, ElevenLab

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • Brand Design expertise: 4+ years as a Brand Designer (ideally in a large, fast-paced organization), with advanced expertise in Figma and Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and a portfolio showcasing diverse projects and brand system implementation.
  • Brand Platform mastery: Deep understanding of brand guidelines, with the ability to apply, adapt and evolve the brand platform to meet strategic needs.
  • AI-powered Brand Design: Ability to use AI tools and agents to scale creative production while ensuring brand consistency and quality.
  • Project ownership & operational excellence: Proven experience managing creative projects with structured processes, high quality standards and respect for deadlines, from brief to delivery of complex cross-functional deliverables.
  • Cross-functional collaboration & stakeholder influence: Works effectively with Sales, Product, Marketing, Compliance and Operations to deliver scalable, compliant B2B and B2C content, and synthesizes information to influence decisions.
  • Communication & content quality: Strong written and oral skills, with attention to detail on all textual content (titles, scripts, captions) and polished, error-free deliverables. French native speaker with business-level English.
  • Growth & business partner mindset: Sets ambitious goals, prototypes rapidly, monitors design trends, and uses client insights to align creative choices with business goals.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have an experience in B2B/B2C, tech, consumer products, payments, or digital products.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What’s in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Shaping Alma into the brand consumers actively choose and keep coming back to: build a distinctive brand experience that drives consumer preference, loyalty, and long-term engagement.
  • Building Alma’s AI-powered brand guardian: design a Brand AI System that connects Alma’s AI tools to ensure brand consistency across every touchpoint, from content creation to quality control.
  • Helping shape a more collaborative creative team: structure the team around dedicated static and motion design partnerships, combining complementary skills to deliver stronger, more cohesive creative work.

🤑 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year ****(+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

🎯 Interview Process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.
  • Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.
  • Case study presentation with 2 - 3 team members (ideally in house) to assess your practical knowledge.
  • 1 or 2 additional interviews customized to the role's level to further assess your skills and team fit.

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Business Development Executive
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Business Development Executive

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced outbound sales professional to join our direct sales team to qualify and convert leads in a fast paced and fun environment. You'll benefit from an uncapped commission structure, giving you full control over your earnings. OTE of £78k-£83k, with even higher earning potential available through promotion.

The role

As a Business Development Executive you’ll build a high quality pipeline of prospects and generate revenue by making outbound calls, booking meetings, following up with customers, using Social Selling tools, and much more. Each interaction with a potential new customer is unique, and requires focus as well as solo thinking. How you manage your pipeline will make a significant difference in hitting your KPIs. If you are successful, the opportunity to grow and develop as a sales professional is unbounded.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building and nurturing a high quality lead pipeline by making a high volume of outbound calls, and occasionally dealing with inbound queries, at all times representing the company in a highly professional manner

  • Using Social Selling tools & techniques to maximise your success in connecting with prospects

  • Identifying and qualifying prospects that might have a need for business finance

  • Communicating the iwoca value proposition in a precise and compelling way to engage and convert prospects

  • Going above and beyond in your efforts to hit and exceed your KPIs; this will enable us to beat sales growth targets

  • Working as a team player, and helping improve the overall success of this exciting part of the business.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally you'll:

  • Have past experience in sales, ideally within financial services

  • Be comfortable making cold outbound calls, and have an outstanding call manner

  • Be highly motivated, and excited to exceed targets

  • Be able to take on, and provide, quality feedback to power your own growth, as well as that of your teammates

  • Be organised and able to manage a large pipeline of prospects, with deals at various stages of progress

  • Be able to simplify and explain complex products in a way that customers with little experience in commercial financing can easily understand

Desired:

  • Understand the challenges facing small businesses

  • Have a good understanding of different financial products used by small businesses

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it.

What You'll Do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it.
  • Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery.
  • Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review.
  • Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves.
  • Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month.
  • Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field.
  • A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures.
  • Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.

title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages.

Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Animer des ateliers avec les métiers et le L&D pour analyser les besoins, segmenter les publics et cartographier un workflow.Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation.Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité.Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert.Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Suivre l'adoption et la valeur du use case, les compétences acquises, la capacité à répliquer et les premiers usages; proposer des ajustements concrets pour améliorer l'activation.Contribuer à l’analyse des freins et au plan de change du programme, sous la responsabilité du chef de mission.Identifier les dépendances SI, les risques sécurité et le besoin d'escalade vers la DSI ou AI Engineering.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

  • 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une première expérience de pilotage d’un stream ou d’une mission et de coaching de consultants juniors.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une bonne maîtrise de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding).
  • Une aisance dans la conception et l’animation d’expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, d’ateliers collaboratifs et de dispositifs de montée en compétences par la pratique.
  • Une capacité à comprendre les enjeux et processus métier, à embarquer les parties prenantes et à accompagner la transformation des tâches, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.
  • Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises

Les créations sont conçues et fabriquées en France à la commande et proposées dans une vaste sélection de pierres et de métaux précieux. La marque se distingue par une expérience client personnalisée, un modèle largement digital, une distribution 100% intégrée, et des prix toujours respectueux.

Plus de la moitié des ventes sont réalisées sur le site internet Gemmyo et 50% à travers les 9 boutiques de la marque, situées à Paris (2 boutiques), Lyon, Aix-en-Provence, Bordeaux, Toulouse, Genève, Bruxelles et Tokyo. La Maison est également présente via une Résidence (boutique éphémère) à Zurich depuis juillet 2024.

La Maison d’une centaine de collaborateurs est aujourd’hui référente pour une clientèle francophone exigeante.

Contexte de recrutement

Gemmyo dispose aujourd’hui de solides actifs :

  • Une notoriété importante sur ses marchés français, japonais, suisse et belge, et un accueil enthousiaste par ses clients

  • Une équipe structurée autour d’un Directeur Général et de 4 pôles : Marketing, Finance & Digital, Opérations & Retail, Secrétariat Général

  • Une compétence rare dans le domaine du luxe digital

  • Une trésorerie confortable

L’entreprise a défini un plan agressif d’expansion internationale qui sera déployé à partir de 2027.

Vos missions

Le service client faisant partie intégrante de notre équipe Retail, nous sommes à la recherche d’un état d’esprit, d’un enthousiasme débordant et d’une passion commune pour la joaillerie.

Nous recherchons une personne Chargée du Service Client à temps partiel (3 jours par semaine) qui sera l’une des voix de Gemmyo !

Le Chargé(e) du Service Client transmettra et partagera nos valeurs et notre histoire à nos clients et prospects afin de leur faire vivre une expérience unique et inoubliable.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans les plus beaux moments de leur vie et avons à cœur de leur faire découvrir une nouvelle façon de voir la joaillerie, jeune, délicate, moderne, bien loin du solennel de la Place Vendôme.

Le Chargé(e) du Service Client rapportera au Responsable Service client et aura les responsabilités suivantes :

  • Conseiller nos clients par mail, téléphone et tchat pour trouver le bijou qui leur correspond et répondre aux mieux à leurs attentes

Le/La Chargé(e) du Service Client travaillera au sein de notre Siège situé dans le 5ème arrondissement de Paris, à temps partiel, à raison de 3 jours par semaine du lundi au vendredi (hors samedi et dimanche), dans le cadre d’un CDI, et sera amené(e) à intervenir ponctuellement dans nos deux boutiques parisiennes.

title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Channel Partner Manager, Accounting
descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp's Accounting Channel is a key growth driver for the company, and we're looking for a founding Channel Partner Manager to help build our UK accounting-partner motion from the ground up. As an early member of the team in London, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Ramp partners with accounting and advisory firms across the region; building the relationships, go-to-market strategy, and repeatable motions that fuel long-term growth.

This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and takes ownership without being handed a playbook. You'll acquire and grow relationships with accounting and advisory partners, enable their teams, and generate revenue through client referrals. You'll also help us adapt Ramp's partner strategy to the commercial and cultural nuances of the UK markets.

What You'll Do

  • Source, qualify, and conduct deep discovery with net-new accounting and advisory partners across the UK

  • Sign partners and build comprehensive go-to-market plans that create a scalable referral motion

  • Drive revenue for Ramp by generating and converting client referrals from accounting firms

  • Enable and onboard partner team members so they can confidently identify, position, and refer Ramp

title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

  • Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

  • Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

  • Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

  • Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

  • Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

  • Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

  • Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

  • Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

  • Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

  • Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

  • Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

  • Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

  • Process & tools: Disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, and KPI ownership (win rate, cycle time, stage conversion, ACV/TCV).

  • Governance & compliance: Familiarity with public-sector procurement practices and export-control considerations; knows when to engage specialists.

  • Marketing savvy: Skilled in shaping and delivering impactful presentations, narratives, and proposals that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Soft skills: Executive presence, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, stakeholder influence, and resilience in long negotiations.

  • Ways of working: High ownership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment; willing to travel for customer meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience at a small satellite company that scaled into a large business - candidates who've operated through that growth curve are especially well suited to this role.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Computer Vision / ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Every part we make has to be inspected before it ships, and in precision manufacturing inspection is slow, skilled work. Our robotics team is building a computer vision inspection cell for the shop floor, and this role leads that work.

You will be one of the first engineers in the team, taking vision-based inspection from prototype to a system that runs in production and can be deployed at many sites.

What you'll do

  • Design and build the vision inspection cell: cameras, optics, lighting, fixturing and software.

  • Develop computer vision and machine learning models to inspect machined parts.

  • Build the data pipeline behind them: capture, labelling, training and evaluation.

  • Validate results against conventional measurement, and agree with the quality team where vision can be trusted.

  • Integrate the cell with MasonOS so results feed the factory's records.

What we're looking for

  • Strong computer vision and machine learning engineering experience, with models deployed in the real world rather than only in research.

  • Proficiency in Python; C++ is useful.

  • Hands-on experience with cameras, optics or imaging hardware.

  • An engineer's approach: comfortable building hardware and software together.

  • Comfort working on a live factory floor, close to the machinists and inspectors who will use what you build.

Nice to have

  • Industrial inspection or metrology.

  • Robotics.

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment or a startup.

Why Isembard

  • Lead the first in-house project of a new robotics team.

  • See your work running on a live factory floor.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London.

Missions

Quand un écart de calcul ou un rejet DSN bloque une paie, le cabinet a besoin d'un expert qui comprend vite et explique clairement. Ta réponse évite une paie en retard et renforce la confiance du cabinet dans Alassio.

title: Contract manager
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for.

As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the CCN lifecycle from receipt or initiation through impact assessment, negotiation, approval, and formal issue, with clear ownership and deadlines for every open item.

  • Chase and track open CCNs with customer contracting officers, program managers, and internal stakeholders, and escalate delays that threaten schedule or cash flow.

  • Coordinate impact assessments with engineering, quality, supply chain, and finance, covering technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and compliance effects.

  • Prepare and negotiate change proposals, including pricing justification, supporting documentation, and changes to terms and conditions.

  • Maintain the contract baseline by recording each approved CCN in the contract register and ensuring the scope, price, milestones, and deliverables reflect the current agreed position.

  • Monitor entitlement and notice obligations, including time limits for submitting change requests and claims under the contract and applicable procurement rules.

  • Manage the CCN register and reporting, providing regular status updates on open, pending, and approved changes, value at stake, and aging to program leadership.

  • Support invoicing and revenue recognition by ensuring approved changes are reflected in billing milestones and Odoo or ERP records.

  • Ensure compliance with the contract's terms, applicable public procurement and export-control rules, and internal approval and delegation-of-authority policies.

  • Prepare for audits and reviews by maintaining a complete, traceable record of change decisions and correspondence.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. descriptionHtml:
Rejoignez l'aventure ALMMA !

ALMMA, c'est la rencontre de deux pépites de l'agroalimentaire français : Foo Seng (spécialiste des snacks asiatiques) et Varachaux (expert des produits élaborés viande & végétal). Résultat : plus de 100 collaborateurs, 3 usines, et une ambition assumée : accélérer, vite et fort, en interne comme en externe, aux côtés de nos actionnaires et d'un fonds d'investissement qui partage notre vision.

Notre ADN ! L'énergie d'une start-up, la solidité d'un outil industriel. Pas de contradiction ici : on avance à la vitesse d'une équipe qui construit, avec la rigueur d'un groupe qui pilote des volumes, des flux et des échéances réelles.

Le poste

Au sein d'une équipe finance nouvellement créée et en plein déploiement, vous êtes le/la partenaire privilégié(e) de nos usines. C'est une création de poste clé, conçue pour un profil qui aime faire parler la donnée au cœur des ateliers de fabrication ! Rattaché(e) directement au CFO Groupe

En clair : une feuille blanche, un vrai mandat de builder. Vous ne reprenez pas un système existant, vous le créez, vous le modernisez, vous le simplifiez.

Vos missions

Envie de faire parler la donnée sur le terrain ALMMA !

Véritable chef d'orchestre de la performance industrielle, vous co-construisez nos indicateurs et accompagnez nos équipes de production pour maximiser la création de valeur :

Vos Missions :

Calcul & Analyse Fine des Coûts de Revient :

Pilotage des Écarts & Performance des Ateliers :

Processus Budgétaire & Suivi des Investissements (CAPEX) :

  • Participer activement à la construction du budget industriel et aux révisions budgétaires périodiques.

  • Maîtrise de la comptabilité analytique, des méthodes de calcul de coûts de revient et des ERP industriels ;

title: Country Manager - Germany (Shift)
descriptionHtml:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

This is an incredible opportunity, to own Shift’s German operation, from business acquisition and data collection through logistics, team-building and delivery.

Requirements

  • Strong operational ownership: able to make local decisions, coordinate teams and take responsibility for delivery.

  • Ability to win participation from businesses, particularly mid-sized businesses doing skilled, non-domestic tasks.

  • Commercial judgment: build a local operation while operating as lean as possible.

  • Practical logistics capability: maximise hardware, including distribution, returns, cleaning, uploads and loss prevention.

  • Comfort building a team where justified by the economics, while working closely with Shift’s central team.

  • Willingness to do hands-on, repetitive operational work, not only strategy or automation.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Credit Fraud Analyst
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as a Credit Fraud Analyst to help protect Qonto's credit products as we become a bank. You'll own the operational efficiency of our credit fraud processes end-to-end, reporting to Thibault, Head of Fraud.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own credit fraud operations end-to-end: You'll supervise the day-to-day efficiency of our credit fraud processes.

  • Sharpen our AI fraud detection: You'll partner with Tech to continuously improve the AI tool we use to catch credit fraud and defaults.

  • Rework eligibility, not just enforce it: You'll analyze credit defaults and declined financing to challenge and rework our eligibility criteria.

  • Build and run fraud controls: You'll design and implement the controls that keep our credit products safe as we scale.

  • Be the cross-market go-to on credit fraud: You'll act as the point of contact for Risk, Product and Customer Care across all our markets.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • A credit fraud background: You’ve worked in credit fraud specifically, on loans, financing or other credit products, not only payments or AML.

  • Hands-on case analysis: You’ve investigated fraud or default cases yourself, from reading the file to making the call.

  • You bring a critical mind and real curiosity: You question existing criteria and processes instead of taking them at face value.

  • You're curious about AI: You're comfortable using AI tools to spot patterns in data, and keen to help us sharpen the AI tool we use to catch fraud.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A function you get to build, not inherit: As Qonto becomes a bank, you'll shape the credit fraud function from the ground up.

  • Real ownership, real trust: Your manager gives real autonomy — you'll be the team's go-to expert, not someone executing a fixed brief.

  • A seat at the table across the business: You'll work directly across teams, with visibility across markets.

  • A front-row seat to Qonto becoming a bank: You'll join at a pivotal moment as we launch new credit products.

➡️ Your future manager

You will work directly with Thibault Mosser, our Head of Fraud, who has been with Qonto for 7 years and has led the fraud team through an impressive growth phase. He has led the successful separation of Fraud and AML and implemented modern fraud detection systems.

Thibault is known for his supportive leadership style that grants teams great autonomy, and brings deep understanding of international fraud management. With him as your manager, you will benefit from a leader who understands both operational details and strategic direction.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚 Our Marketing team

No one is more creative and data-driven than this team; they truly combine the best of both worlds. The Marketing team’s mission is to put our product into the hearts and hands of millions of users around the world.

  • The Growth Team builds and scales innovative growth engines to conquer markets, attract, and retain users.

  • The Brand & Communications Team shapes Joko's long-term vision and builds a lasting emotional connection with users.

  • The Campaign & Merchandising Team drives our B2C campaign calendar and elevates the shopping experience.

  • The B2B Marketing Team positions Joko as the top partner in our space and builds a standout employer brand.

Led by Isa, our CMO, the team is constantly innovating to take the business to new heights.

🎯 What you will do

As CRM & Lifecycle Manager, your mission is to design and run lifecycle programs that turn new signups into engaged, loyal, high-LTV Joko users. You will own the end-to-end CRM strategy across in-app, push, and email from the first onboarding message to the campaign that reactivates dormant users. You will join the Growth team, report to the VP Growth, and partner daily with Product, Data, and Brand teams.

Your main missions will be:

  • Guide new users to their first Joko “wow” moment: The first days shape everything that follows. You’ll design the onboarding journey: messaging, timing, and triggers so every new user feels understood and reaches activation quickly. At our scale, getting those first touches right compounds into millions of engaged users.

  • Turn engaged users into power users, and power users into advocates: You’ll build retention and referral programs that deepen usage among our best users, drive word of mouth, and lift long-term retention.

  • Maximize LTV across the full lifecycle: You’ll design cross-channel journeys that deliver the right benefit to the right user at the right moment. You’ll partner closely with Data to turn behavioral signals into segmentation and triggers, and with Product to keep lifecycle nudges tightly aligned with the in-app experience.

  • Raise the bar on experimentation: You’ll run a continuous A/B testing program (hypotheses, tests, learnings, iterations) to improve existing flows and challenge our current lifecycle map. Every decision should be grounded in evidence, not intuition.

  • Take CRM to the next level with AI: You’ll use AI to automate the operational grind (segmentation, copy iteration, QA, reporting) and unlock what we couldn’t run manually: sharper personalization, faster experimentation cycles, and richer lifecycle logic. You’ll decide where AI genuinely moves the needle (and where it doesn’t), then ship production solutions.

  • Drive growth across the company: You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Data, User Acquisition, and Brand so CRM compounds alongside everything else we’re building.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in B2C CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a high-growth mobile or consumer app. You’ve owned lifecycle programs end-to-end, not just executed individual components.

  • CRM craft: You’re hands-on with modern CRM platforms (Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or similar) and you know what “good” looks like across in-app, push, and email. Deliverability, segmentation logic, template design, and orchestration are second nature.

  • Data-driven to the core: You read cohort curves, funnel data, and A/B test results fluently. You use data to form opinions and drive decisions, not just to build reports.

  • Experimentation mindset: You’ve run structured A/B testing programs and know how to design experiments that actually teach you something, not just optimize a subject line.

  • Curious and hands-on with AI: You’re genuinely excited by what AI can do for CRM. You’ve already built solutions from scratch using AI to improve workflows or drive impact, and you have real opinions formed from real attempts on where it works and where it doesn’t.

  • User-centric: You’re relentlessly curious about how users think, what they need, and how they respond. Every message you ship starts from a real user insight, not a template.

  • Ownership and drive: You take initiative, hold yourself accountable to outcomes (not activities), and move fast without dropping the ball.

  • Attention to detail: You know a broken merge tag, a mistimed push, or a poorly segmented email can undo weeks of work. You have a talent for spotting flaws before they ship.

  • Languages: You’re a native-level French speaker and fluent in English, our internal working language.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €43.4K – €69.3K

title: CTO - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
descriptionHtml:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI, qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA.

Le marché est à un point d'inflexion. Les entreprises disposent de volumes considérables de données internes mais peinent à les exploiter, tandis que l'IA générative ouvre des possibilités inédites d'automatisation, d'aide à la décision et de transformation des processus métiers. Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. Nous avons une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en nous appuyant sur notre approche Lean Tech® et nos partenariats stratégiques (Google Cloud Partner of the Year France 2025, AWS, Snowflake).

C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter.

Votre rôle

En tant que CTO Data & IA, vous êtes le leader qui fait le pont entre le business et la tech sur l'ensemble du périmètre Data & Intelligence Artificielle. Concrètement, vous portez quatre responsabilités.

  • Offre & expertise technique : vous positionnez Theodo à la pointe du marché. Vous benchmarkez les architectures data modernes (data platforms, data mesh, lakehouse) et les architectures IA (RAG, agents, semantic layer, fine-tuning, MLOps). Vous développez des accélérateurs et des enablers internes réutilisables, vous animez la communauté des leaders tech et data scientists, et vous formalisez les apprentissages pour capitaliser sur les retours de mission.
  • Vente & Solution Architecture : vous êtes le référent technique du cycle de vente. Vous intervenez en avant-vente comme solution architect de référence sur nos offres Data & IA, vous co-construisez les propositions techniques avec les équipes commerciales, et vous challengez et crédibilisez les réponses techniques face aux CTO, DSI et CDO de nos clients. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec notre Head of Sales sur le closing des deals stratégiques et sur nos partenariats.
  • Delivery : vous garantissez l'excellence et faites grandir les équipes. Vous communiquez en interne autour de nos offres pour attirer les meilleurs profils, et vous recrutez et formez nos ingénieurs data, data scientists et AI engineers.
  • Marketing technique : vous construisez notre visibilité et notre crédibilité sur le marché. Vous bâtissez et maintenez notre showroom (démos, cas d'usage de référence), vous produisez du contenu à fort impact (articles, livres blancs, tech radars), vous intervenez en conférences et événements (Nuit de la Data, Google Cloud Next, AWS Summit…), et vous alimentez nos partenariats technologiques avec du contenu technique.

Les défis qui vous attendent

  • Vous couvrirez un périmètre large qui va de la data platform à l'IA générative, en passant par la data science classique et le MLOps sans vous disperser.
  • Vous rejoindrez une équipe déjà expérimentée, avec une culture Theodo forte.
  • Vous articulerez une vision unifiée Data & IA là où le marché tend à séparer ces deux mondes, tout en conservant une équipe pluridisciplinaire (data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, MLOps) pour scaler la delivery.
  • Vous naviguerez dans un écosystème de partenaires technologiques variés (Google Cloud, AWS) en maintenant une posture agnostique crédible.
  • Et surtout, vous transformerez la vague GenAI en offres industrialisables et vendables, avec un ROI démontrable pour nos clients.

title: Data Scientist Internship
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between infrastructure, backend, and frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership, and team spirit.

👉 Curious to see what we’re building? Check out our Tech Blog!

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. You’ll work closely with our AI engineering and data science teams to design, test, and evaluate LLM-based systems that turn loosely structured inputs into reliable, working Pigment models and formulas.

Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).
  • Benchmark quality, reliability, and cost/latency, and document trade-offs.
  • Work with engineers and data scientists to build evaluation pipelines and share findings.

    • Technical Stack

    Our current AI and engineering stack includes:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, LangGraph
  • Data & ML Infrastructure: Weights & Biases, Hugging Face Hub, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes
  • Databases: PostgreSQL
  • CI/CD & Experimentation: CircleCI, MLflow, and internal orchestration tools

    • We don’t expect you to know them all. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, experiment rigorously, and translate data insights into actionable results.

    Work Environment
