descriptionHtml:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

The Role: Platform Engineering Manager (Cloud Foundations)

Location: London / Hybrid (2 days per week in office) 

Reporting to: Head of Technology Operations


The Role 

 Rightmove’s Cloud Foundations team delivers the secure, reliable, scalable and cost‑optimised platform foundations used by hundreds of engineers and dozens of mission‑critical services. As we ensure safe, low friction delivery of core services and operate at scale, the Engineering Manager will lead a team providing cloud platforms and infrastructure, cloud security, governance, automation, and operational excellence.  

This position blends people leadership, cloud operations, platform engineering, security governance, and FinOps. The successful candidate brings deep operational experience in product‑led technology companies and understands how to run cloud foundations as a modern internal platform. 

Key Outcomes for This Role 

Strategy, Delivery and Execution 

  • Through working with your team, key stakeholders, and the platform product manager, we provide a cloud platform strategy and roadmap that aligns to Rightmove business goals and our internal customer’s needs.  
  • The team provides accurate estimates and realistic plans. 
  • The platform roadmap, initiatives/projects, and OKRs are well managed and delivered in line with expectations. 

People Leadership & Team Development 

  • Through coaching and mentoring engineers, setting clear, achievable development goals and provides actionable feedback, they improve skills, confidence, and impact. 
  • Individual growth plans align with team objectives and organisational priorities. 
  • Engineers are supported to designing and delivering scalable, secure, resilient platform services without micromanagement. 
  • Achievements are recognised and rewarded, performance issues are addressed early and fairly.  
  • There is an inclusive, psychologically safe environment; with leadership tailored to individual strengths and motivations. 

Platform Engineering, Operations & Reliability 

  • Cloud platform and key services are reliable, incident detection and resolution are smooth due to proactive monitoring, well‑maintained alerts/logs, and complete observability coverage. 
  • Platform resilience and DR planning/testing strategy is defined and operational, working across the business with validated requirements and outcomes. 
  • Backup, restore and resilience mechanisms are regularly tested, ensuring the platform can recover predictably. 
  • Incident management processes are consistently followed, including timely post‑incident reviews (PIRs) and completion of follow‑up actions. 
  • On‑call is well staffed, sustainably operated, and fosters a healthy on‑call culture. 
  • Automation (AI‑driven or traditional) delivers increased speed, reduced toil, and enhanced reliability. 
  • Support requests are triaged and responded to promptly, with prioritisation based on upstream impact. 
  • Capacity and cloud spend are effectively managed—no incidents caused by under‑provisioning, and costs are controlled by avoiding unnecessary over‑provisioning. 
  • Finops culture is embedded with tooling and process across product development teams 
  • Vendor relationships are managed, supplier due diligence is completed on time, contract costs and SLAs are negotiated as needed. 
  • Continuous improvement culture is embedded: teams regularly evaluate performance, reliability and cost efficiency, feeding learnings back into the platform. 

Governance, Guardrails & Security 

  • Infrastructure‑as‑Code, Policy‑as‑Code and automated guardrails accelerate delivery while strengthening governance and consistency across the platform. 
  • Secure software delivery practices and policies are followed, vulnerabilities are managed within SLAs, Platform configuration standards are maintained (CIS Benchmarks). 
  • Cloud security policies, governance standards and privacy controls consistent with predefined roles, least‑privilege IAM patterns and role-based access practices are implemented and followed 
  • The organisation meets regulatory, contractual and audit obligations, maintaining documentation, policies and process evidence for compliance reviews 
  • Secure cloud configurations, WAF policies, bot protection, and cloud‑native security tooling are maintained. 
  • Architecture diagrams for network and key components are maintained for audit, security, knowledge sharing purposes. 

What you’ll bring  

  • Proven experience in cloud operations and platform engineering management, overseeing cloud infrastructure and platforms, monitoring, reliability, and service delivery in production environments. 
  • Previous hands‑on experience running large cloud-based website environments with GKE, service mesh, load balancers, CDN/WAF, Kafka, Elasticsearch. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud services including networking, compute, storage, containerisation, security and IAM. 
  • Experience with IAC, python, Go, CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, modern ops tooling and DevOps workflows. 
  • Demonstrated experience implementing security controls, IAM policies, and cloud governance frameworks.  
  • Familiarity with platform engineering concepts including developer platforms, reusable platform components and enabling internal product teams. 
  • Experience improving operational processes and developing documented procedures (monitoring, DR, incident response, upgrade processes). 
  • Strong leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills, aligned with expectations for managing technical cloud teams.  
  • Experience designing scalable, reliable cloud platform architectures, consistent with Cloud  

A note from your future manager - "You'll shape the cloud foundations that empower hundreds of engineers to build, deploy and innovate at scale."

Life at Rightmove

Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right!

title: Enterprise Account Executive - API Solutions
descriptionHtml:
The role

We are looking to hire a Enterprise Account Executive - API Solutions to join our EMEA sales team in London.

This is an on-site role out of our London office

Working at WGSN

Together, we create tomorrow

A career with WGSN is fast-paced, exciting and full of opportunities to grow and develop. We're a team of consumer and design trend forecasters, content creators, designers, data analysts, advisory consultants and much more, united by a common goal: to create tomorrow.

WGSN's trusted consumer and design forecasts power outstanding product design, enabling our customers to create a better future. Our services cover consumer insights, beauty, consumer tech, fashion, interiors, lifestyle, food and drink forecasting, data analytics and expert advisory. If you are an expert in your field, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

We are seeking a high performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition for the WGSN Intelligence API.

For 28 years, WGSN has provided category-leading trend intelligence to the world’s top consumer brands. As enterprise clients rebuild their systems around AI, this role is responsible for selling high-value, direct API integrations that embed WGSN’s proprietary intelligence into client design tools, merchandising platforms, e-commerce environments, and AI agents.

This is a pure hunting role focused on closing complex, enterprise integration deals across fashion, beauty, retail, consumer goods, and fintech.

Key accountabilities

  • Pipeline Generation: Proactively source and build a net-new enterprise pipeline targeting C suite and VP level buyers (Chief Digital, Data, Innovation, and Product Officers).

  • Technical & Consultative Selling: Lead end-to-end sales cycles for complex, high-value API integrations. Conduct deep consultative discovery to map WGSN API capabilities directly to client technical architectures and business cases.

  • Deal Ownership & Orchestration: Direct the complete sales process from origination to signature. Strategically pull in internal technical specialists only when needed for deep scoping.

  • IP Protection & Commercial Discipline: Structure deals within established pricing and legal guardrails, ensuring strict protection of WGSN’s intellectual property, training-data exclusions, and brand attribution.

  • Pipeline & Forecast Management: Maintain accurate forecasting, deal stage hygiene, and pipeline coverage metrics.

Skills, experience & qualifications

  • Background in trend intelligence, syndicated consumer data, SaaS, or enterprise AI/ML platforms is preferred.

  • Consistent history of exceeding quotas in an individual contributor, net-new enterprise hunting role closing $1M+ multi-year deals.

  • Ability to independently lead technical discussions with senior data and technology buyers. Solid working knowledge of enterprise integration models, including REST/streaming APIs, authentication, and enterprise AI/ML architectures (e.g., RAG, embedded copilots, AI agents).

  • Expert at navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments across technical, product, and commercial business units.

  • Strong qualification discipline; ability to identify non-viable deals early and protect IP standards without compromising revenue goals.

  • Existing network of senior digital, data, and innovation leaders within Tier-1 retail and consumer brands preferred.

  • Familiarity with AI content licensing models, including training-data protections and brand attribution terms is preferred.

What we offer
Our benefits and wellbeing package offers flexible benefits you can tailor to your own personal needs, including:
- 25 days of holiday per year - with an option to buy/ sell up to 5 days- Pension, Life Assurance and Income Protection Flexible benefits platform with options including Private Medical, Dental Insurance & Critical Illness - Employee assistance programme, season ticket loans and cycle to work scheme - Volunteering opportunities and charitable giving options - Great learning and development opportunities.

More about WGSN
WGSN is the global authority on consumer trend forecasting.
We help brands around the world create the right products at the right time for tomorrow’s consumer.

Our values
We Are EverywhereThe future is everything, it happens everywhere. WGSN is the world-leading forecaster because we track and analyse consumer behaviours, product innovation, design and creativity, everywhere.
We Are Future FocusedWe utilise our global resources and intelligence to research, source and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to produce our forecasts. Everything we do is focused on working with our customers to create a successful and positive tomorrow.
We Are RigorousWe source, review and assess quantitative and qualitative data to produce robust, actionable forecasts. To provide credible insights and design solutions for our clients, it is essential that rigour runs through everything we do.

Our culture
An inclusive culture is one of our key priorities. We want our people to truly be themselves and thrive. We love having a diverse team of people who bring new ideas, different strengths and perspectives & reflect the global audience we work with.

Inclusive workforce
We are committed to supporting the environment and sustainability, including ensuring our pension plan defaults to sustainable options and striving to be net zero by 2030.
Recognising great performance is a key part of our culture. Our Awards schemes recognise and reward the brilliant achievements of our people.
We offer a flexible working environment with a wide range of flexible, hybrid and agile working arrangements. Conversations about flexible working have always been—and will continue to be—actively encouraged here, but we do not offer full remote working.
We want to ensure everyone has the opportunity to perform their best when interviewing, so if you require any reasonable adjustments that would make you more comfortable during the process, please let us know so that we can do our best to support you.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Entwicklungsingenieur Konstruktion (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) entwickeln und konstruieren Sie eigenständig Baugruppen und Einzelbauteile unter Berücksichtigung technischer Anforderungen
  • Zudem erstellen Sie Konstruktionskonzepte, führen Dimensionierungen durch und erarbeiten normgerechte Fertigungsunterlagen
  • Darüber hinaus definieren und koordinieren Sie Bauteil- und Baugruppenschnittstellen und berücksichtigen dabei funktionale und konstruktive Anforderungen
  • Zusätzlich erstellen und pflegen Sie CAD-Daten und technische Zeichnungen im PLM-System sowie Gewichtsbilanzen und Präsentationen
  • Dabei stimmen Sie sich mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Entwicklungspartnern ab und unterstützen die Fertigung und Montage bei konstruktiven Fragestellungen

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugtechnik oder Konstruktionstechnik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Sie bringen Erfahrung als Konstrukteur (m/w/d), Konstruktionsingenieur (m/w/d) oder Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) mit, idealerweise im Fahrzeugbau
  • Sie bringen bereits Berufserfahrung in der Erstellung normgerechter Zeichnungen und der Anwendung von Form- und Lagetoleranzen mit
  • Zusätzlich verfügen Sie über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint, sowie gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Wichtig sind eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit - Kenntnisse in fahrzeugspezifischen Bereichen wie Schweißtechnik, Ergonomie oder Package-Entwicklung sind von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell
  • Sicherheit: Langfristige Jobmöglichkeit bei einem krisensicheren Arbeitgeber
  • Gesundheit: Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze sowie zahlreiche Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote sorgen dafür, dass Sie sich rundum wohlfühlen
  • Entwicklung: Auf Sie warten zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Vielseitigkeit: Freuen Sie sich aufspannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld

title: Event Marketing Manager (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
As Event Marketing Manager, EMEA, you will help shape how developers, platform teams, and open-source communities experience Coder in person and online. You will plan and execute events that build awareness, create pipeline, and turn technical interest into meaningful engagement.

You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and partners to bring event programs to life. You will manage the details, connect the teams, and make each experience feel useful, credible, and well run.

What you’ll do here

  • Plan and execute Coder’s EMEA event programs, including trade shows, conferences, summits, and partner activations.

  • Manage event timelines, budgets, vendors, contracts, staffing plans, registration, logistics, shipping, and on-site execution.

  • Partner with DevRel and Product Marketing to create event experiences that resonate with developers, platform engineers, DevOps teams, and technical buyers.

  • Work with Sales to align event strategy to account priorities, meeting goals, pipeline creation, and follow-up motions.

  • Create pre-event and post-event communications, including attendee outreach, internal briefings, speaker prep, staff guides, and follow-up plans.

  • Coordinate Coder’s presence at open-source, developer, ai infrastructure, cloud, and platform engineering events.

  • Help identify the right events for Coder to attend, sponsor, host, or skip based on audience fit, business goals, and community relevance.

  • Manage relationships with agencies, production teams, venues, event organizers, swag vendors, and other external partners.

  • Track event performance across attendance, engagement, meetings, leads, pipeline influence, sourced pipeline, and qualitative feedback.

  • Travel as needed to support hands-on event execution and ensure every program runs smoothly.

What we’re looking for

  • Must be located in the UK

  • 4–7 years of experience in event marketing roles.

  • Strong experience planning and executing events from start to finish, including logistics, communications, vendors, timelines, budgets, and on-site details.

  • Excellent program management skills. You can manage multiple moving parts, keep stakeholders aligned, and bring order to complex work.

  • High attention to detail. You catch issues early, document clearly, and make sure the small things do not become big problems.

  • Create event playbooks, briefing docs, run-of-show plans, staffing guides, and post-event reports.

Bonus tacos if you have

  • Experience marketing to developers, DevOps teams, platform engineers, infrastructure teams, or other technical audiences.

  • Experience working in or around open-source communities, developer ecosystems, or technical community programs.

  • Experience supporting open-source projects, foundations, community events, or contributor programs.

  • Familiarity with developer conferences and communities such as KubeCon, GitHub Universe, Open Source Summit, DevOpsDays, HashiConf, or similar events.

  • Experience with account-based marketing and sales-aligned event motions.

  • Experience with event technology and marketing systems such as, Cvent, Luma, HubSpot, Salesforce, or 6sense.

Our tech stack

You do not need to know every tool on day one, but familiarity with common go-to-market and event systems will help you ramp quickly. This role may work across tools such as Asana, Salesforce, HubSpot or Marketo, event platforms, ABM tools, shared content systems, and internal planning docs.

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby and Brainerr help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact  

Coder is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Executive Assistant
descriptionHtml:
📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 1 day WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £55,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Co-CEOs, so they can spend their time on growing the business.

This is an opportunity for someone to join a scaling business during one of our most exciting chapters yet, and to build close relationships with Founders who both value and reward excellence.

If you are organised, trustworthy, and dependable, and know what separates exceptional EAs from good ones - we think you might do great work here.

How you’ll make a difference

  • You make sure the Co-CEOs are spending their time on things that only they can do. You run their diaries and inboxes, delegate work where possible, and say no to people when a day is already full.

  • You’ll make sure meetings with them are worth having - e.g. there's a defined agendas, people turn up prepared, and actions get followed up on. Before board and investor meetings, you’ll make sure they know the numbers and what’s in the board pack.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re an experienced EA, haveworked with a CEO or founder before and understand the appropriate level of support for stakeholders at this level.

  • You’re super organised, and can juggle requests coming in from multiple people with different ways of working.

  • You’re trustworthy and reliable.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail.

  • You can build good relationships with people, and are able to say no to protect the founder’s diaries without souring relationships.

  • Bonus points if you’re comfortable using AI tools - but it won’t rule you out!

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won't be for everyone.

  • If you'd rather work for one person. You'll be balancing two founders' priorities, plus travel for our senior leaders - so you’ll be juggling different requirements and ways of working.

  • If you want to work mostly from home. This role is 4 days a week in our Manchester office, so you're on hand when people need you.

If that sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk, Spectre & Cortex form a powerful trio, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home 1 day per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£50,000 - £55,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

Interview Process

2 stages = 45-minute video call with our Head of People > In-person interview with our Co-CEOs.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

Compensation: £50K – £55K

title: Executive Assistant
descriptionHtml:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time.   • Coordinate board and leadership meetings: pull the papers together, chase actions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between sessions.

  • Be the first point of contact for the CEO, handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and representing them well with senior stakeholders, investors and the exec team.

  • Keep the leadership team's rhythm on track by coordinating offsites, leadership meetings and the cross-team moments that keep everyone aligned.

  • Spot where things could run better and fix them. You'll have real ownership of how the CEO's office runs day to day.

The fit:

  • Experience supporting a CEO, founder or senior executive in a fast-moving business, ideally at C-suite level.

  • A sharp eye for detail, and the judgement to know what's urgent, what's important and what can wait.

  • Total discretion with confidential and sensitive information. People trust you with the details that matter.

  • A calm, organised approach under pressure, with the confidence to manage upwards and push back when needed.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary + completion bonus

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

  • Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

  • 1st stage interview with our Senior Executive Assistants

  • 2nd stage interview with the VP Strategy and Corporate Development

  • 3rd stage interview with our CEO

title: Finance Analytics Engineer | FP&A
descriptionHtml:
What we're looking for

Do you like knowing exactly why a number moved? As an Finance Analytics Engineer at ARQ, you'll own the data foundations behind our revenue, cost and management reporting. You'll sit between Finance and Engineering: building the models that tell us how the business is performing, keeping them accurate every day, and turning them into insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a dbt project or a Python codebase as in a P&L. You'll work closely with Finance, Treasury and Engineering, and your work will feed management, investor and regulatory reporting directly.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the finance data layer: Maintain and extend our dbt repo. That means building and refactoring models, writing tests, and keeping finance data clean, documented and reliable.

  • Revenue and cost models: Build and maintain the models behind revenue, unit economics and operations costs (payment rails, FX, card, banking partners, vendors) across our markets.

  • Management accounts: Support daily and monthly management accounts on both accrual and cash basis. Reconcile them to source systems and explain movements.

  • Budgeting and forecasting: Feed actuals into the budget and forecast, run variance analysis, and help Finance understand what is driving performance.

  • Python services: Help maintain and improve the internal Python services and pipelines that support finance reporting and reconciliation.

  • Data mapping and requirements: Map data sources across our product and payments stack, and document business logic and assumptions so others can trust and reuse your work.

  • Onboard new business: When we launch a new product, partner or market, make sure it flows correctly into financial reporting, controls and processes.

  • Dashboards and reporting: Build and improve dashboards with Finance and Controllership that track key metrics and surface business drivers.

  • Anomalies and controls: Spot breaks, unusual spikes or data quality issues early, find the root cause, and fix it at the source.

  • Data literacy: Help the wider team understand and self-serve finance data.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years in a data, analytics or FP&A role, ideally in fintech, banking or payments

  • Strong SQL and solid Python

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (or a similar transformation tool) and version control (Git)

  • A good grasp of financial statements, management accounts and core finance concepts (accruals, revenue recognition, unit economics)

  • A quantitative background, through education or experience

  • Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset, while still able to work to tight deadlines

  • Clear communication: you can explain a variance to a CFO and a data model to an engineer

  • Initiative to automate repetitive work and improve how things are done

Nice to have

  • Experience with regulatory or external reporting

  • Exposure to reconciliations, treasury or general ledger data

  • Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI) and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)

  • Experience maintaining production code: code review, testing, CI/CD

  • Spanish or Portuguese proficiency

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Stock options, so you own part of what you build

  • Discretionary performance bonus

  • The latest tools and technology

  • A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

  • The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

  • Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

title: Finance Manager – Automatisierung & KI (all genders) | Voll- oder Teilzeit | ab sofort
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die MainTea GmbH. Ein wachsendes Food-Tech-Unternehmen aus Frankfurt.

Mit unseren Marken Besser im Glas, Bubble Pop, PRO2BE, Honest Coco und SMOOOTH IT bringen wir innovative Produkte in den Lebensmitteleinzelhandel und den E-Commerce und entwickeln gleichzeitig als operativer Mikro-VC neue Marken und Produktideen.

Mit unserem Wachstum werden auch unsere Finanzprozesse über mehrere Gesellschaften hinweg komplexer – und wir wollen sie nicht mit mehr Händen, sondern mit besseren Systemen lösen. Deshalb suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit im Bereich Finance, die Buchhaltung versteht und lebt und Lust hat, Finance Operations mit KI und Automatisierung neu zu denken. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Steuerbüro und den internen Teams zusammen.

Aufgaben

  • Finance Operations: Verantwortung für die laufenden Finanzprozesse der Gruppe – von Kreditoren- und Debitorenmanagement über Zahlungsverkehr und Belegmanagement bis zur Vorbereitung für Monatsabschluss und Steuerbüro.

  • Prozessautomatisierung: Identifikation manueller, wiederkehrender Abläufe (z. B. Rechnungseingang, Zahlungsabgleich, Mahnwesen, Kontierung) und deren schrittweise Automatisierung mit Tools, Schnittstellen und KI-Agenten.

  • KI im Finance: Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung KI-gestützter Workflows – etwa für Auswertungen, Abstimmungen, Reportings oder die Prüfung von Zahlungsavisen. Du testest neue Tools und bringst das, was funktioniert, in den Alltag.

  • Systemlandschaft: Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Tools (u. a. DATEV, Moss, Xentral, Shopify) und Sicherstellung sauberer, durchgängiger Datenflüsse zwischen den Systemen.

  • Reporting & Transparenz: Aufbau und Automatisierung regelmäßiger Finanz-Reportings und KPIs für Geschäftsführung und Gesellschafter, damit wir jederzeit wissen, wo wir stehen.

  • Schnittstelle: Ansprechpartner:in für Steuerbüro und interne Teams in allen operativen Finanzthemen.

Qualifikation

  • Buchhaltungsverständnis: Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Accounting und erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 1–3 Jahre) in Buchhaltung, Finance oder Controlling. Du weißt, was hinter einer Buchung steckt – musst aber kein Bilanzbuchhalter sein.

  • KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude schon heute selbstverständlich und hast Spaß daran, herauszufinden, was damit alles geht.

  • Tech- & Prozessdenken: Du denkst in Abläufen und Systemen. Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools (z. B. Make, Zapier, n8n), fortgeschrittene Excel/Google-Sheets-Kenntnisse oder erste Schritte in SQL/Python sind ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Sorgfalt & Struktur: Genaue, zuverlässige und disziplinierte Arbeitsweise und Überblick auch über mehrere Gesellschaften hinweg.

  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Mindset: Ownership, Neugier, Hands-on. Du gibst dich nicht mit „haben wir immer so gemacht“ zufrieden.

Benefits

  • Team & Kultur: Offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Arbeitsumfeld mit regelmäßigen Teamevents und echter Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum, frühe Verantwortung und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – du baust den Finance-Bereich aktiv mit auf.

  • Moderne Tools: Zugang zu aktuellen KI-Tools und die Freiheit, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.

  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage sowie ein strukturiertes und modernes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden: Frisches Team Lunch an drei Tagen pro Woche durch unsere Köchin sowie eine wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Flexible Vorteile: Wahl zwischen Wellhub für Fitness & Gesundheit oder steuerfreien Sachbezügen.

Wenn du Lust hast, unseren Finance-Bereich mit KI und Automatisierung auf das nächste Level zu bringen, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Schick uns gerne deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Motivation – gerne mit einem Beispiel, wo du KI oder Automatisierung schon einmal sinnvoll eingesetzt hast.

title: Finance Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: Finance Manager

Team: Finance

Location: UK Hybrid; London or Leeds area preferred for hybrid collaboration. Wider UK candidates considered.

Number of Positions: 2

As Finance Manager, you’ll report to Reshma Nangpal and work closely with the broader finance team, including other Finance Managers, to deliver accurate, timely month-end accounting and financial control. This is a hands-on role covering bank and PSP reconciliations, sportsbook and casino revenue accounting, gaming duties and revenue-share payments. You’ll partner with Data, Compliance and Commercial teams, strengthen scalable processes and support Midnite’s growth across entities and markets. We’re hiring two people, with flexibility for mid-level and more senior accountants.

 

You will:

  • Deliver key aspects of the monthly close accurately and on time, including accounts payable, supplier invoices, staff expenses and company credit card reconciliations.

  • Perform and review bank reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, post bank fees and update month-end FX rates.

  • Own PSP reconciliations and monthly journals, matching settlement and transactional data to accounting records.

  • Maintain reconciliations for deferred revenue, player balances, prepayments and fixed assets, and accrue key supplier costs.

  • Prepare sportsbook and casino revenue journals and reconcile revenue and cost of sales to source data, including promotional deductions and adjustments.

  • Verify and accrue contractual revenue-share payments, share monthly data with casino suppliers and reconcile it to internal records; manage international partner revenue-share receivables and invoicing.

  • Calculate and accrue General Betting Duty, Remote Gaming Duty, the Horse Racing Levy, Statutory Levy and Economic Crime Levy.

  • Prepare the month-end cash report, support management reporting and variance analysis, reconcile marketing costs and post interest journals for the user acquisition credit facility.

  • Help maintain the financial model with FP&A and Data, aligning reporting with forecasts and KPIs and supporting gross-margin and customer-profitability analysis.

  • Maintain robust controls and documentation, review balance sheets, liaise with external accountants and auditors, and assess accounting treatments for new deals as Midnite expands internationally.

  • Improve workflows through automation and AI, collaborating with other Finance Managers and cross-functional teams to deliver accurate, timely financial insight.

 

The next Midniter:

  • Is at least part-qualified (e.g. ACCA, CIMA or ACA) and actively working toward full qualification, or is fully qualified and looking for a more senior opening.

  • Has hands-on month-end accounting and financial control experience, including reconciliations and revenue processes.

  • Is familiar with PSPs and high-volume transactional data.

  • Understands UK GAAP/IFRS and their application to revenue and cost accounting, alongside robust controls and audit-ready records.

  • Brings gambling industry experience as a strong advantage, not a requirement; gaming duty calculation experience is also a plus.

  • Genuinely wants to work in gambling and learns unfamiliar topics through proactive research and technical questioning.

  • Brings commercial acumen, can assess deals from financial and accounting perspectives, and has experience in business partnering, ideally in gaming, betting or technology.

  • Is proficient in financial modelling, forecasting and variance analysis and can turn data into useful recommendations.

  • Has advanced Excel and financial systems knowledge; experience with BI tools is a plus.

  • Communicates clearly with senior and non-finance stakeholders, takes ownership and maintains high attention to detail.

  • Looks for practical improvements to workflows, documentation and data quality, including opportunities to use automation and AI.

💰 Winnings - UK

  • Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

  • Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

  • Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

  • Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.

  • Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

  • Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

At Midnite, we’re committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

title: Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.


Role overview

Complex merchants can create complex financial crime risks. Their corporate structures, operating models and control environments may span entities, jurisdictions and teams. When concerns emerge, effective action depends on more than identifying the issue: someone must bring the right people together, agree a credible response, and keep remediation moving until it is complete.

As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. You will coordinate targeted oversight of higher-risk or strategically important merchant relationships, helping turn concerns into clear, proportionate and evidenced plans. You will work across Compliance, Financial Crime Investigations, onboarding, commercial and operational teams, and, where appropriate, directly with merchants. Your judgement will matter: you will need to know when a proposed control or remediation is credible, when evidence is insufficient, and when an issue needs escalation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines financial crime compliance expertise with strong delivery discipline. You will help address issues early, support defensible decisions, and give complex remediation the structure and follow-through it needs.

What you’ll do

  • Own targeted remediation coordination. For complex merchant concerns, bring together the relevant internal teams, clarify the problem and desired outcomes, agree accountable owners and milestones, and maintain a practical plan through to closure. Track dependencies and slippage, challenge gaps, escalate material blockers and confirm that completion is supported by evidence.

  • Coordinate Compliance-imposed conditions. Track material financial-crime conditions attached to product, market or other approval decisions. Work with the relevant Compliance and business owners to confirm accountability, milestones and evidence of completion; identify slippage or gaps; challenge whether evidence demonstrates the condition has been met; and escalate overdue or inadequately evidenced actions through the agreed governance route. The relevant delivery owner remains accountable for implementing the condition.

  • Coordinate enhanced oversight of merchants. Support a structured watch-list approach for merchants whose risk or control environment warrants closer attention than routine, risk-tiered monitoring, but where immediate termination or a formal investigation is not necessarily the right response. Help define the oversight plan, review progress and ensure concerns do not remain unresolved or without an owner.

  • Assess remediation quality. Review proposed actions and evidence against the underlying financial crime concern and relevant regulatory expectations. Identify whether controls appear appropriately designed and operating, whether further evidence or testing is needed, and whether residual concerns require escalation or a change in the relationship’s risk treatment.

  • Engage merchants constructively. Where appropriate, work with account teams to agree clear requests, expectations and timelines with merchants. Maintain a firm, evidence-led approach while supporting a proportionate path to address weaknesses and establish whether the relationship can be sustained safely.

  • Lead enhanced control reviews. Design and, where appropriate, lead deeper reviews of a merchant’s AML controls during onboarding or ongoing oversight. This may include preparing agendas, conducting structured discussions with merchant stakeholders, probing key control areas, documenting findings and agreeing any required remediation.

  • Support reliance and outsourcing assessments. Contribute to the initial scrutiny of outsourced activities or other arrangements that depend on another party’s controls. Help establish whether reliance is justified, what evidence supports that view, and what conditions or remediation are required.

  • Improve the oversight approach. Capture recurring issues, lessons and delivery gaps, and help refine processes, reporting and escalation so that complex concerns receive consistent, timely and well-evidenced attention.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or a closely related risk and control role, with a sound understanding of AML control frameworks and how to assess their design and effectiveness.

  • Experience coordinating complex remediation, regulatory or audit actions, control reviews, investigations follow-through, or comparable cross-functional change. You can turn an ambiguous issue into a sequenced plan with clear owners, milestones and evidence of completion.

  • The confidence and judgement to challenge senior stakeholders and merchants constructively, distinguish a credible response from a paper commitment, and escalate when progress or evidence is inadequate.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to lead structured discussions, document findings clearly and translate complex issues into practical actions.

  • Excellent organisation and follow-through across multiple workstreams, with a pragmatic approach to prioritisation, dependencies and changing circumstances.

  • A collaborative style and the resilience to work through sensitive, commercially significant issues without losing sight of the control outcome.

  • Experience with structured project management methods, such as Lean Six Sigma or PRINCE2, to drive organised execution across complex workstreams is a strong plus.

Experience with complex merchants, payments, cryptoassets, money service businesses, correspondent or outsourced service models would be valuable. Relevant professional qualifications are welcome but are not a substitute for sound judgement and demonstrated delivery.

Why this role

You will work at the point where financial crime risk, merchant relationships and practical execution meet. The role offers meaningful ownership of issues that cut across teams and can shape whether concerns are resolved early, managed with appropriate safeguards, or escalated on a sound evidential basis. Success is visible in the quality of the decisions and the fact that agreed actions are actually completed.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Lead complex risk transformation across financial services at scale

The Role

Capco is seeking a Financial Risk Transformation Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. In this role, you'll lead strategic client engagements, advise senior stakeholders including Chief Risk Officers, and drive transformation across risk functions. You'll play a key role in shaping large-scale programmes spanning liquidity, credit, market, and model risk, helping clients modernise their risk capabilities through data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled ways of working. You'll leverage approved AI tools to enhance insight, improve delivery efficiency, and support better decision-making while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex risk transformation programmes across liquidity, credit, market, and model risk, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation to improve client outcomes.
  • Advise senior stakeholders on regulatory frameworks including Basel, IFRS 9, and BCBS 239, translating regulatory requirements into practical transformation strategies and sustainable operating models.
  • Design and implement enhanced risk controls, target operating models, governance frameworks, and data-driven reporting solutions that strengthen regulatory compliance and business performance.
  • Drive the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve risk processes, reporting, forecasting, and decision-making while ensuring appropriate governance and validation.
  • Contribute to business development, proposition development, client relationship growth, and the continued expansion of Capco's Financial Risk capability.

  • Extensive experience delivering financial risk transformation programmes within financial services or management consulting.
  • Deep expertise across liquidity risk, credit risk, market risk, and model risk, with strong knowledge of Basel, IFRS 9, BCBS 239, and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes and influencing senior stakeholders, including Chief Risk Officers and executive leadership teams.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with experience using approved AI tools and automation to enhance delivery while maintaining sound professional judgement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex risk challenges into practical, business-focused solutions.

Bonus Points For

  • Leadership experience including mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing consulting teams.

Why Join Capco

  • Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured leadership development.

title: FinTech Operations Graduate (Customer Support)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

  • Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

  • Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

  • Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

  • Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

  • Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

  • Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

  • Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues


What we're looking for

Essential

  • Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

  • The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

  • Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

  • Sound judgement, and the willingness to speak up when a customer isn't getting a good outcome

  • Comfort with digital tools and picking up new technology, including AI-driven platforms

  • Availability to work from our Chatham office three days a week and two weekends a month (where you will work from home)

Nice to have

  • Experience in a contact centre or another customer-facing role, particularly in financial services would be a definite plus but it is not essential for this role.

  • A habit of spotting where a process could work better and suggesting how


Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.Interview process


Our Interview Process

We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Fixed-Wing Test Pilot, you will operate Alta Ares' fixed-wing drones during development and demos. You will act as the Safety Pilot during experimental flights, ensuring mission success and platform integrity. Over time, you will also contribute to training, documentation, and continuous improvement of operational procedures.

Flight Operations

  • Operate fixed-wing UAVs during development tests and demos

  • Execute manual piloting tasks, including executing non-standard or complex takeoff and landing procedures.

  • Serve as Safety Pilot during avionics hardware and software testing, closely monitoring aircraft behavior and taking manual control when required.

  • Work with the flight-controller team to provide detailed feedback on anomalies or unexpected behavior.

  • Validate aircraft airworthiness and pre-flight checks.

Aircraft Maintenance

  • Prepare, organize, and maintain flight-test and demo equipment.

  • Routine maintenance of the UAV

  • Repairs and hardware adjustments

Requirements

  • Proven experience flying fixed-wing UAVs (required).

  • Experience flying multirotor drones (preferred).

  • Strong understanding of aerodynamics, CG balancing, and basic aircraft mechanics.

  • Ability to troubleshoot propulsion systems, particularly turbines.

  • Familiarity with flight-control systems, tuning, and parameter testing.

  • Hands-on skills in maintenance and repair of UAV platforms.

  • Strong safety mindset and ability to operate under test-flight conditions.

title: Flight Control System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
  • Design and analyze flight control algorithms and Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) architecture.
  • Develop and validate control laws through simulation (e.g. 6-DOF simulations).
  • Define flight control system requirements and manage interfaces with avionics and seeker teams.
  • Support hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and flight test campaigns.
  • Analyze flight/test data and support root-cause investigations.
  • Maintain technical documentation in line with requirements.

Who You Are 
  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience in flight control/GNC system design, ideally on missiles, rockets, or aircraft.
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and control system design/analysis.
  • Experience with 6-DOF simulation and control law validation.
  • Strong analytical skills and systems-level thinking.

    • What we offer 

    • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe's most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

    • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

    • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

    • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

    • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

    • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


    Security and Eligibility Requirement 

    Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/NATO/German citizen and eligible for Security Clearance.

    At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.
