title: Forward-Deployed Banker
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

The Customer Success organisation is composed of three teams: Pre-sales, Customer Success, and Support. The Customer Success Manager will join a team of trusted partners alongside their Account Manager, working closely with newly onboarded and existing clients to demonstrate the full value of our platform, develop strong client engagement, drive successful renewals and contribute to growth across dedicated accounts. They are natural problem-solvers, storytellers and product experts who thrive on helping customers make better and faster decisions.

Customer Success Managers combine deep product knowledge, industry experience and ability to build strong client relationships to ensure that each client interaction is both meaningful and impactful. Due to their extensive exposure to a variety of clients both on the buy-side and sell-side, they are the Voice of the Customer, working closely alongside our Product Management and Content teams to help determine future product developments, as well as playing a key role in product Betas and the customer feedback loop.

About the Role: 

As a Forward-Deployed Banker, you will play a critical role in driving product adoption and delivering ongoing value to our clients, working closely with the wider account team to positively impact net retention. You’ll engage directly with clients and develop a comprehensive understanding of their workflows, challenges, and goals; bridging the gap between the powerful capabilities of our technology and the domain-specific needs of financial professionals across: Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity/Venture Capital and Hedge Funds.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Partner with GTM Teams to Drive Commercial Outcomes: Collaborate closely with your Account Manager and the wider account management team to ensure continuous alignment of account strategies and goals. 
  • Leverage Data Driven Insights: Use internal data tools to monitor client engagement, identify opportunities to showcase value, and strengthen platform adoption. Proactively seek growth opportunities while also detecting early signs of churn risk to support retention and long-term account success.
  • Build and Curate Financial Services Use Cases: Conduct targeted discovery into clients' unique research workflows and painpoints in order to help them effectively leverage AlphaSense for their bespoke use cases. Continue to seek out and develop new and emerging use cases with clients as AlphaSense’s capabilities evolve.
  • Forge and Maintain Strong Client Relationships: Engage directly with investment professionals of all levels/seniority at financial institutions to understand their most pressing challenges and goals. Deliver white glove service that puts the clients needs first; going above and beyond to build trust and credibility as a Trusted Partner and Product Expert.
  • Contribute to Product Development: Translate client feedback and proactively share product & content improvements/enhancement requests internally.

Who You Are:

You have a proven track record of working with Financial Services investors/clients to solve complex problems and are passionate about the application of AI to the industry. You are client-centric and creative thinker with an ambition to continuously improve processes and a desire to contribute to a fast-growing, entrepreneurial team culture. You are a natural problem solver and prioritise white glove service to go above and beyond for clients. You enjoy autonomy and proactively drive initiatives that contribute to long term success. You enjoy cross-functional partnerships and are able to build strong internal stakeholder relationships.

What You Bring:

  • Financial Services Expertise: 2+ years of front-office investment banking experience, ideally with exposure to more than one product area (e.g., DCM, ECM, M&A, Leveraged Finance), providing a strong foundation in capital markets processes and client-facing deal work.
  • Curiosity About Generative AI in Financial Services: A demonstrated interest in the transformative potential of AI for the financial sector, flexible problem-solving skills and knowledge of the competitive landscape for GenAI in Financial Services.
  • Executive Presence & Strong Presentation Skills: A proven capacity to engage stakeholders at all levels, earn their trust, and explain technical solutions to business-oriented audiences. Comfort with conducting evaluations of varying lengths/forms e.g. on-site workshops, whiteboard sessions, multi-call demos etc.
  • High-Impact, Ownership Mindset: An exceptional ability to thrive on autonomy, tackle client questions and challenges with enthusiasm, and drive workflow transformation at some of the world's biggest financial firms.
  • Consultative Approach: A highly articulate, consultative, and confident client-facing professional with the ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.
  • Team Player: Superior ability to build and maintain strong internal relationships, combined with a positive and proactive personality.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Ability to work cross-functionally and effectively distill client feedback to GTM, Product, and Content teams, in order to continually help influence and improve our capabilities/product offerings.
  • A Proactive Mindset with a passion for client success and continuous improvement

Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of front-office investment banking experience across at least one product area, with a solid grounding in capital markets and client-facing deal execution.
  • High aptitude and willingness to learn.
  • Outstanding oral, written, and presentation skills.
  • Effective attention to detail, time management, and task prioritization, even when under pressure.
  • Ability and interest to work autonomously and contribute to a dynamic and entrepreneurial team culture.
  • Empathetic, curious minded, client-centric

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We’re looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You’ll build and lead an exceptional FDE team in your location, while working alongside our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. You’ll remain deeply hands-on — working directly with our most ambitious customers, writing production code, and building alongside your team.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 

What makes this role special?

You will:

• Build and lead the FDE team in your location

• Join a small group of FDE leaders defining how the function operates and scales globally

• Stay deeply hands-on — personally building and shipping alongside your team

• Partner with customers building never-seen-before AI systems

• Set a high technical bar across architecture, engineering, and execution

• Turn patterns from real deployments into core product and platform improvements

• Influence our product direction, technical roadmap, and how FDE works at Lovable

 

If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself — this is that role.

 

What we’re looking for

• 12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering

• Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams

• A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown

• Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals across modern frontend and backend development

• Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems

• Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end

• Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users

• Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior customer stakeholders

• High agency and comfort operating in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments

 

Bonus if you’ve:

• Built a team or technical function from zero

• Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production

• Led zero-to-one product development

• Worked in a founding or early-stage startup environment

• Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI

 

What you’ll do

In one sentence: build the team that deploys intelligence into the real world — and deploy it alongside them.

• Recruit, develop, and lead an exceptional team of Forward Deployed Engineers

• Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems

• Personally design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team

• Own and guide projects from idea → architecture → shipping → iteration

• Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering

• Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements

• Partner with other FDE leads to shape standards, playbooks, and how the function scales globally

• Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

 

Our Tech Stack

We choose tools that empower both humans and AI:

• Frontend: React, TypeScript

• Backend: Golang & Rust

• Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers

• Tooling: GitHub Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

• Always evolving with what works best

 

How we hire

1. Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team

2. A technical leadership interview — how you build teams, set standards, and make technical decisions

3. Show us how you approach hard technical problems

4. Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud

5. Conversations with the leaders you’d work most closely with, followed by a final discussion

 

About your application

• Please submit your application in English — it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join

• We treat all candidates equally — if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you'll spend your time writing code. You'll work with partner technical teams and end users to understand what they actually need, then design and build the solution yourself: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment. You'll be close enough to the mission to see why the problem matters, and you'll ship fast, because what you build gets used in the field almost immediately. Once a solution proves itself, you'll work with our core platform team to fold the durable parts back into the product, so your work keeps paying off beyond the deployment you built it for.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build software applications that solve specific operational problems for our partners, owning them end-to-end from architecture through deployment.

  • Take loosely defined, real-world requirements from partner militaries and organizations and turn them into working software, often on tight timelines.

  • Build interfaces and connectors between our platforms and partner systems, and validate data flows end-to-end in the field.

  • Deploy your solutions on site, gather feedback directly from operators, and iterate quickly based on what you see working (or not) in practice.

  • Spot patterns and capabilities worth building into the core product, and work with our platform engineering team to get them there.

  • Debug issues in live operational settings, drive them to resolution, and document what you learn along the way.

  • Build real working relationships with client technical teams and end users so you understand their problems well enough to solve them properly.

Requirements

  • 4+ years building and shipping production software, in Python and at least one lower-level language (C++, Rust, Go).

  • A track record of defining and building end-to-end systems: projects, internships, or early-career work where you took an ambiguous problem to a working, deployed solution.

  • Comfortable owning software end-to-end — design, build, debug, deploy — including on Linux, in operational or field conditions.

  • Confident and clear communicating with client technical teams and senior stakeholders, with a bias to action

  • Practical under constraint: ill-defined problems, tight deadlines, and a working solution over a theoretically perfect one.

  • Travel: frequent on site with partners, domestic and international.

  • Proficiency in English is mandatory.

Nice to have

  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering experience.

  • Depth in computer vision, deep learning, mission planning, robotics, or embedded software.

  • Degree from a leading engineering school.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Founder Associate / Assistenz der Geschäftsführung (m/w/d) - - Vollzeit
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht zuschauen, wie ein Unternehmen gebaut wird – du willst es mitbauen.

besser zuhause baut Badezimmer für Menschen um, die zu Hause alt werden wollen. Unser Kernprodukt ist der Umbau von der Badewanne zur barrierearmen Dusche, komplett aus einer Hand: Beratung, Planung, Zuschuss der Pflegekasse, Umsetzung, Abrechnung. Wir arbeiten stark standardisiert, mit einem eigenen Duschsystem, einem Netz aus Wohnberatern und Handwerkspartnern. Unsere Standorte sind Hamburg, Berlin, Hannover und Bremen.

Der Markt wächst, weil die Gesellschaft altert. Unser Ziel ist ein skalierbares System für altersgerechtes Wohnen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der eng mit der Geschäftsführung arbeitet und uns den Rücken freihält.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und bist in alle wichtigen Themen eingebunden. Nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung übernimmst du schnell eigene Verantwortung. Am Anfang begleitest du Projekte, später führst du sie selbst. Deine Schwerpunkte:

Personal

  • Recruiting steuern: Stellen ausschreiben, Bewerber vorqualifizieren, Prozesse in Personio sauber halten

  • Onboarding, Vertragsvorbereitung und HR-Prozesse mitgestalten

  • Bei Vergütungs- und Provisionsmodellen mitarbeiten

Finanzen

  • Liquiditätsplanung und Reporting vorbereiten (Profit Center, KPIs, Power BI)

  • Offene Forderungen im Blick behalten, vor allem gegenüber Pflegekassen

  • Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung aufbereiten

Geschäftsentwicklung

  • Neue Geschäftsfelder und Partnerschaften bewerten und aufbauen, z. B. mit der Wohnungswirtschaft oder für Treppenlifte

  • Den Markteintritt in neue Regionen vorbereiten

  • Prozesse analysieren, standardisieren und mit AI und Automatisierung verbessern

Und alles dazwischen: Du übernimmst, was gerade am wichtigsten ist, und bringst es zu Ende.

Was du mitbringst

  • Einen sehr guten Abschluss, z. B. in BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fach

  • Erste Berufserfahrung, z. B. in Beratung, Startup, Private Equity oder einer operativen Rolle. Praktika zählen.

  • Analytische Stärke: Excel ist kein Fremdwort für dich, Zahlen erzählen dir Geschichten

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du schreibst nicht nur Konzepte, du setzt sie auch um

  • Strukturiertes Arbeiten, auch wenn zehn Dinge gleichzeitig brennen

  • Klare Kommunikation, mit Handwerkern genauso wie mit Vorständen von Wohnungsunternehmen

  • Neugier auf AI-Tools und Lust, Abläufe zu automatisieren

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch, weil unsere Kunden, Partner und Teams Deutsch sprechen

Was wir dir bieten

  • Lernkurve: Du siehst das ganze Unternehmen, von der Baustelle bis zur Gesellschafterebene

  • Echte Verantwortung: Nach der Einarbeitung führst du eigene Projekte mit spürbarer Wirkung

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Wir sind Sparringspartner und Mentoren, keine Chefs, die nur delegieren

  • Perspektive: Founder Associates entwickeln sich bei uns in Führungsrollen weiter, z. B. als Head of People, Finance oder Expansion

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit: Was wir bauen, sorgt dafür, dass Menschen länger sicher zu Hause leben können

Vergütung

Das Gehalt für diese Position liegt bei EUR 42,000–55,000 pro Jahr.

title: Founder’s Associate / Entrepreneur in Residence
descriptionHtml:
About us
We’re a team of serial entrepreneurs who have built and scaled companies before, and we’re starting again. Our next venture tackles a problem every founder knows: protecting your brand is slow, expensive and confusing. We combine smart technology with real trademark expertise to make it simple.

We’re at the very beginning, and that’s exactly why we’re looking for you: someone who wants to build a company from day one, side by side with founders who’ve done it before.

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

title: Founder's Associate
descriptionHtml:
Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut.

Tasks

In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren. Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung.

🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3)

Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst:

  • Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation.

  • Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen.

  • Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist.

  • AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet.

🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3)

Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel:

  • Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren

  • Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen

  • Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten

  • Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten

Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will.

Requirements

Rahmen

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate, Vollzeit

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

Wie du arbeitest

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht.

  • AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup.

  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

  • Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier)

  • Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung: Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.

Was du danach kannst

  1. Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt.

  2. Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient.

  3. Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden.

  4. Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr.

Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen

Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran: Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst.

Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen

  1. Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln.

  2. Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago.

Wie du dabei wächst

  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm.

  • Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch.

  • Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions.

  • Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst.

Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung.

  • Read This Before Joining as Employee 1 to 20 at a Startup von Stacy La (Employee #3 bei Clover Health): https://review.firstround.com/read-this-before-joining-as-employee-1-to-20-at-a-startup

  • First Startup Employees – Erfahrungsberichte von frühen Mitarbeitenden bei Wise, GoCardless, Gousto und mehr: https://sifted.eu/articles/first-startup-employees/

Zusätzlich bieten wir:

  • Perks: Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, zweimal pro Woche gemeinsames Team-Dinner sowie Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community.

  • Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung.

Closing

1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung

Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast.

2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

Ein kurzes Kennenlernen mit Maria, um deinen Hintergrund und deine Motivation zu verstehen. Wir erklären dir die Rolle, zeigen das Produkt und beantworten erste Fragen.

3. Gespräch mit den Gründern (25 Minuten)

Lerne Janick oder Ann-Christin kennen, mit denen du jeden Tag zusammenarbeiten wirst. Vorab bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe, die du im Gespräch kurz vorstellst. Perfekt muss sie nicht sein. Uns interessiert vor allem, wie du an Dinge herangehst.

4. Case Study / Schnuppertag (halber Tag vor Ort)

title: Founding engineer, AI on CAD geometry (co-founder equity)
descriptionHtml:
Founding engineer: AI that reads mechanical designs (Berlin / remote EU):

LoopforgeLab enables machine and hardware makers make better design decisions by better we mean shorter design iterations, more sustainable products with less cost to manfuacture and own.

We are building the Forge Engine is an agentic tool for manufacturing. Give it a BOM and a STEP file and it returns what the part costs to make and what the machine will cost to own over fifteen years, while there is still time to change the design. The lifecycle engine is built and runs on declared drivers. The agent already modifies geometry from natural-language instructions on our platform.

The next piece is the reason we are hiring. We need geometry reasoning that holds up on real customer CAD: feature recognition from B-rep, tolerances read per feature rather than per part, similarity against parts we have already costed, and an evaluation setup that shows whether the agent is improving or only sounding more certain. Also we need to build integrations with different CAD/ER and PLM systems.

What you would own:

  • The geometry reasoning module. Feature extraction from STEP, manufacturability signals, tolerance and surface finish handling.

  • The design agent’s optimisation loop. Iterating a design against a cost or lifecycle target rather than following instructions.

  • Evaluation. Benchmarks, regression suites, and the discipline to drop approaches that do not beat the baseline.

  • Architecture decisions with the founder, including when LLM reasoning beats rules and when it does not.

  • Reasoning Engine and live context retriever

Who you probably are:

  • Strong experience with one of those: Python/Rust and C++ and real ML depth. You have built at least once in your life a geometric deep learning, GNNs, 3D representation learning modules in real production data settings and they're used by real users right now.

  • You have touched mechanical engineering for real. A degree, CAE/CAD/CAM work, manufacturing process knowledge, or a PhD near feature recognition, DFM or process simulation. You know why a tight tolerance on one face costs more than a loose one on five.

  • Comfortable with messy industrial data. Re-exported CAD that parses differently, BOMs with missing fields, 40 parts rather than 40,000.

  • You ship. Two-week demoable checkpoints rather than six-month research tracks.

  • Familiar with sustainability concepts and how do they be applied in the context of design and manufacturing

Nice to have:

  • OpenCascade, PythonOCC, or commercial CAD kernel experience.

  • MCP servers, agent tooling, or LLM-in-the-loop CAD work.

Co-founder-level equity with standard vesting. You would be the thrid engineer in the room, which means you own things outright, including the parts nobody enjoys. We plan to open source what the community builds and put a private product layer on top.

title: FTTH Security Expert
descriptionHtml:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on.

Job Description

If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together.

What you will do

  • Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment.

  • PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned.

  • CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws.

  • Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers.

  • Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines.

  • Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base.

  • Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting.

  • The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial)

  • MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure

  • Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment.

  • Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications.

  • Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure.

  • Relevant certifications, such as:

  • OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED

  • GPEN / GXPN / GRID

  • CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO

  • Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings)

  • Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices.

If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security!

Language requirements

  • English - fluent speaker

  • French - optional

Further details

  • 🏢 Headquarters: Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE

  • 🏠 Remote policy:

  • At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

  • C-level & Director call (30 min)

Specialisations

Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

title: General Manager
descriptionHtml:

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  • You’ll be spending most of your time with prospects across phone calls, emails and live chat on our website, as well as internal tools like slack and salesforce.

  • Your quota is measured by the number of demonstrations booked and completed at the subsequent stage of the process. Our current team in this role have achieved >=95% of their targets each month since starting

 

⚡ Challenges

  • Learning about the built world if you haven’t had any exposure to it - there are a lot of different types of companies and plenty of new terminologies to learn.

  • Up-skilling your call/phone and email skills - although we have plenty of examples for you to learn from during your onboarding.

  • Understanding SaaS financial acronyms and common terminology - if you have not worked in a SaaS company before, there is going to be a lot of metrics to learn. This cheat sheet is a good resource: The Ultimate SaaS Acronyms Cheat Sheet

  • We move very quickly, so you’ll need to be excited to come in and learn extremely fast.

 

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Ambitious individuals wanting to pursue a career in SaaS

  • People who thrive in a structured, high-agency, KPI-driven environment

  • Strong communicators who enjoy building relationships

  • Resilient individuals who can persevere and perform with high-volume tasks

 

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • Those unwilling to handle rejection frequently

  • People uncomfortable with people and conversations

 

🎯 Skills & Tools

Must Have:

  • Confident and clear communication skills, with excellent writing and presentation skills over email, phone, video conferencing and in-person.

  • Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases.

  • Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers).

  • Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy.

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site.

We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada.

 

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

 

Our Core Values

Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate.

  • Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered

  • Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic

  • Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all

  • Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change

  • High Vis: A high visibility, transparent and  open environment

title: GRC Automation Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that.

The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls.

  • Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review.

  • Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding.

What Ramping Up Looks Like:

You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end.

Why This Role:

  • You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist.

  • You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code.

  • We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day.

  • Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent).

  • 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes.

  • Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus.

  • Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others to do so.

  • Deep GRC fluency: control design, evidence, risk, and how auditors actually think.

  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP): IAM, compute, storage, networking, and security controls, because that’s where the evidence lives.

  • Systems thinker who prefers to automate repetitive manual work rather than repeat it.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Reads APIs, JSON, and logs comfortably; scripting (Python, bash, TypeScript).

  • Prior hands-on experience with a GRC automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or similar).

  • Scripting/light coding and API integration experience.

  • Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar.

  • AI governance, AI risk management, or ISO 42001 exposure.

  • Background in a technology, SaaS, or engineering-adjacent environment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

title: Growth Engineer (all genders) B2B SaaS für KMU
descriptionHtml:
Deutschland lebt von seinen kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen, und viel zu viel von deren Geld und Aufmerksamkeit geht in die Pflicht: Buchhaltung, Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung, Jahresabschluss. Unvermeidbare Arbeit, die niemand will und für die alle zu viel bezahlen.

mika nimmt sie ihnen ab. Weil nichts davon optional ist, verstehen wir das, was wir bauen, als Infrastruktur und nicht als Software, und der Zweck ist einfach: Es soll billiger werden, in Deutschland ein Unternehmen zu führen.

Von 100 auf über 900 Kund:innen in acht Monaten, und immer noch ein kleines Team. Intern arbeiten wir auf Englisch, weil das Team international ist. Der Markt ist deutsch.

Worum es geht

Unser Growth-Team hat mehr Ideen als Hände. Es gibt eine Website, die mehr könnte, Landingpages, die gebaut werden wollen, Tracking, dem man noch nicht trauen kann, und eine Menge Handarbeit in Marketing und Vertrieb, die niemand machen müsste. Diese Rolle ist die technische Hand im Growth-Team – die Person, die das baut, live stellt und am Laufen hält.

Du bekommst Probleme, keine Tickets. Wenn etwas an dich übergeben wird, dann in der Form „hier klemmt es" und nicht „bau bitte genau das" – den Weg dahin entwirfst du. Und du bringst eigene Ideen mit: Was dir auffällt und was du für richtig hältst, landet auf derselben Liste wie alles andere.

Was du machst

  • Website und Landingpages: entwickeln, bauen, live stellen – inklusive der interaktiven Elemente, die eine Seite von einer Broschüre unterscheiden

  • Tracking, SEO und Hosting: dass die Seite schnell ist, gefunden wird und dass man den Zahlen dahinter trauen kann

  • Prototypen und Automationen: Die schnellste Version, die eine Frage beantwortet – ein Prototyp ist bei uns meistens auch ein Experiment, und du liest das Ergebnis mit

  • Tooling für Growth und Sales: z.B. Clay, Lemlist und was sonst gerade das Richtige ist. Leitfrage: Welche Handarbeit in diesem Team müsste es eigentlich nicht mehr geben?

  • Die Brücke zum Produkt: Du sitzt in Growth, gehst aber auch in die Dailys der Entwickler – vieles, was Marketing braucht, hängt am Produkt und umgekehrt

Wie es hier wirklich aussieht

Vieles ist unfertig. Unserem Tracking kann man an Stellen nicht trauen, und ein Teil der ersten Monate ist Aufräumen, bevor es Bauen wird. Dafür gilt das Gegenteil von dem, was du vielleicht kennst: kein Freigabeprozess, kein Ticketstapel, kein Warten auf eine andere Abteilung. Was du für richtig hältst, kannst du heute live stellen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast schon etwas selbst live gestellt – nicht nur lokal gebaut. Du weißt, wie ein Server von innen aussieht, was Hosting bedeutet und worin der Unterschied zwischen Herumprobieren und Ausliefern liegt.

  • Du willst nicht nur Entwickler:in sein. Marketing interessiert dich wirklich: Du verfolgst, was im Markt passiert, hast eine Meinung zu Kampagnen, die dir begegnen, und willst verstehen, warum Leute kaufen – nicht nur, wie man es technisch umsetzt.

  • Neugier auf Werkzeuge. Du probierst Neues aus, bevor dich jemand darum bittet, und hast Spaß daran, anderen im Team die Arbeit leichter zu machen.

  • Auge für Gestaltung. Du erkennst, ob eine Seite absichtsvoll aussieht, und kannst sagen, warum eine schwache Version schwach ist.

  • KI ist dein Normalzustand, nicht dein Nebenprojekt. Ohne würde dir das Arbeiten langsam vorkommen.

  • Eigene Ideen. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist – aber du kannst auch mit einer fremden Priorität arbeiten, ohne dass es dich stört.

hilfreich, aber nicht nötig

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot, GA4, GTM oder vergleichbaren Stacks

  • Eigene Projekte, ein Nebenprodukt, ein Shop, eine Seite, die Leute wirklich benutzen

  • SEO über die Grundlagen hinaus

kein Fit

  • Du willst reine Entwicklungsarbeit und Marketing ist dir egal

  • Du brauchst fertige Tickets, Reviews und einen Prozess, bevor du anfängst

  • Du hast noch nie etwas außerhalb deines eigenen Rechners live gestellt

  • Du arbeitest lieber monatelang an einer sauberen Lösung, als nächste Woche eine zu haben, die funktioniert

Das Level, auf dem wir einstellen

Das ist eine Einstiegs- bis Mid-Level-Rolle, und wir meinen das ernst: Uns zählt, was du schon gebaut und live gestellt hast, nicht wie viele Jahre dahinterstehen. Du berichtest an den Head of Growth.

Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher sowie Englisch auf C1-Niveau oder höher setzen wir voraus – unser Markt ist deutsch, unsere Teamsprache englisch.

Gehalt
65.000 bis 100.000 € je nach Erfahrung, dazu Stock Options.

Drei Runden: ein erstes Kennenlernen, eine Arbeitssession mit einer kleinen Aufgabe und eine letzte Runde mit den Gründer:innen. Ein Termin findet in Berlin persönlich statt, und du hörst in jeder Stufe innerhalb einer Woche von uns, auch wenn die Antwort nein ist.

Warum mika

  • Du stellst selbst live. Kein Freigabeprozess, keine fremde Abteilung dazwischen – was du für richtig hältst, ist heute online.

  • Viel ungetestete Fläche. Fast alles, was man anfassen kann, ist noch nie angefasst worden, und es gibt ein Budget dahinter.

  • Zwei Welten statt einer. Du sitzt in Growth und arbeitest mit den Entwicklern – wer beides lernen will, findet hier wenige vergleichbare Stellen.

  • Alle KI-Lizenzen sind da, und ihre Nutzung ist Erwartung, nicht Duldung.

  • Die Arbeit zählt auch außerhalb des Büros. Jedes Stück Automatisierung heißt, dass kleine Unternehmen weniger Zeit und Geld für Papierkram ausgeben, den sie sich nie ausgesucht haben.

  • Berlin, hybrid, vollkommen flexible Arbeitszeiten bis auf das tägliche Standup.

Klingt nach dir?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei Dinge, mehr nicht:

  1. Etwas, das du gebaut und live gestellt hast – ein Link reicht. Sag kurz dazu, was daran von dir ist und womit du es gebaut hast.

  2. Eine Sache, die du an unserer Website ändern würdest, nachdem du zwanzig Minuten daraufgeschaut hast.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £70,000-£90,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

title: GTM Founder's Associate
descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We’re now on the hunt for a brilliant all-rounder who wants to make an enormous impact on Spruce’s growth trajectory as we add thousands of installers over the next 18 months. You’ll work on marketing, commercial strategy, RevOps, reporting & analytics, and generally anything that helps accelerate our growth.

This is not an easy job – but we can promise it’ll be incredibly stimulating & fulfilling, and you’ll struggle to find a lovelier, more engaged group of customers to work with (..and the team’s not bad either!).

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there’s a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on hundreds of installation businesses, merchants, utilities and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

As we drive the business towards the next fundraise, you’ll be working closely with Hector and our founder Jo getting stuck into pretty much everything that goes on across the growth side of business. No two days will be the same, but at minimum your work will include:

  • Running growth experiments – setting up and running our full set of growth/marketing tests, quickly binning things that don’t work, and iterating quickly on everything to find our growth levers.

  • Creating & managing ads, creative, and content – top and middle-funnel marketing content, videos, customer testimonials, short form copy for our website, socials, ads, and nurturing emails, and onboarding guides for new customers.

  • Supporting sales & customer success – building the systems that allow our commercial teams to scale hyper-efficiently and deliver exponentially more value per hour of work they do.

  • Data analysis & reporting – digging into how our customers are using the platform, breaking down conversion rates through our marketing and sales pipelines, spotting areas we can improve, and coming up with suggestions for when and how we should change tack.

🫵 About You

You’ll have somewhere between 1 and 6 years work experience (doesn’t matter if it’s not directly related to this role) and you’ll ideally be:

  • Relentlessly proactive — you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get sh*t done;

  • A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply;

  • Highly analytical — you have a real affinity for numbers, love diving into data, and are comfortable working in Excel;

  • A natural “people person” — you love working with people, find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease;

  • An AI whizz – you’re way ahead of the average person with your LLM usage, have built interesting/cool things in your spare time, and are deeply conscious of all the things that are possible that you haven’t had a chance to try yet;

… and you’ll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 Base salary £50-70k, with quarterly bonus aligned to company targets

  • 🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

  • 🌍 Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world.

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

title: Head of Clinical Operations
descriptionHtml:
🏨 About the company

Resilience Care is a leading provider of remote patient monitoring and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is to improve care.

We provide remote patient monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining electronic patient-reported outcomes (ePROs) with AI techniques. Our solutions include a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals, enabling the early detection of side effects and continuous, proactive care, as well as a mobile app that helps patients track and manage their symptoms through tailored resources.

Our solutions help optimise care, deepen our understanding of patients throughout their care journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. They are currently used in routine care by 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as in around 20 academic and industry-sponsored clinical studies.

We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition of helping every patient benefit from personalised medicine.

📝 Your role

In a nutshell

You will lead all of Resilience’s clinical operations: Resilience-sponsored randomised controlled trials (RCTs), investigator-initiated studies (ISRs), real-world evidence (RWE) projects and studies conducted for industry partners. You will report directly to the Chief Medical Officer, manage a team of five to six people, including CTMs and Senior CTMs, and step in operationally on projects when backup is needed.

Your impact

You will ensure that every study is delivered on time, within budget and to the expected quality standards, while keeping the team’s workload manageable. You will give the medical leadership team a reliable overview of the study portfolio—including timelines, budgets and the risk register—and prepare clinical operations to support a growing number of industry partners.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Role Description

Own creative direction for Allica Bank across brand, design, motion, video, copy and web, leading a multi-disciplinary studio team that serves both brand & marketing work and the high-volume production needs of Growth & Digital Acquisition. Balance hands-on craft leadership with production efficiency at scale, and drive AI adoption across the studio to meet growth's velocity requirements without compromising brand or compliance standards.

Principal Accountabilities

Creative direction & craft

Team & production management

Production capacity & growth support

Brand

title: Head of People
descriptionHtml:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

About the Role

As our Head of People, you’ll own everything related to our growing workforce (65 people today). Compensation, leveling, performance, org design: most of it exists today and yours, and it’s yours to upgrade to make sure it remains best-in-class as we scale. You’ll lead a lean team across Talent Acquisition and Talent Development (2 people for now), work directly with the CEO and Head of Ops, and have a real say in how ScorePlay scales internationally.

It’s also a rare chance to answer a question most People leaders are only starting to ask: what does a high-performing company look like when AI changes roles, team sizes and what we hire for?

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll design the frameworks yourself, make decisions with data and ship them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organizational design & workforce planning: Design organizational structure, spans, team composition, and headcount plans as we scale, including how AI changes roles, team sizes, and what we hire for.

  • Performance, leveling & talent management: Build consistent leveling and performance frameworks across functions. Oversee performance cycles and calibration, and own talent reviews, succession planning, and the resolution of legacy leveling inconsistencies.

  • Compensation, equity & benefits: Build competitive, internally consistent compensation bands, equity frameworks, and regional benefits. Own compensation benchmarking, offer governance, and compensation cost discipline, with particular attention to US-market competitiveness.

  • Hiring strategy & talent standards: Define hiring priorities, workforce needs, and senior hiring, and set a consistently high talent bar, including AI fluency.

  • High-performer retention & growth: Identify and retain top talent, build meaningful career paths, and own succession and development plans. Monitor regretted attrition and address systemic retention risks.

  • Manager effectiveness: Equip managers to hire, develop, evaluate, and retain strong teams. Set practical management standards and oversee manager development, with clear accountability for performance and people decisions.

  • Culture & organizational health: Maintain a cohesive, high-performance culture across regions and hybrid teams. Identify and address organizational friction, engagement risks, and gaps in accountability or collaboration.

  • People analytics & governance: Define clear People KPIs, review cadence, and decision frameworks. Lead strategic employment-structure decisions, including entity/EOR considerations, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

  • People function leadership: Lead and develop the People team, ensuring strong execution of recruiting, employee lifecycle, employee relations, compliance, and HR operations through the team and appropriate external experts.

Qualifications

  • Experience building People programs in high-growth tech companies, ideally with 8+ years of progressive experience across People Operations, People Strategy, HRBP, or related roles.

  • Proven ability to design and implement People frameworks, in at least two of the following areas: compensation and job leveling, performance management and calibration, talent development, or organizational design.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to use data to diagnose organizational problems, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations that balance employee experience, performance, and financial discipline.

  • A first managerial experience required, having led and developed at least a small People or HR team.

  • Comfort operating hands-on in a lean, fast-moving organization, building practical first versions of processes and systems rather than relying on large teams or extensive external support.

Why ScorePlay?

  • Join at a pivotal moment: the V1s are live and working well, and now we’re building the next version together as we scale fast

  • A global People agenda: teams in Paris, New York and across Europe, with US and European comp, employment and culture questions on your desk.

  • Real influence: you’ll work with the CEO and Head of Ops and bring People expertise into the decisions that shape the company.

  • A high bar: the goal is to have the best possible person in every seat, and you set the standard for what that means.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.
