309 - Lead Architect, Data & AI Platforms – Choreograph Consulting

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

About Choreograph: A Leading WPP Media Brand

Choreograph is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

Role Summary and Impact

We are hiring a Lead Architect to own the technical design of Azure-first data and AI platforms. You will define the reusable patterns, reference architectures and end-to-end solution concepts that our delivery teams build from, and prove them in code rather than in slideware.

This is an engineering-first, developer-architect role: roughly 70–80% designing solutions, building and packaging reusable patterns, and prototyping new concepts in code, and 20–30% client-facing advisory.

As a senior technical authority, you will bridge client strategy with hands-on code, setting the reference architecture and proving it yourself, then partnering with the Data Engineering, Platform/DevOps, Security and Client Delivery teams who industrialise it into resilient, self-service, cost-effective and compliant delivery at scale. Replacing traditional IT operations and manual governance with modern software automation, you will mentor engineers, review code/IaC, and own key technical decisions and trade-offs.

What this role is not: This is not an IT infrastructure, cloud operations or estate-management position. There is no BAU support rota, ticket queue, or manual portal configuration. Candidates whose recent experience is running and supporting cloud infrastructure, rather than designing and building data and AI platforms in code, will not be a fit. Equally, this is not a hands-off design role: you will prototype and prove your own patterns before a delivery team scales them.

Area of expertise:

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) & Automation: Production fluency with Terraform; treating IaC like software code using modular designs, policy-as-code, reusable baselines, and automated testing via CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps).
  • Solution Architecture Pattern Design & Packaging: Defining end-to-end solution concepts and reference architectures, then packaging them as deployable, versioned assets that other teams can pick up and run, rather than as documents.
  • Azure-First Data Platforms: Deep architecture and build experience on Microsoft Azure (Data Lake/Lakehouse patterns, ADLS Gen2, Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake), with enough hands-on AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience to design portable patterns for mixed client estates.
  • Orchestration & Data Pipelines: Batch and streaming ingestion using Azure Data Factory (pipelines, wrangling flows, integration runtimes), Event Hubs, Kafka, and performance optimization (Spark/Synapse SQL).
  • AI Solution Design & Build: Designing and building AI solutions on the data platform: Agentic AI workflows, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns, vector search and LLM orchestration, alongside standard analytical workloads.
  • Security as Code: Networking, private endpoints, managed identities, Key Vault, RBAC, Purview governance and data masking, all defined in Terraform and versioned like application code.
  • Observability, FinOps & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, cost/performance telemetry, SLAs/SLOs for pipelines, and FinOps-aware cloud design.
  • API & Service Integration: Designing data services using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and API Management.

Skills and Experience:

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.
  • Developer-Architect Mindset: A hands-on builder who sets reference architectures and patterns, leading by example through direct code contributions and rigorous code/IaC reviews.
  • 70/30 Design-to-Advise Split: Spends 70–80% of the time architecting solutions, writing code, packaging repeatable patterns and prototyping new concepts, drawing on end-to-end understanding of the data platform in use, and 20–30% in front of clients, translating commercial objectives into technical roadmaps and explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in their own language.
  • Coding & Automation Obsession: Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, SQL, Terraform); automates everything possible via IaC and CI/CD, favoring repeatability over legacy IT ticket processes.
  • Azure-Deep, Cross-Cloud Aware: Expert on Azure and comfortable across AWS and GCP, designing for operability, security, and cost while preparing platforms for emerging AI architectures.
  • Clear Communicator & Mentor: Able to facilitate client workshops, write concise design docs/runbooks, align cross-functional teams, and mentor engineers to create shared ownership of outcomes.
  • Outcome-Focused: Measures success with deployment frequency, lead time for changes, data pipeline SLAs, cost efficiency, and platform reliability metrics.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure-First Platform Architecture: Architect and implement Azure data platforms for clients, including landing zones, networking, identity, and data platform services (Azure Data Lake Storage, Synapse, Databricks), extending patterns to AWS or GCP where a client estate requires it.
  • Design & Build Data Pipelines: Design, Implement key data ingress patterns across data platforms. Key focus would be Azure Data Factory pipelines and data flows for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration; establish patterns for parameterization, retries, and error handling to meet pipeline SLAs, then work with the Data Engineering team to scale those patterns into production delivery.
  • Implement Modern IaC & CI/CD: Design, implement key IaC patterns. Deliver infrastructure-as-code using Terraform; create reusable modules and policy-as-code guardrails. Establish repo strategies, branching, pull requests, multi-stage pipelines, approvals, and automated promotion gates.
  • Package Reusable Solutions: Turn proven designs into packaged, deployable assets (Terraform modules, pipeline templates, reference implementations and accelerators) with the documentation and worked examples delivery teams need to reuse them across clients.
  • Architect for AI & DataOps: Introduce DataOps practices (automated unit/integration testing, data quality checks) and build the AI layer on top of it: vector search, RAG workflows and agentic capabilities.
  • Prototype & Showcase New Concepts: Build working prototypes of new data and AI concepts (RAG, agentic workflows, streaming and real-time patterns) and demonstrate them to clients to shape demand, test feasibility and de-risk delivery before a full team is committed.
  • Client Advisory & Technical Leadership: Own the technical relationship with client and agency stakeholders. Run discovery and design workshops, present at design authorities, and translate commercial objectives into phased roadmaps, costs and trade-offs that a non-technical audience can act on.
  • Ship Secure-by-Default Controls: Codify private endpoints, managed identities, Key Vault-backed secrets, RBAC, network isolation, data encryption and Purview cataloging/lineage as reusable modules, so security ships with the platform rather than being applied afterwards.
  • Optimize Performance & Cost (FinOps): Optimize compute and storage across Spark clusters, autoscaling, partitioning, and serverless options; track, report, and drive cloud cost savings.
  • Observability & Reliability: Build monitoring into pipelines and platforms using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and define the SLOs and alerting the owning engineering team runs against.
  • Guide Event-Driven Architectures: Lead streaming and micro-batch patterns (Event Hubs, Kafka on Azure, Structured Streaming) where required by client use cases.
  • Enable the Data Engineering Team: Mentor engineers, review pull requests/IaC, and hand over patterns and accelerators in a state the Data Engineering team can run with, so larger builds are delivered by the team rather than bottlenecked on you.

Requirements:

  • Hands-on Developer-Architect experience: Proven track record in cloud platform and data engineering, with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and hands-on exposure to AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Production IaC Fluency: Strong proficiency in Terraform applied with a software engineering mindset (reusable modules, testing, modular code structures).
  • Data Platform Core: Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, and Azure Databricks (Spark).
  • CI/CD Mastery: Strong CI/CD experience using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps for both IaC and data workloads.
  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Solid coding capability in Python and SQL; performance tuning for Spark/Databricks; data modelling for analytical and AI workloads.
  • Evidence of Shipped Work: Able to walk through data platform code, Terraform modules or pipelines you have personally authored. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to talk through their own code and design decisions at interview.
  • Patterns Adopted by Others: Examples of reference architectures, reusable modules or accelerators you have designed, packaged and had adopted by teams other than your own.
  • Client-Facing Advisory Skills: Demonstrated ability to consult directly with senior client and agency stakeholders, including non-technical business audiences, present pragmatic technical solutions, and lead architectural workshops unaided. You will be the technical voice in the room, not supported by a separate engagement lead.
  • Security as Code: Ability to implement VNets, private endpoints, managed identities, Key Vault, RBAC and governance patterns as Terraform, rather than through portal configuration or change-request processes.

Nice to have:

  • Production experience shipping RAG or agentic AI workloads to live users (vector databases, LLM orchestration frameworks).
  • Event-driven architectures with Event Hubs, Kafka, Stream Analytics, or Functions; CDC patterns.
  • Lakehouse/Delta patterns on Databricks; MLflow and feature store awareness.
  • Data quality tooling and frameworks (Great Expectations, Deequ) and dbt for transformation governance.
  • Data Governance: Experience tracking data lineage, defining data quality policies and procedures, and enforcing them at runtime.
  • API Management, Logic Apps, or Azure Functions integration experience.
  • Experience with Azure Enterprise-Scale Landing Zones and Azure Policy.
  • Relevant certifications: Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or AWS / GCP equivalents. Certifications are welcome but are weighted below demonstrable evidence of shipped code.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing regional Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team that accelerates enterprise customer adoption by turning high-impact automation use cases into production-ready workflows. You'll own technical delivery quality, team development, and regional execution, while staying hands-on and empowering customers to become independent, successful builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

Build & Lead a High-Performing FDE Team

  • Hire, onboard, and coach Forward Deployed Engineers across your region, partnering closely with Deployment Strategists to deliver high-impact customer engagements.

  • Set and maintain a high technical quality bar for production workflows, custom nodes, integration architectures, and customer-facing delivery.

  • Manage regional team capacity, workload, and staffing while staying hands-on with customer engagements and supporting your team's technical development.

Own Regional Delivery & Customer Outcomes

  • Lead regional engagement intake and prioritization with Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships, focusing resources on high-value accounts, strategic adoption opportunities, and at-risk renewals.

  • Qualify and scope customer engagements, selecting the right mix of internal FDEs and delivery partners while ensuring clear success criteria, technical ownership, and timelines.

  • Drive measurable customer outcomes through production-ready workflows, increased adoption, and seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers, while reporting regional results and expansion signals to leadership.

Enable Customers & Scale Technical Excellence

  • Champion a customer-first delivery approach where customers build alongside FDEs, develop technical confidence, and become capable of maintaining and scaling their own automations.

  • Create and continuously improve reusable technical assets, including workflow templates, reference architectures, workshop materials, and hackathon playbooks.

  • Capture learnings from customer engagements and turn them into scalable best practices that improve delivery quality and consistency across the global FDE team.

Drive Partner Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with regional partner managers and the Partner Delivery Manager to ensure partner-led engagements meet n8n's technical and delivery standards.

  • Support partner technical readiness, certification, and quality reviews to build a reliable regional ecosystem of delivery resources.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback, integration gaps, feature requests, and custom node needs into actionable priorities, balancing reusable product improvements with customer-specific solutions.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical Customer-Facing Experience: You have 6+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, or technical consulting within a software company.

  • 🌟 Technical Leadership: You have 2+ years of experience leading and coaching technical teams, with a track record of developing talent and raising the bar for customer-facing technical delivery.

  • ⚡ Automation & Integration Expertise: You have hands-on experience with workflow automation, integration platforms, or low-code tools and can confidently design and troubleshoot complex automation solutions.

  • 🏗️ Enterprise Technical Delivery: You're experienced in building production-ready workflows and integrations, with a strong understanding of APIs, authentication, data handling, security, and enterprise architecture considerations.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional Collaboration: You're comfortable working across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Partnerships to align priorities, manage expectations, and make thoughtful trade-offs.

  • 🎯 Customer Outcome Mindset: You know how to balance technical excellence with business impact, identify high-value use cases, and empower customers to become self-sufficient rather than dependent on ongoing services.

  • 🚀 Player-Coach Mentality: You enjoy staying close to the technology and customer challenges while building a high-performing team, creating repeatable processes, and scaling delivery in a fast-moving environment.

  • 🌍 Regional Availability: You're based in the relevant region (EMEA or North America) and comfortable traveling to customer sites when needed.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 n8n Expertise: You're familiar with n8n or similar workflow automation and low-code platforms, ideally with experience building complex production workflows.

  • 🤝 Partner Ecosystems: You have experience working with systems integrators, technical consulting partners, or external delivery teams to deliver enterprise customer engagements.

  • 🌱 0-to-1 Team Building: You've helped establish or scale a regional technical delivery team, including hiring, defining processes, and building a strong team culture from the ground up.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape a regional Forward Deployed Engineering team at a pivotal moment in our enterprise growth journey. You won't just lead engineers — you'll help define how we deliver technical excellence, accelerate customer adoption, and turn ambitious automation ideas into real business outcomes.

You'll combine hands-on technical work with people leadership, working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to influence how we scale customer delivery across your region. Your work will directly contribute to getting more workflows into production, helping customers become independent builders, and creating scalable technical practices that benefit our global FDE organization.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups and a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Lead Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes. - Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel. - Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu. - Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet. - Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes. -Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo. - Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

  • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
  • Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
  • Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
  • Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
  • Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.
  • You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.
  • Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.
  • Nice to haves: 
    • hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch
    • knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.


What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

title: Lead Talent Partner - Product and Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

Orbital is entering a major scaling chapter, and Product Engineering + Design Engineering are at the heart of it. This is a low-volume, high-calibre role. Success looks like building a market-leading attraction engine and a repeatable hiring system that consistently delivers bar-raising hires, primarily in the UK (with occasional US roles).

The role, in a nutshell

You’ll be the CTO’s partner for Product & Design Engineering hiring — owning the strategy, the operating rhythm, and the market-facing plan that enables Orbital to repeatedly win top talent.

At Orbital, these roles are typically:

  • Product Engineers: product-minded full‑stack engineers who ship end-to-end customer value.

  • Design Engineers: frontend/UI engineers operating at the intersection of design and engineering, with high craft.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, senior Product/Engineering/Design leaders, and a marketing specialist to build the narrative, content and materials that help Orbital stand out — and convert the best people over time.

What you’ll do

1) Own the Product & Design Engineering hiring strategy (CTO partnership)

2) Build a market-leading attraction engine (content + community + creative search)

  • Design and run a high-touch, always-on engagement and nurture engine for top Product & Design Engineering talent (not tied only to live reqs).

  • Partner with leadership and marketing to create standout content and outreach materials (positioning, sequences, technical narratives, proof points, community activity).

  • Establish targets (set with the CTO) and report on pipeline health and learning loops:

    • warm pipeline size by discipline/level

    • engagement rates (reply / meeting booked)

    • nurture → active candidate → offer → accept conversion

    • competitive intel and drop-off reasons

3) Deliver hiring outcomes (low volume, very high calibre)

  • Personally own the most senior and business-critical Product Engineering hires (e.g., Staff/Principal/Lead level and key leadership roles).

  • Protect the quality bar for assessment, references, and offer calibration; step in on escalations and closing.

  • Set the operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for (must-haves)

  • Scale-up experience: proven track record hiring in a high-growth tech scaleup with high standards and ambiguity.

  • Deep Product & Design Engineering market immersion: credible, active network in the UK. Ideally you have run meetups and build communities. You know who the standout people are and what motivates them.

  • Exec-search level craft: evidence of closing low-volume, very high-calibre engineers via creative, non-standard routes (not just inbound + job boards or Linkedin).

  • Attraction + nurture strategy: you’ve built always-on engagement motions that convert exceptional people over time (content, community, referrals, targeted events, high-touch outreach).

  • CTO partnership: you’ve partnered closely with technical leadership to define quality, design assessment, and calibrate the bar.

  • Strong written narrative and messaging: you can translate a technical story into compelling outreach/materials (and collaborate well with marketing).

  • Data-informed judgement: you use metrics as feedback loops for quality and funnel health — and can clearly explain what you track and why.

What this role is not (important)

  • Not high-volume recruiting — this is low volume, bar-raising hiring.

  • Not a “maintain the process” job — you’ll build and continuously improve the attraction engine and operating model.

  • Not fully remote — hiring is UK-first and roles are hybrid.

Working model & location

  • Location: London, UK 2-3 days a week.

  • Working model: Hybrid (all roles)

We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Leitung Kommunikation / Öffentlichkeitsarbeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Das Unternehmen:

Strategie gestalten. Menschen erreichen. Kommunikation weiterentwickeln.

Unser Auftraggeber ist ein etabliertes, regional stark verwurzeltes mittelständisches Finanzinstitut mit hoher gesellschaftlicher Verantwortung und einer engen Verbindung zu den Menschen und Unternehmen in der Oberpfalz. Als bedeutender Finanzdienstleister engagiert sich das Unternehmen nicht nur für seine Kundinnen und Kunden, sondern auch für das gesellschaftliche, kulturelle und sportliche Leben vor Ort.

Im Zuge einer strategischen Weiterentwicklung soll insbesondere die Kommunikation moderner, digitaler und zielgruppenorientierter aufgestellt werden. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die klassische Öffentlichkeitsarbeit mit zeitgemäßer Kommunikation verbindet und neue Impulse setzt.

Die Stelle:

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position übernimmst Du die Leitung des Bereichs Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die interne und externe Kommunikation strategisch weiter.

Strategische Kommunikation: Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Maßnahmen auf die übergeordneten Unternehmens- und Geschäftsziele einzahlen.

Vorstandskommunikation: Du berätst den Vorstand bei kommunikativen Fragestellungen, bewertest Themen und Botschaften und entwickelst passende Kommunikationsansätze. Dabei hast Du auch die interne Kommunikation und die Stimmung innerhalb der Organisation im Blick.

PR & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit: Du verantwortest die externe Kommunikation, pflegst die Beziehungen zu regionalen Medien und steuerst auch anspruchsvolle Kommunikationssituationen – beispielsweise bei Veränderungsprozessen, Krisen oder öffentlich sensiblen Themen.

Führung & Teamentwicklung: Du führst ein sechsköpfiges Team mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen Hintergründen, förderst die Zusammenarbeit und entwickelst Kompetenzen und Strukturen weiter.

Digitale Kommunikation: Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Kommunikation voran. Insbesondere Social Media und die Ansprache jüngerer Zielgruppen sollen künftig einen noch höheren Stellenwert erhalten. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf der strategischen Ausrichtung und Steuerung.

Gesellschaftliches Engagement: Du begleitest die strategische Ausrichtung des regionalen Spenden- und Sponsoringengagements und wirkst bei der Verteilung eines Budgets von rund 1,5 Millionen Euro mit.

Vertriebsunterstützung: Du entwickelst Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und Kampagnen, die insbesondere die Gewinnung junger Kundinnen und Kunden unterstützen und darüber hinaus das Firmenkundengeschäft sowie das Private Banking stärken.

Besondere Kommunikationsthemen: Du steuerst das Beschwerdemanagement bei eskalierten oder öffentlich sensiblen Fällen und begleitest die regionale Kunstsammlung gemeinsam mit der zuständigen Kuratorin.

Du arbeitest überwiegend strategisch und steuernd. Für die operative Umsetzung steht Dir ein erfahrenes Team zur Seite. Gleichzeitig hast Du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausrichtung und Organisation der Kommunikation aktiv mitzugestalten.

Qualifikation:

Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit, die strategisch denkt, Menschen begeistert und klassische PR ebenso versteht wie moderne digitale Kommunikationsformate. Du hast Freude daran, unterschiedliche Themen zusammenzuführen und Kommunikation als wichtigen Erfolgsfaktor eines Unternehmens zu etablieren.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Berufserfahrung in PR, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, Unternehmenskommunikation und/oder Marketing
  • Erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung – idealerweise sowohl fachlich als auch disziplinarisch
  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Social Media, digitale Kommunikationskanäle und insbesondere die Ansprache jüngerer Zielgruppen
  • Strategisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, Kommunikationskonzepte zu entwickeln und zukunftsorientiert weiterzuentwickeln
  • Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Textkompetenz sowie ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und anspruchsvolle Kommunikationssituationen
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Führungskräften und idealerweise im Umgang mit Vorständen oder Geschäftsführungen
  • Eine breite kommunikative Aufstellung: Du verbindest klassische Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit mit moderner Unternehmens- und digitaler Kommunikation
  • Eine offene, verbindliche und souveräne Persönlichkeit, die unterschiedliche Menschen und Kompetenzen zusammenbringt
  • Was uns besonders wichtig ist: Wir suchen keinen klassischen Pressesprecher und auch keinen reinen Social-Media-Spezialisten, sondern einen vielseitigen Kommunikationsprofi mit Führungskompetenz, strategischem Blick und einem guten Gespür für gesellschaftliche und digitale Entwicklungen
  • Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Deine fachliche Kompetenz, Deine Persönlichkeit und Deine Bereitschaft, neue Perspektiven einzubringen

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition mit direkter Nähe zum Vorstand und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein engagiertes, fachlich vielseitiges Team mit sechs Mitarbeitenden und unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen
  • Die Chance, die Kommunikationsstrategie eines etablierten Unternehmens maßgeblich zu prägen und moderne Kommunikationsformate weiter auszubauen
  • Ein Vorstand, der die Weiterentwicklung der Kommunikation aktiv unterstützt und insbesondere in den Bereichen Social Media und digitale Kommunikation investieren möchte
  • Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit leistungs- und erfolgsorientierten variablen Bestandteilen sowie einer zusätzlichen Sonderzahlung
  • Eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • 32 Tage Urlaub, ab 2027 sogar 33 Tage, sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 39-Stunden-Woche mit transparenter Arbeitszeiterfassung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein Mitarbeiterrestaurant und verschiedene Betriebssportangebote

Dein Arbeitsmodell:

Für diese Führungsposition ist eine regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort gewünscht – grundsätzlich an vier Tagen pro Woche. Gerade in den ersten sechs Monaten steht die persönliche Vernetzung und ein umfassendes Onboarding im Mittelpunkt. Flexible Arbeitszeiten zwischen 7 und 20 Uhr sowie eine transparente Erfassung und Steuerung von Überstunden gehören selbstverständlich dazu.

Interesse geweckt?

Du möchtest Kommunikation nicht nur verantworten, sondern aktiv verändern und weiterentwickeln? Du hast Freude daran, strategische Themen mit einem starken Team umzusetzen und neue kommunikative Wege zu gehen?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb Dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam über Deine nächsten Karriereschritte sprechen.

title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role
The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Localization Operations Manager (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We're looking for a Localization Operations Manager to audit and redesign how we conduct translation and localization end to end; from content creation, through engineering delivery, to linguistic quality review. You will challenge our current tooling and AI/MT workflows, content ownership and governance models, integrate AI software development best practices, and leave behind a better process and toolset for multiple language markets, not just one.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Audit the current end-to-end localization and translation workflow for our three main markets, from source content definition through engineering execution to linguistic QA, defining and implementing improvements for an updated localization process. 

  • Evaluate and evolve our use of machine translation and AI-assisted translation tooling, including glossary ownership and governance, content classification, and where and how human review fits in.

  • Define a vendor and tooling strategy for translation and linguistic quality a cross our language markets; updating our existing tool stack as needed. 

  • Design and roll-out evolved processes in partnership with engineering, design, product, medical, and local go-to-market teams

  • Hand off a durable process and toolset by the end of the engagement.

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Prior experience as a Technical Program Manager, Product Manager, or Localization Operations Manager, with hands-on experience designing and implementing localization/internationalization tooling and MT/AI-assisted translation workflows.

  • Strong proficiency in AI-native workflows as they relate to software development and content management. Can build tooling solutions, agents, and technical solutions where needed. 

  • Experience with multi-market, multi-language products at scale. Italian, French or German localization experience is a plus.

  • Track record of shipping quality, speed, or cost improvements to a localization or translation operation.

  • Strong stakeholder management across design, engineering, and content teams.

  • Comfortable working independently on a fixed-term, outcome-driven engagement.

  • Professional working proficiency in English; fluency in Italian is a plus. 

Our interview process

  • Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour)

  • Case Study & Restitution

  • Behavioral Interview (1h30)

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Short term position

  • 9 months

  • Paris or Berlin, France

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Memory
descriptionHtml:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

  • Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
  • Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
  • Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

  • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
    • Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
    • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
  • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits except for PMI (for dependents). Our current benefits package includes pension, private medical insurance, health care cash plan, dental insurance, disability and life insurance, critical illness, cycle to work scheme, flu shots, health checks, and meals. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.                         

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: Machine Learning Researcher
descriptionHtml:
About the position

We’re looking for smart and curious individuals from industry and academia to join our growing team and drive our ML work.

On our Machine Learning team, you'll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges— large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques. 

Researchers, engineers and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems and run trading strategies. Depending on the day, we might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging distributed training performance or studying how our model likes to trade in production.

We’ll rely on your in-depth knowledge of the machine learning landscape and understanding of a variety of approaches—drawn from LLMs, image models, RL agents, recommendation systems or classical ML methods—to shape the future of ML at Jane Street. You’ll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. You’ll also be hiring new colleagues, attending conferences and teaching techniques to teammates—all of which we consider to be real and impactful parts of the job.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. descriptionHtml:

Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.

By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.

Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch.

Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.

Please review our Hugging Face and GitHub repos before applying, as they’ll be part of the interview discussion.


Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help advance the state of the art in speech synthesis.

You will work on research and development across the full speech pipeline — from model architecture and training to dataset design and production deployment. The role combines applied research with real-world engineering, working closely with a small team pushing the boundaries of real-time speech systems.

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in text-to-speech systems, or multimodal machine learning involving speech and audio.

Your work will include:

title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités :

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.
  • Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.
  • Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.
  • Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.
  • Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.
  • Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.
  • Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.
  • Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.
  2. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.
  3. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.
  4. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.
  5. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.
  6. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.
  7. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.
  • Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.
  • Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.
  • Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.
  • Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.
  • Une certification d’architecture cloud.
  • Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Architecture Case  (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

The role:   We are looking for a Manager who leads strategy and architecture projects focused on GenAI solutions. You will own the design of architectures and solutions end to end, balancing business value, technology choices and economics across every dimension of the decision. You will lead development teams, present solutions to C-level stakeholders and run technical and strategic workshops independently.   Key responsibilities: Project and programme leadership
  • Lead strategy and architecture projects on GenAI, from scoping and business case through to solution design and rollout oversight.
  • Own project plans, budgets, risks and quality, ensuring delivery against client objectives.
  • Shape proposals, estimates and demos, and identify follow-on opportunities with clients.
GenAI architecture and solution design
  • Design GenAI architectures and solutions: RAG, agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, MCP and A2A integration, copilots and assistants.
  • Select and combine cloud-native AI services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks) with third-party and custom components.
  • Apply GenAI to support functions such as HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, redesigning processes and operating models around the new solutions.
Cross-dimension optimization and trade-offs
  • Orchestrate decisions across make, buy and customization options, weighing capex against opex and total cost of ownership.
  • Assess the impact of tool and architecture choices on vendor lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Translate these trade-offs into clear recommendations that business and IT leaders can act on.
Team and stakeholder leadership
  • Guide development teams technically: set the architecture, review solutions and unblock delivery.
  • Present solutions and recommendations to C-level audiences.
  • Run technical and strategic workshops independently, from discovery to design and prioritization.
  • Coach and develop consultants and architects in the team.
Requirements:
  • At least 8 years of professional experience in IT.
  • At least 3 years on AI/GenAI architecture and solution design projects.
  • Prior hands-on background as an engineer or developer.
  • Proven experience applying GenAI to support functions (HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance or IT).
  • Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.
  • Track record of managing projects and leading teams, including development teams.
  • Experience presenting to C-level stakeholders and running workshops independently.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
Technical and functional skills:
  • GenAI architectures: RAG, agentic and multi-agent patterns, LLMOps, model evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.
  • Agent protocols and copilots: MCP, A2A, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, custom assistants and their integration with enterprise systems.
  • Cloud AI platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks and the native data and AI services of Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Architecture trade-offs: make vs buy vs customize, capex vs opex, TCO, lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Support functions: processes and operating models in HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, and how GenAI changes them.
  • Delivery leadership: agile methods, technical team guidance, solution review, programme governance.
  • Business: business cases, value tracking, and the ability to translate technical choices into economic impact for executives.
Nice to have:
  • German not strictly required.
  • Cloud or AI certifications (e.g. Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning).
What we offer
  • A leadership role bridging strategy, architecture and GenAI delivery, with direct impact on client decisions.
  • International projects on GenAI, agentic systems and support function transformation.
  • A growth path towards senior programme and practice leadership roles.
  • Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.
  • Highly competitive compensation package.

This position is based in Zürich.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution.

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.

MISSION

  • Je helpt bij het creëren van nieuw POS-materiaal, zoals banners, flyers, etc;

YOU

  • Jij volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau;

  • Je draait volledig mee in het team en doet praktijkervaring op. (Geen afstudeerstage!);

  • Beheersing van Nederlands is een must (!). Engels is een pré;

  • Jij begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn;

  • Jij gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief;

  • Jij bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen;

  • Jij hebt ervaring met de programma’s Canva en Adobe;

  • Jij bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt);

  • Je bent 40 uur per week beschikbaar.


OUR OFFER

  • Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie;

  • Een duurzaamheidsbewuste werkgever;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving;

  • Collega's die investeren in jouw talent;

  • De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen;

  • De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers;

  • Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback;

  • Stagevergoeding van € 650,- bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime

  • En nooit meer een ‘bad hair day’ dankzij de personeelskortingen op de gehele KEUNE collectie!

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.

KEUNE

Wij zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap het hart van alles is wat we doen. Ons verhaal begon in 1922 in Amsterdam. Vandaag, meer dan 100 jaar later, is Keune een van de snelstgroeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden Keune-producten wereldwijd ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en gedistribueerd naar meer dan 90 landen. Met een sterke focus op duurzaamheid en diervriendelijke praktijken, zijn we B-Corp-gecertificeerd en blijven we uitbreiden door jaarlijks een nieuwe locatie te openen. Onder leiding van Philip Berlijn richten wij ons op het bouwen van een sterk merk, het bevorderen van samenwerking, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter in alles wat we doen.

HOME OF THE HAIR PRO
