descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Marketing Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact.

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients.

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London.

About the Role

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape.

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets.

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles.

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage.

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations.

What You Will Be Doing

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs.
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery.
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods.
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective.
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity.
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context.

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways.
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities.
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends.
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience.
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements.
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation.
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity.
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams.
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes.
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning.

What You Need to Be Great in This Role

Essential

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design.
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance.
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight.
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels.
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs.
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions.
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows.

Preferred:

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting.
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows.
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments.
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources.
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

title: Marketing Manager (12-18 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE BRAND TEAM

The Brand Team is responsible for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, performance and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and exploration.

THE ROLE

Plan and deliver integrated marketing that builds the Carwow brand and drives results, from big campaigns to always-on activity.

You’ll own campaigns from brief to results, working across brand and performance so everything we put out works hard at every stage of the funnel. You’ll brief and manage in-house creatives and agency partners, as well as working closely with performance, CRM and content teams. You’ll also use data to shape the work and prove its impact as part of a performance-focused Marketing team. Most of your focus will be the UK, with some work supporting our team in Spain.

This is a 12-month contract with real ownership. In that time you’ll establish test and learn plans across our marketing stack, run flagpole campaigns for new launches and leave behind ways of working that last beyond your time with us.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver integrated campaigns from brief to results, across brand and performance channels.

  • Drive innovation with pace using AI tools across the Marketing org; speeding up planning, briefing, reporting and campaign delivery, sharing what works with the wider team

  • Building relationships across the org to ensure adoption of systems and processes, including AI innovation

  • Write clear, insight-led briefs for creative, media and agency partners.

  • Manage agencies and production partners, keeping work on time, on budget and on brand.

  • Work with performance teams to improve existing test and learn plans and implement new processes where needed.

  • Partner and project manage cross-functionally with CRM, social, content and product teams to ensure campaigns and launches are joined up across every touchpoint.

  • Work with Brand Creative to bring campaigns to life and keep the brand consistent, briefing with clear insight and giving constructive feedback on the work.

  • Manage campaign budgets and keep spend accurately tracked.

  • Report on what worked and what didn’t, and use it to shape the next initiative.

  • Support our team in Spain to adapt campaigns for their market.

  • Find and test new ways of working, including AI, to plan and deliver faster.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years in marketing, in-house or agency, ideally at a consumer brand or scale-up.

  • A track record of integrated campaigns that delivered commercial results, across brand and performance.

  • Strong knowledge of ATL and digital channels, including TV, OOH, Meta, YouTube and paid search.

  • Experience briefing and managing creative and media agencies.

  • Comfortable with data: reading results, running tests and turning insight into action.

  • Confident managing budgets and tracking spend.

  • Hands-on use of AI in your marketing work, and a clear view on where it helps and where it doesn’t.

  • Strong stakeholder management, adapting your style for different teams and levels.

  • Able to get up to speed quickly and deliver from the start.

title: Marketing Operations
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Medical Director
descriptionHtml:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the operating system for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives.

The role

Lucis analyses 110+ biomarkers, builds personalised clinical protocols, and delivers them through an AI-powered preventive health product. We are live in France and opening the UK, Portugal and Spain.

This role exists to turn clinical judgement into the medical standards the company can run on.

We are hiring a Medical Director to own Lucis's clinical direction and medical safety system.

You will:

  • Decide what we test and why, and to what clinical standard the service runs

  • Set the risk posture and the governance model: who signs what, how incidents are handled, what Lucis can claim

  • Own the certification call and path: medical device classification, CE, ISO, or stay out of scope, and the argument behind it

  • Hire and lead the clinical operations and safety team.

  • Represent Lucis clinically with labs, insurers, institutional partners and regulators, alongside the CMO

  • Set the standards that product team should follow to make each release safe.

About you

You're passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast-moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve.

You'll fit in well if

  • Have an MD and roughly 5 to 10 years of hospital practice

  • Have led people and systems since, in healthtech, diagnostics, pharmaceutical company as medical affairs or CRO

  • Have held a quality or regulatory seat, and can carry a certification decision rather than hand it to a consultant

  • Can set a standards and orchestrate other doctors to execute your vision

  • Are fluent in French and English, spoken and written

  • Use AI in your daily work and can explain when it fails and what you do about it

We might not be a fit if

  • You want to focus primarily on traditional bedside practice

  • You prefer pure research or citation work without shipping clinical standards

  • You are a copywriter without real clinical practice

  • You need every process already defined before you contribute

  • You prioritise predictable nine-to-five work over mission intensity

Practical details

  • Format: Full-time preferred. Flexible for the right senior profile.

  • Location: Paris mostly

The process

  1. Introductory call (20 minutes)

  2. Technical interview (30–60 minutes) — clinical judgement, protocol/evidence thinking, writing sample or case

  4. Deep dive and team conversations in Paris

title: MLRO, UK

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are seeking an experienced and driven MLRO to lead the financial crime compliance programmes across Payward Ltd (PWL) and Payward Services Ltd (PSL), two FCA-regulated UK entities within the Kraken Group. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across all aspects of financial crime risk management. This includes maintaining a robust control framework, advising on risk treatment across products and clients, and overseeing the operation and continuous improvement of transaction monitoring and sanctions screening systems.

  

The opportunity

  • Coordinate internal assurance activity and support external audits and regulatory reviews of the financial crime framework

  • Deliver training and awareness programmes to ensure staff understand their financial crime responsibilities

  • Prepare regular reporting and MI for senior management, risk committees, and the board

  • Lead delivery of UK MLRO team monthly review of UK corporate clients

  • Review monthly compliance and AML MI in order to identify trends, issues and ensure appropriate mitigation / escalation to the Board where appropriate

  • Attend relevant Committee meetings and Board meetings, support Executive decision making, escalate AML program related issues

  • Lead on strategic AML framework initiatives/implementations (e.g. Travel Rule)

  • Horizon scanning - monitor regulatory developments and ensure timely updates to internal policies and procedures

  • Liaise with law enforcement and regulatory authorities as required:

    • Regular engagement with FCA supervisory team

    • PoC for NCA

    • Support LEAs with setting up accounts

  

What you bring

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF and financial crime compliance within a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep understanding of the UK Money Laundering Regulations, Proceeds of Crime Act, UK sanctions regime (OFSI), and relevant industry guidance (e.g. JMLSG)

  • Proven track record of operating or overseeing transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and customer due diligence systems

  • Skilled in translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable policy and operational controls

  • Confident communicator, able to influence senior stakeholders and represent the firm in external engagements

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and resilient — with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities

  

Nice to haves

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF and financial crime compliance within a regulated cryptoasset, e-money, or payments firm

Travel

title: Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified.

  • Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run.

  • Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results.

  • Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities.

  • Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team.

  • Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence.

  • Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness.

  • Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers.

  • Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following:


What we would love to see from you

  • Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns.

  • Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it.

  • Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).

  • Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics).

  • Experience with requirements management and traceability tools.

  • Structured, precise, and ownership-driven, with the ability to align multiple subsystem teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in flight software on spacecraft or launch vehicles.

  • Familiarity with NASA & ECSS standards for space software and verification.

  • Experience operating or setting up SIL, PIL, HIL and/or vehicle-in-the-loop facilities.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Operations Data & Automation Apprentice
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is the leading global marketplace dedicated to refurbished tech. We give electronic devices a second life by connecting customers with professional refurbishers, making more sustainable technology accessible to everyone.

Trade-in enables customers to sell their used devices, including smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles and more to professional refurbishers through Back Market. It is an important part of our circularity strategy: it helps customers recover value from their devices while giving Sellers access to the supply they need to grow their refurbished business.

Trade-in is currently operated across several markets, including 4 EU countries, the UK and the US, with further country and category expansion planned. Operations cover many different operational areas including logistics, fraud, CRM, customer care, payments, catalog and more.

 

Trade-in Operations is a transversal scope covering the entire Trade-in journey, including payments, customer care, CRM, catalog, pricing, seller operations, logistics, fraud & more.

Our mission is to make sure that customers and sellers experience a smooth, reliable and efficient Trade-in service. This means understanding how the service works end to end, getting hands-on with operational issues, managing incidents, finding solutions and continuously improving the way we work.

You will work close to the day-to-day operations, executing processes and understanding where problems really occur. The objective is then to use data, automation, AI and process improvement to make these operations simpler, faster and more scalable.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

1. Ensure smooth operations from day one

You will take ownership of operational processes and checks, making sure that important tasks are completed accurately and on time. This may include:

  • Maintaining the Trade-in Catalog and product matching

  • Monitoring pricing and identifying inconsistencies

  • Supporting Seller limit adjustments and Seller reactivation processes

  • Updating customer and agent-facing content

  • Supporting transactional CRM communications

  • Monitoring fraud-related processes

  • Investigating operational issues and coordinating incident resolution

These activities are essential to understanding the service and building the expertise needed to improve it.

2. Improve operations and create measurable impact

You will identify opportunities to improve, simplify and automate processes:

  • Analyse data to identify recurring issues and root causes

  • Build or improve reports, dashboards, alerts and monitoring

  • Simplify manual workflows and reduce unnecessary steps

  • Prototype automation using available tools, AI and workflow platforms

  • Improve incident detection and reduce resolution time

  • Track the impact of your improvements on incident rates, manual effort, customer satisfaction and seller experiences

  • Document processes and create reliable playbooks for the teams

  • Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of our AI chatbot for customer support

The goal is to turn recurring operational work into measurable improvements, not simply to execute tasks more efficiently.

3. Enable Trade-in to scale

Trade-in plans to open additional countries and categories while continuing to improve its performance. We cannot rely on increasing operational resources in proportion to the business.

You will help prepare the service for this growth by:

  • Standardising processes and making them easier to replicate

  • Designing scalable workflows and controls

  • Automating repetitive checks and actions

  • Making operational knowledge easier to share across markets

  • Helping ensure that new launches do not create an equivalent increase in manual work

Success in this role means helping Trade-in handle more volume, countries and categories with fewer incidents, faster resolution times, better customer and seller experiences, and less manual effort.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are hands-on, curious and solutions-oriented

  • You enjoy investigating problems and finding ways to make things work better

  • You are comfortable starting with operational execution to understand how things work and using it as a foundation for improvement

  • You are comfortable with spreadsheets and data extraction (SQL) and analysis

  • You are curious about processes, automation, AI and tools such as Braze (CRM), Intercom (Customer Care), Zapier and Workato (automation), Tableau and Omni (data visualization)

  • You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and verbally

  • You want to see the concrete impact of your work on a real, 360 business scope

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed).

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Video-call interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

  • Live business case/Skills Fit interview with a team member

  • Skills and cultural fit interview with the Hiring Manager

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1,250 – €1,450 per month

title: Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Partner Account Manager - France
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste

Ce poste de direction est essentiel : il consiste à construire et à faire passer à l’échelle les partenariats d’Anthropic avec les cabinets de conseil, les intégrateurs de systèmes mondiaux (GSI) et les boutiques partenaires nativement IA en France.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe commerciale pour que les clients adoptent l’IA grâce à nos partenaires.

Ce poste est un poste de construction, et non de gestion. Compte tenu du stade de développement d’Anthropic, nous recherchons un profil qui a déjà fait ses preuves en faisant passer des partenariats de zéro à des moteurs de revenus à grande échelle, un profil qui a bâti ces relations de A à Z, et non simplement hérité de relations existantes pour les gérer.

Responsabilités

  • Partenariats et exécution
    • Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l’équipe commerciale pour comprendre comment les partenaires peuvent soutenir l’adoption de Claude par les clients.
    • Vous accompagnerez les partenaires dans la création de solutions clients reproductibles, répondant à des cas d’usage précis dans de nombreux secteurs : services financiers, santé, distribution, industrie, secteur public et services professionnels.
  • Performance et pilotage des indicateurs clés (KPI)
    • Vous portez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance et vous les pilotez : revenus influencés par les partenaires, livraison réalisée par les partenaires, nombre de personnes consultantes formées et certifiées.
    • Chaque deal influencé par votre portefeuille de partenaires doit être conçu pour la réussite du client et la croissance de sa valeur à long terme. Vous définirez des critères de réussite pour les comptes communs, veillerez à la qualité de la mise en œuvre et de l’accompagnement à l’adoption, et mettrez en place des boucles de retour d’expérience favorisant l’amélioration continue.
    • Vous rendrez compte de la santé des partenariats, de leur avancement et de leurs résultats commerciaux, en vous appuyant sur des analyses fondées sur les données.
  • Développement du marché et construction de la marque
    • Vous renforcerez la notoriété de la marque Anthropic en France grâce à des relations stratégiques avec les partenaires.
    • Vous élaborerez et déploierez des stratégies de mise sur le marché (GTM) propres à chaque marché, adaptées aux pratiques commerciales et aux nuances culturelles locales.
    • Vous composerez avec les enjeux locaux de réglementation, de conformité et de souveraineté des données.
    • Vous créerez un avantage concurrentiel grâce aux capacités singulières des partenaires et à des propositions de valeur élaborées en commun.

Votre profil

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si vous réunissez les atouts suivants :

  • Vous avez l’esprit d’initiative et le goût de construire : vous êtes à l’aise pour partir de zéro et créer des partenariats d’envergure.
  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français.
  • Vous comptez au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats technologiques à destination des entreprises, idéalement dans le cloud, l’IA/ML ou les activités de plateforme.
  • Vous avez une culture de la donnée, tournée vers les résultats mesurables et l’atteinte des KPI, et un historique avéré de revenus additionnels générés grâce aux partenariats dans la région.
  • Vous avez démontré votre capacité à assurer la réussite des clients et la protection de la marque via les canaux partenaires.
  • Vous avez l’esprit de compétition : la victoire et la différenciation sont votre moteur.
  • Vous avez une approche collaborative et savez travailler de façon transversale avec les équipes commerciales, produit, marketing et régionales.
  • Vous nourrissez une vraie passion pour l’IA et vous vous reconnaissez dans la mission d’Anthropic : développer une IA bénéfique.

Relations de travail

Votre rattachement hiérarchique se fera auprès de la direction des partenariats internationaux, tandis que votre activité quotidienne sera pilotée par la personne responsable des partenariats EMEA Sud. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la direction commerciale régionale d’Anthropic et ses Account Executives, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Customer Success et Applied AI de la région.

Lieu et déplacements

Ce poste est basé à Paris, en France, avec des déplacements à prévoir pour rencontrer les partenaires et les clients.

About the Role

This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and scaling Anthropic's consulting, GSIs and AI-native boutique partners in France.
You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure customers are adopting AI through our partners.

This is a builder role, not a manager role. Given Anthropic's stage, we need someone who has proven they can take partnerships from zero to scaled revenue engines — someone who has built these relationships from the ground up, not just inherited and managed existing ones.

Responsibilities:

  • Partnerships and execution: 
    • You will engage closely with the sales team to understand how partners can support customer Claude adoption
    • You will guide partners in creating repeatable customer solutions that address specific use cases across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, public sector, and professional services.
  • Performance and KPI ownership:
    • Own and drive key performance indicators, partner-influenced revenue, partner delivery, consultants trained and certified
    • Every deal influenced through your partner portfolio must be architected for customer success and long-term value expansion. You will establish success criteria for joint accounts, ensure proper implementation and adoption support, and create feedback loops that drive continuous improvement.
    • Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights
  • Market Development & Brand Building
    • Amplify the Anthropic brand in France strategic partner relationships
    • Develop and execute market-specific GTM strategies adapted to local business practices and cultural nuances
    • Navigate local regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty considerations
    • Create competitive differentiation through unique partner capabilities and joint value propositions

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Builder mentality — comfortable starting from zero and creating scaled partnerships

Fluent in English and French

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology partnerships, ideally within cloud, AI/ML, or platform businesses
  • Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment. Track record of driving incremental revenues through partnerships in the region
  • History of delivering exceptional customer success and brand protection through partner channels
  • Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation
  • Collaborative approach with ability to work cross-functionally across sales, product, marketing, and regional teams
  • Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

Working Relationships

You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our South EMEA Partnerships lead. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Applied AI teams.

Location and Travel

This role will be based in Paris, France with travel expected to engage with partners and customers externally.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. People Experience Administrator (German-speaking) - People Operations

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom.

We’re looking for a People Experience Administrator

Keep the employee journey running smoothly for iwocans across the UK and Germany. You'll support payroll in both countries, run onboarding and offboarding, and be the first port of call for questions.

The team
The People Operations team's mission is to attract, develop and retain high performers who genuinely love being part of iwoca. The People Experience team handles the nuts and bolts of the entire employee journey, from onboarding and offboarding to background checks and visa paperwork. It looks after HR systems like BambooHR and Peakon, keeps policies up to date, and manages benefits and payroll. The team is the first point of contact for most People Operations questions.

The role

As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last.

Supporting payroll across our UK and German teams is a key part of the role, so you'll play a direct part in making sure every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

It's a broad, hands-on role at the heart of our People Operations team, with the flexibility to shape your days and hours around your life, so it suits anyone balancing work with other commitments. You'll own your work and be someone the team relies on.

In this role, you'll:

  • Own the day-to-day running of our UK and German benefits, and be the person iwocans come to when they have a question about them.

title: Physical Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings. We're moving towards real-world deployment, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Physical Verification Engineer to drive DRC/LVS signoff for our integrated circuit and photonic integrated circuit (PIC) designs. You’ll work at the intersection of electronic and photonic design, running and debugging verification flows against foundry PDKs and helping keep our tapeouts clean.

What You’ll Do

  • Run and debug physical verification (DRC, LVS, extraction) on IC and photonic IC layouts

  • Debug LVS/DRC discrepancies, including port mismatches, hierarchy mismatches, and device recognition issues

  • Read, manipulate, and QA GDS/OASIS layout data

  • Maintain and extend verification runsets and rule decks

  • Build Python/Tcl/shell tooling to automate verification flows and triage error reports

  • Maintain verification libraries and runsets under version control, with controlled release processes

  • Handle third-party and foundry IP with care, following licensing terms

  • Work with design, layout, and CAD teams to close out verification issues ahead of tapeout

  • Document known issues, workarounds, and runset changes

What You Bring

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on physical verification experience in IC design

  • Practical experience with Siemens Calibre and/or Synopsys ICV for DRC/LVS signoff

  • Experience with custom/analog layout tools such as Cadence Virtuoso or Synopsys CustomCompiler

  • Strong working knowledge of GDS/OASIS formats and LVS concepts

  • Proficiency with Linux and scripting in Python, Tcl, or shell

  • Experience managing rule decks, runsets, or libraries under version control (e.g., Git)

  • Ability to independently debug complex hierarchical netlist and layout issues

  • Strong written communication for documenting root causes and fixes

Nice to have

  • Photonic IC verification experience

  • Experience with Verilog/SystemVerilog netlists

  • Exposure to foundry PDK qualification

  • Experience building internal automation to scale verification

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Use tools like Terraform, Helm and Crossplane to manage and automate provisioning of all cloud infrastructure and champion GitOps best practices.

  • Monitoring & Observability: Establish robust monitoring and logging foundations collaborating with the wider Site Reliability Engineering Function.

  • Experience using cloud platforms like AWS (preferred), Google Cloud, or Azure.

  • A strong desire to (or experience in) creating and maintaining Kubernetes clusters in production.

  • A solid foundational understanding of distributed systems.

  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code technologies.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with a requirement of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Feel free to contact a member of the to discuss the role. More info can be found in our Internal Recruitment Policy.

title: PMO Intervention
descriptionHtml:
La mission en bref

Nous recherchons pour notre client, un grand groupe télécom, un ou une PMO expérimenté(e) dans le domaine de l'intervention, disponible rapidement, pour piloter la performance de fournisseurs au niveau national.

Client

Grand opérateur télécom

Arcueil (94). Sur site.

Dès que possible

Jusqu'au 31 décembre 2026 renouvelable (mission longue durée)

Dans le cadre d'un projet stratégique, vous soutenez deux managers et renforcez temporairement l'équipe en place. Votre priorité : piloter la performance des fournisseurs d'intervention et lancer un chantier d'amélioration continue. Vous représentez aussi temporairement la direction dans certaines instances de projets transverses, afin de libérer du temps à ses responsables.

Vos activités

Performance de l'intervention (environ 75 % de la charge)

  • Préparer les revues nationales de performance fournisseurs : collecter et consolider les données des neuf régions, analyser les résultats et préparer les messages à présenter.

  • Créer un comité de performance interrégional, identifier les bonnes pratiques, partager les retours d’expérience et accompagner leur déploiement sur le territoire.

Instances et représentation (environ 25 % de la charge)

  • Participer à certaines instances de gouvernance et y porter les enjeux de la direction, dans le périmètre convenu.

Livrables

Profil recherché

Le critère principal est une solide connaissance préalable de l'intervention et de son écosystème au sein d'un grand opérateur. Le poste demande une prise en main rapide du périmètre, et vos références devront le démontrer sur des missions comparables.

Compétences métier

title: Principal, CEO Office
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The CEO Office

The CEO Office works with senior leaders across Checkout.com on high-priority strategic and operational problems. The team turns important questions into clear decisions, coordinated execution and measurable business outcomes.

The role

This is a manager-level individual-contributor role for a hands-on operator. You will own defined, high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end—from framing problems and aligning stakeholders to implementing solutions and delivering measurable outcomes.

Working closely with the Head of the CEO Office, you will combine structured problem-solving with hands-on execution. You will translate priorities into coordinated action, strengthen how teams operate and drive initiatives through to impact.

This is neither a traditional PMO nor a presentation-led strategy role, and it is not an executive-level position. Success requires sound judgement, analytical rigour, clear communication, operational follow-through and the ability to influence effectively without formal authority.

How You'll Make an Impact (Role overview)

  • Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes.

  • Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems.

  • Support departments in scaling by contributing to organisation design, objectives and KPI setting, and the development of robust operating processes.

  • Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner.

  • Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting.

What We're Looking For (Background and core competencies)

  • Relevant background and impact: Experience in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Relevant backgrounds include consulting, high-growth technology, investing, investment banking, strategic finance or entrepreneurial operations. Payments or fintech exposure and international experience are advantages.

  • Problem-solving and analytical rigour: Use first-principles thinking, data and judgement to structure ambiguous problems, identify key measures and move between strategic questions and operational detail. Advanced SQL or hands-on data analysis is a plus.

  • Building and execution: Turn analysis into practical plans, KPIs, processes, tools or systems that create durable value. Experience building low-code/no-code or AI automations that others continue to use is a plus.

  • Ownership and impact: Personally own cross-functional work and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Influence and collaboration: Build trust, navigate trade-offs and make progress across functions without formal authority, with a low-ego and collaborative approach.

  • Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Principal Client Partner
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is a Version 1 company and AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

Our UK Benefits 

  • 35 days leave (including bank holidays). 
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Enhanced parental and adoption leave. 
  • Financial coaching + 5% pension match.
  • 40 hours of paid learning and development.

 View our full list of UK benefits.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team: 

Our Client Partners are at the heart of our client relationships, and our focus is on growing them, not just maintaining them. As Principal Client Partner, you'll own some of CreateFuture's most strategically important client relationships and lead a team of Lead Client Partners and Client Partners. This is a senior commercial leadership role: you'll set the growth agenda across a portfolio of accounts, build trusted relationships at C-suite level, and turn those relationships into significant, sustained revenue.

You'll be the person our clients call when they're thinking about what's next, and the person our team looks to for how growth gets done. You'll shape how CreateFuture grows its client base, from account strategy and multi-competitor bids through to commercial planning, and lead by example in the behaviours that drive it: qualifying with rigour, following through with intent, and seeing commercial conversations through to an outcome.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Owning the commercial performance of a portfolio of our largest or most strategically important accounts, from opportunity identification through to close, with clear accountability for revenue, margin and growth targets.
  • Building and sustaining C-suite relationships (CEO, CTO, CDO), expanding the stakeholder map, identifying whitespace and needs before clients articulate them, and turning those conversations into multi-workstream programmes.
  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Lead Client Partners and Client Partners, raising the whole team's capability in consultative selling, stakeholder strategy and commercial qualification.
  • Leading CreateFuture's approach to large, complex and multi-competitor bids, shaping value propositions, particularly across AI, data and modern digital delivery, that position us as the partner of choice.
  • Setting the operational rhythm across multiple portfolios: holding a 3x pipeline standard, driving forecast accuracy and high-quality Statements of Work, and owning your contribution to annual financial targets and wider commercial planning.
  • Championing strategic account planning and Client Partnership Groups (CPGs), aligning delivery teams to client expectations, using client satisfaction as a lever for growth, and raising CreateFuture's profile through events, content and thought leadership.


We’d love to talk to you if you:  

  • Have significant experience leading accounts in consultancy, professional services or digital and technology delivery, with a track record of growing large accounts materially through your own commercial judgement and relationship moves, not just retaining them.
  • Take full ownership of your numbers: you understand pipeline coverage, qualify with discipline, forecast accurately without being chased, and are comfortable leading commercial conversations early, often and at C-suite level.
  • Bring real credibility on AI and technology: you can hold a commercially grounded conversation with a CTO, CDO or CEO about agentic AI, data, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern software delivery, and have successfully positioned AI-related propositions.
  • Have led and developed client-facing teams, building commercial instinct and discipline in others and creating repeatable ways of working that scale across accounts.
  • Think strategically and act decisively: you spot opportunity, assess risk, bring senior client and internal stakeholders on the journey with you, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not activity.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Principal Designer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

In Product and Design, we bring together product managers, product designers and service designers in a central team covering the breadth of Faculty’s Applied AI division. In partnership with our Business Units, we form multidisciplinary teams and work with data scientists, engineers and delivery colleagues to create durable AI-powered software solutions for clients across a variety of industries.

Both product management and design are critical disciplines to create impact with AI. While data science and machine learning offer a powerful means to build insight and predictive capability, those insights are often consumed within a complex operational environment where human and organisational factors determine whether solutions are adopted and ultimately successful.

Closing the gap between the outputs of a model and the outcomes desired by our clients requires us to go beyond data and technology to address the human side – product and design are critical to this.

About the role

As a Principal Designer at Faculty, you will own and develop design as a core discipline within Applied AI while delivering high-impact work as a senior leader. You will shape our capabilities across both product and service design, defining progression frameworks and embedding modern practices. Operating as a trusted partner to executive-level clients, you will bridge the gap between technical AI capabilities and real-world commercial outcomes. This high-leverage position balances strategic client delivery with building an entrepreneurial design function from the ground up.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning and developing the product and service design disciplines at both individual and organisational levels across Applied AI.

  • Delivering high-leverage, billable client engagements by anchoring project deliverables, shaping work, and setting up strategic accounts.

  • Building influential executive relationships across client product, technology, and business leadership teams to drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Defining comprehensive skill frameworks to directly inform talent acquisition, career progression, and team development.

  • Partnering with business development teams during early project stages to identify product opportunities and structure multidisciplinary teams effectively.

  • Advocating for the value of design across Faculty and client organisations to integrate human-centred design into AI-driven products.

descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms.   • Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF.

  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
