title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - France)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €85K – €105K • Offers Bonus

title: Senior Lead Product Designer, Operations
descriptionHtml:
📍London or UK Remote | 💰£110,000 - £125,000 + Stock Options + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐Our Design team

We’re a team of 100+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

The Operations Collective is where we design how help and customer support works at Monzo. We think holistically about the experience of getting support as a customer, and how that connects to the systems, tools, and people behind the scenes.

We’re focused on delivering effortless, tech-led support experiences that can scale as Monzo grows. That means understanding customer problems deeply, preventing support needs where possible, solving issues at their source within the product, and designing seamless journeys whether customers self-serve or speak to a customer support agent. 

AI and automation play a central role, empowering customers to resolve simpler issues independently, and equipping our operations teams with intelligent tools to handle more complex cases with confidence and speed. We design across the full ecosystem: customer journeys, internal platforms, routing, and the foundations that enable us to scale safely.

There’s a real opportunity to shape how help works across Monzo, end to end. 

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Embedding the long-term design vision for support experiences at Monzo, shaping how customer-facing journeys, internal systems, and human service connect into one coherent ecosystem.
  • Leading large, end-to-end design initiatives across ambiguous problem spaces, spanning AI-enabled help experiences, internal tooling, and operational workflows.
  • Designing with a service mindset, understanding what happens beyond the interface and shaping the real-world impact of your design decisions.
  • Designing across touchpoints; from the app, to the phone, to human support.
  • Navigating tradeoffs and guiding strategic decisions in an opinionated way.
  • Coaching the other Ops Collective designers by helping them to embed the vision in their work, running design crits and supporting them to shape their work. 
  • Continuing to raise the bar for design craft and product excellence at Monzo, ensuring your work is a benchmark for quality and innovation across the organisation and our industry.
  • Partnering with cross-functional leaders to define and execute product strategies that translate into actionable plans you help build and ship.
  • Proactively addressing systemic challenges, reducing complexity, and creating better conditions for teams to deliver impactful work.
  • Acting as a visible ambassador for Design, sharing your work and its impact across the company to maintain Design’s place at the heart of Monzo.
  • Mentoring and levelling up designers across the discipline, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and belonging.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re an expert in your craft, with deep expertise in a specific design discipline and strong foundational skills across all areas of product design.
  • You’re comfortable designing for AI and automation-enabled environments, and excited by the opportunities AI creates to rethink how services operate.
  • You have experience working on complex service ecosystems, where digital products connect to real-world operations, people, or logistics.
  • You’re passionate about improving how humans and technology work together, creating experiences that feel seamless to customers and empowering to the teams delivering support.
  • You have a proven track record of delivering high-impact design work that drives customer outcomes, influences company metrics, and achieves commercial goals.
  • You’ll have excellent visual, UI and interaction skills, and the ability to think through complex interaction design. 
  • You thrive in ambiguity, leading teams to deliver in complex, fast-changing environments while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • You’re a strategic thinker who can shape product direction across multiple areas and translate organisational goals into clear, actionable plans.
  • You’re a natural collaborator, skilled at working cross-functionally to improve ways of working and deliver greater value for customers and the business.
  • You’re passionate about growing and shaping the Design team, whether through hiring, onboarding, or creating resources that scale your impact across the organisation.
  • You’re pragmatic and proactive, always looking for ways to improve Design’s impact at Monzo while balancing the need to “get the job done”.

🙌What’s in it for you

💰£110,000 - £125,000 + Stock Options

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

title: Senior Legal Counsel

title: Senior Linux Kernel Driver Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

This role sits at the boundary between host and silicon. The kernel driver is key to keeping pace with our ultra-fast devices on cutting-edge server platforms. It’s a high-leverage layer where each win shows up as real throughput and latency gains.

You’ll be there for the pre-silicon simulations, first bring-up, first end-to-end runs, and the moments where performance jumps because of something you shipped.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, and maintain the Linux kernel driver for Fractile’s AI accelerator

  • Build the performance-critical kernel-space paths that keep the host stack moving: PCIe device management, DMA, memory handling, interrupt handling, and robust recovery paths

  • Define and evolve the userspace interface the runtime depends on, with a focus on stability, debuggability, and performance

  • Work in a tight co-design loop with hardware, firmware, runtime and ML engineers: validate assumptions, iterate on behaviour, and close gaps early

  • Improve tooling/workflows so we move fast without breaking things

What we’re looking for

  • You’ve shipped and maintained Linux kernel device drivers in production. Experience with PCIe-attached devices and custom hardware interfaces is ideal.

  • Strong systems and performance instincts. You can reason about computer architecture, concurrency, and where the time goes

  • Excellent C and/or Rust, and a pragmatic approach to building high-quality, maintainable & secure kernel code

  • You enjoy hard kernel and system-level problems, and you take them end-to-end until the measurements move

  • Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths, Physics, or related degree and 3+ years of industry experience

Nice to have

  • GPUs / ML accelerators / high‑throughput I/O (NICs, RDMA, storage)

  • Hardware bring‑up or pre‑silicon simulation experience

  • Performance work: profiling, tracing, benchmarking, regression tracking

If you want to build the software where every driver win unlocks huge system performance, come build it together.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level.

Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights. 

At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level. Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights.  

The Lightcast platform is a benchtop laboratory instrument that uses microfluidics to allow precise and highly flexible control of thousands of aqueous microdroplets using software-generated light patterns. Control systems enable the integrated optical, mechanical, and fluidic sub-systems to perform complex workflows and assays used in the search for drug candidates. 

We are seeking a Senior Mechatronics Engineer to join our team and take a leading role in system design and engineering activities. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering complex systems within a product business through a background in Electronics, Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering, with an emphasis on designing and debugging systems at the intersection of hardware, firmware and control. You will have: 

  • A strong technical track record in designing complex mechatronic products for function, reliability, manufacture, serviceability and cost  
  • Hands-on and analytical approach to debugging complex systems, problem solving and resolution ownership 
  • Full end-to-end development experience in mechatronic and electronic systems, having worked with development and manufacturing teams to engineer and improve product designs 
  • Deep subject matter expertise and extensive experience in developing and delivering complex measurement systems and instrumentation  

Your responsibilities: 

  • Working with our development, manufacturing and support teams to design, develop, deliver and maintain our platform and microfluidic products 
  • A strong focus on delivering electro-mechanical system architecture designs  
  • Taking a key position in system engineering activities, devising and delivering system tests, functional characterisation and verification tests 
  • Technical review of projects, as a subject matter expert 
  • Technical documentation of design outputs and rationale 
  • Leadership in and advocacy for good product engineering practice, process development, definition and documentation 
  • Leading and participating in risk mitigation, design reviews, verification, change control 

It would be advantageous for you to have any of the following: 

  • Embedded programming experience 
  • Experience using Python or similar programming languages 
  • Experience developing Life science products 
  • Experience developing opto-mechanics, precision motion control and fluidics systems
  • A track record of working in a multidisciplinary environment 
  • Deep knowledge of operating with MCAD and ECAD 

Lightcast Discovery is committed to equal employment opportunity. Learn more about Lightcast Discovery

We have agreements with our preferred suppliers and will not be adding to this list. Any resume submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will become the property of Lightcast Discovery, and will not incur a placement fee.

title: Senior ML Engineer (AI Research)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

This role is for Nebius AI R&D, a team focused on applied research in AI. Examples of applied research that we have recently published include:

  • applying reinforcement learning for agent training in long-context multi-turn scenarios
  • dramatically scaling task data collection to power reinforcement learning for SWE agents
  • building a decontaminated evaluation for SWE agents that is regularly updated
  • investigating how test-time guided search can be used to build more powerful agents

The results often lead to collaboration with adjacent teams where our research findings are applied in practice.

We are currently looking for senior- and staff-level ML engineers to work on research in areas such as:

  • Guided search and reinforcement learning for agentic systems
  • Reinforcement learning for reasoning models
  • Web-scale problem collection for training agents
  • Efficient model distillation

Some examples of what your responsibilities might include are:

  • Conducting experiments to figure out efficient ways to train a large language model on traces of interactions with various environments
  • Exploring methods of guided generation and search in the trajectory space
  • Coming up with ways to mine relevant data at web scale and figuring out efficient ways to use this data in model post-training
  • Conducting experiments with different reinforcement learning configurations in verifiable domains
  • Exploring methods to train AI agents on tasks with non-verifiable reward signals

We expect you to have:

  • A profound understanding of theoretical foundations of machine learning and reinforcement learning
  • Deep expertise in modern deep learning for language processing and generation
  • Substantial experience with training large models on multiple computational nodes
  • Strong software engineering skills (we mostly use python)
  • Deep experience with modern deep learning frameworks (we use jax)
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities
  • Experience designing, executing, and analyzing machine learning experiments with proper statistical rigor
  • Ability to formulate research questions, design experiments to test hypotheses, and draw meaningful conclusions from results
  • Ability to document research findings clearly and contribute to technical publications or report

Nice to have:

  • Experience with deep reinforcement learning for LLMs, including techniques such as reward modeling, DPO, PPO etc
  • Familiarity with important ideas in LLM space, such as RoPE, ZeRO/FSDP, Flash Attention, quantization
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field Master’s or PhD preferred
  • Track record of building and delivering products (not necessarily ML-related) in a dynamic startup-like environment
  • Experience in engineering complex systems, such as large distributed data processing systems or high-load web services
  • Open-source projects that showcase your engineering prowess
  • Excellent command of the English language, alongside superior writing, articulation, and communication skills
  • Proficiency in contemporary software engineering approaches, including CI/CD, version control and unit testing

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE 

At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

You’ll have the autonomy to manage and develop a large business portfolio, mentor junior team members, and significantly contribute to team targets. You’ll help unlock growth into new market segments, offering insurance solutions for emerging mobility trends, and support our ambition to become one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You’ll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK

ESSENTIAL

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance 

  • Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers

  • The ability to collate data and provide support to our Head of Underwriting to enable them to monitor and analyse the portfolio

  • Provide feedback and continuously improve the process for gathering risk information from our clients, in order to ensure frictionless quoting and onboarding for all clients and brokers

  • Identify and surface to our Underwriting Manager areas where we can improve our policy wording and coverage

  • Follow rapidly evolving market trends, continuously refurbishing your knowledge of cutting-edge products and services in the Motor Fleet

  • Actively train and develop members of the Underwriting and operations teams and to help promote Underwriting knowledge across Flock

  • Comfortable using AI in underwriting work, for example extracting and checking risk information or speeding up quoting, while keeping your own judgement on every decision

PREFERABLE

  • Experience in dealing with large corporate customers 

  • ACII qualified or working towards

  • Experience of working closely with product teams to ensure product, process and customer journey enhancements are included within the product roadmap

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

descriptionHtml:

Regions: UK & Ireland, Nordics, DACH, Benelux, North America

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light, they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.

Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The Role

Partners are central to how Light grows. Accounting firms, advisory practices and implementation partners bring us into deals, deliver alongside us and help finance teams move off legacy ERPs.

As Senior Partner Sales Manager, you’ll own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue across a portfolio of strategic partners in five regions. You’ll recruit the right partners, build plans with them and turn those relationships into qualified pipeline and closed deals, working hand in hand with our account executives.   • Own a revenue target for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings across your portfolio

  • Recruit and sign new strategic partners: accounting firms, Big 4 and mid-tier advisory practices, ERP implementers and VC/PE networks

  • Negotiate partner commercials with Legal, including referral and rev-share terms, MOUs and reseller agreements

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Around 7 years in B2B SaaS sales or partnerships, with real time carrying a partner or channel number

  • A track record of hitting partner-sourced revenue targets on mid-market and enterprise deals

  • Existing relationships with accounting, advisory or ERP implementation firms in at least one of our regions

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to present with confidence to partner leadership and CFOs

  • A collaborative spirit. You build trust with partners and colleagues alike, and you win as a team.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a finance software company such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday or a modern finance platform

  • A background at a Big 4 or mid-tier accounting firm

  • Experience launching a partner programme or entering a new market

  • German, Dutch or a Nordic language

The Good Stuff

💸 Competitive base plus variable pay on partner-sourced revenue.
📈 Equity in a fast-growing, venture-backed company.

Light is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, just let us know.

How To Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a partner relationship you turned into meaningful revenue.

Our process:

title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions.

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability.

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration.

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation.

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture.

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software.

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability.

Bring-up, Commissioning and Validation

  • Plan and execute payload bring-up and commissioning on vehicle prototypes and demonstrators: mechanical fitment, electrical integration, software provisioning (flashing, configuration, diagnostics), troubleshooting, and validation up to full system commissioning where the complete E/E system is proven to work.

  • Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing.

  • Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams.

  • Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation

  • Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations.

  • Actively support build-ups, rework, payload installation, and vehicle-level commissioning in the workshop during prototype and customer-specific integration phases.


What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines.

  • Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication buses (CAN, ideally CAN-FD or automotive Ethernet), including reading and debugging bus traffic during integration.

  • Solid mechanical integration understanding: mounting concepts, packaging, tolerances, vibration, environmental robustness, accessibility, and serviceability.

  • Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. You are comfortable automating recurring integration tests.

  • Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups.

  • Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Hands-on mentality: comfortable working directly on vehicles, prototypes, harnesses, brackets, and payload installations in the workshop.

  • Strong communication skills across engineering teams, suppliers, procurement, and program stakeholders.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment.

Your Benefits:

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

title: Senior Product Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack — from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues — they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

Why this role is exciting

  • High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

  • True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design — from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

  • AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You’ll own the interface design for Maia, our AI shopping assistant, and build the structured design system guidance used by AI coding agents to generate on-brand code without hand-coding interfaces.

  • Direct customer engagement: Lead user research and usability testing sessions directly with real shoppers, rather than commissioning external agencies or receiving filtered insights.

  • High accountability, low overhead: Work in a small, autonomous team where design decisions move straight to production and work that doesn't deliver measured impact is honestly reverted.

What you will own and deliver

  • Customer Surfaces: Own the end-to-end design and UX strategy across web, iOS, and Android for all core journey stages: homepage, search & browse, product pages, basket, slot selection, checkout, and order tracking.

  • Design System as a Product: Own component architecture, design tokens, patterns, and documentation, ensuring our coding agents have precise design guidance to generate accurate interfaces.

  • AI Experience Design: Define the interaction patterns for Maia (our AI shopping assistant), governing when it intervenes, how it presents information, and how it hands over to human support.

  • Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively — scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance.

  • Direct User Research: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability tests, and field research directly with customers to continuously uncover friction points.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, and your peer product designer, while providing design input to Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products with a strong portfolio of shipped work across both web and native mobile (iOS and Android).

  • Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level.

  • Data-fluent mindset: Ability to read and rigorously interpret A/B testing data, distinguishing genuine impact from vanity metrics.

  • Fluency with AI tooling: Practical experience integrating AI tools into modern design, prototyping, and design system workflows, along with a clear view of where conversational AI adds real interface value.

  • User research expertise: Demonstrated experience designing, running, and analyzing qualitative usability sessions directly with end users.

  • Strong product reasoning: Excellent communication skills in English (C1 level or above), with the ability to articulate the strategic and behavioral rationale behind design decisions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience designing production-grade AI or assistant-driven interfaces.

  • Experience contributing directly to code at the component or token level.

  • Background in e-commerce, quick-commerce, online grocery, or last-mile delivery.

  • First-hand familiarity with how German customers shop.

  • Fluency in German or Czech.

What’s in it for you

  • Fair pay, transparent, stable compensation A strong fixed salary with clear rules. No bonus politics. Great work is rewarded openly and fairly.

  • Good food options, fresh, every day Enjoy subsidised meals/fresh food options in the office and regular refreshments like drinks, fruit, and snacks that keep you energized.

  • Life beyond work, hybrid work & real flexibility Three days in the office and the rest where it works best for you. Take time off when you need it with paid vacation days above statutory and flexible scheduling.

  • Grow with Knuspr every day - we move fast, and so can you. Learn, experiment, and take ownership from day one. Every challenge is a chance to grow.

descriptionHtml:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 95+ (and counting) with 20+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.

Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.

Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.

You will:

  • Oversee the full product lifecycle of concepting, prototyping, and iterating based on design reviews, user testing, feedback, and data like share rates.

  • Implement and maintain the existing design & brand guidelines while also creating and adapting guidelines to elevate the overall Polarsteps design, including the look and feel of our shareable formats.

  • Own your product pillar, while maintaining close collaboration with the other pillars. Proactively ask for and share feedback to keep our product smooth, consistent, and awesome.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure your designs are well-specced and built as intended, down to the last pixel and color.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

✅ Being a seasoned professional with 5+ years of experience designing lovable products;
✅ A strong portfolio, with shipped designs, that demonstrates end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design, with a strong visual eye for typography, layout, and storytelling;
✅ Experience designing for native mobile apps;
✅ Hands-on experience with user insights and testing, like A/B tests and usability studies;
✅ A proactive mindset, with a passion for getting involved in the entire product development process, thinking and problem-solving like a product manager;
✅ Fluency in modern design tools such as Figma/Sketch or similar;
✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.

 

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 75.000 - 90.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you)

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. 

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities 
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers. 
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI. We bring them our extensive expertise in using AI in real-world situations and a track record of delivering serious impact.

Product managers in Applied AI provide strategic leadership for Faculty’s clients, guiding stakeholders through discovery, decision-making and execution. We help our clients to achieve the greatest impact for their organisations with the very latest AI advancements and we teach bleeding-edge product development practices.

As a Senior Product Manager at Faculty, you’ll take on important strategic client engagements, leading teams that include top-flight Data Scientists, Engineers and Product Designers, among others. You’ll help to drive the strategic direction of high-impact AI products for our clients, balancing complex technical considerations and user needs to achieve real commercial outcomes.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

  • Acting as a trusted advisor to clients at well-known organisations on their product and AI strategies.

  • Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

  • Keeping teams focused on outcomes, not just outputs by defining clear goals, shaping prioritisation and articulating trade-offs.

  • Embedding innovation culture among our clients, guiding and inspiring them.

  • Collaborating with your cross-functional teammates including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Designers and Delivery to set the quality bar for AI products, including the eval strategy to ensure they continue to work as intended.

  • Building lasting product development capability in client organisations, from the habits of individual teams to the product operating model as a whole.

  • Advising clients on how AI can accelerate and improve their product development lifecycle, from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement.

  • Contributing to Faculty's product practice through developing case studies, thought leadership and repeatable methods that scale across clients.

  • Partnering with Delivery leads on planning and execution, including supporting business development and fostering strong client relationships.

  • Coaching and developing other product managers.

Who we're looking for:

  • You have experience conceiving, building and launching products at scale.

  • You’ve routinely worked directly with C-suite or equivalent senior leaders at significant, successful organisations.

  • Strong commercial acumen: you've made the case for new products or services - whether for revenue, savings or public benefit - and defended it with leaders.

  • You relish unstructured problems and can turn them into clear plans that teams can execute.

  • You can comfortably converse with experts in how AI models are created, evaluated and operationalised.

  • You have demonstrable experience in working with cutting-edge AI-accelerated product development practices and processes.

  • You have a clear track record of mentoring team members and fostering a collaborative, ambitious culture.

  • You show forward-thinking initiative to spot new client opportunities, solve ambiguous problems, and build enduring organisational value.

Desirable experience

  • You have meaningful professional services or consulting experience, ideally with large enterprises.

  • You’ve worked in at least one scaled-up, fast-moving product-led organisation, owning significant scope and achieving meaningful impact.

  • You have experience in public speaking about product development and/or product management.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. title: Senior Product Manager, Trust & Safety, Integrity and Fraud
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

About the Team

Our Trust & Safety, Integrity and Fraud Product team is dedicated to ensuring a safe and trusted experience for all customers across our platform, including Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. We tackle complex challenges, from preventing fraud, abuse and Account Takeover to ensuring authenticity, to building regulatory compliance capabilities, all while balancing risk mitigation and providing a seamless user experience. Our team partners closely with cross-functional groups, including Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Risk Operations, to drive strategic initiatives that protect our business while fostering growth.

About the Role

Trust is foundational to an on-demand marketplace. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are converging European capabilities into one platform and one global product capability to prevent fraud and abuse. The marketplace is expanding rapidly beyond just restaurants as we become “your door to more." As we add new products, geographies, ways for Consumers, Merchants and Couriers to engage, we’re expanding and enhancing our fraud capabilities to be best in the industry at keeping our platform safe and trustworthy. We strongly believe that trust is the most important attribute of an online marketplace, and the team ensures that we maintain this trust.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager that will lead dedicated cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges that impact Consumers, Couriers and Merchants and touch every corner of our business - from new user onboarding, to the in-app delivery experience, to the products and services being created that our users can’t find anywhere else. We are looking to hire for a few roles, so you’ll either lead a vertical fraud team protecting Consumers, Couriers or Merchants, or lead a horizontal fraud platform team focused on building our Risk Engine, Data Signals Intelligence and Automation / Anomaly Detection capabilities or leading compliance and authenticity efforts involving Identity Verification and Right to Work. The Fraud team is in hyper growth in terms of its size and impact and offers a unique opportunity to set and execute on a vision that will shape the future of Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt globally.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Set the vision and long-term product strategy for one of our vertical fraud teams or our horizontal platform fraud team.

  • Prevent, detect and mitigate fraud and abuse, building and leveraging AI systems to address risk in real time.

  • Build an AI-led fraud operations platform that turns complex marketplace signals into automated decisions, prioritised investigations, and actionable case workflows, stopping fraud, abuse and manipulation before incidents occur.

  • Develop and execute a customer-focused product roadmap through close collaboration with senior leadership, Operations, Data Science, Analytics, Design, and Engineering all while balancing business needs.

  • Translate customer and internal-user needs into clear, well-defined functional and technical requirements backed by data analysis and deep understanding of our users

  • Guide and interface closely with data analysis and engineering teams to define scope, review and refine technical capabilities, prioritize projects for release, and define new opportunities.

  • Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities for product performance, tracking, and to create product insights.

  • Establish business cases and projected return on investment to identify and prioritize opportunities

  • Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to manage the impact on the profitability of the overall business.

  • Establish success metrics and executive reviews covering fraud trends and P&L impact.

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-functional products from strategy through execution in ambiguous problem spaces.

  • Experience defining strategic vision and roadmap execution in a given product area.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-enabled or automation-heavy products, with sound judgment about where models can accelerate decisions and where human expertise, safeguards, and accountability must remain central.

  • Experience in technology, fraud, privacy, security, data governance, trust & safety, risk or an enthusiasm to learn and keep customers and the ecosystem fraud-free and protected

  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous policy, legal, or regulatory requirements into practical, scalable product solutions and clear engineering priorities.

  • Fluency in modern AI product development, including evaluating model quality, designing human-in-the-loop experiences, and translating emerging capabilities into practical, measurable customer and business value.

  • Extreme customer centricity with a focus on ensuring low-friction experiences for good customers.

  • An analytical, structured approach to ambiguity and risk, with the ability to frame tradeoffs, define controls, and set measurable outcomes.

  • Experience partnering effectively with Legal, Compliance, Public Policy, Security, Privacy, Operations, Data Science, Design, and Engineering.

  • An interest in applying AI and data-driven systems to improve fraud detection, triage, escalation, and prevention, with sound judgment about safeguards and human oversight.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior leaders around urgent, high-stakes decisions.

  • Direct experience applying AI/ML to prevent, prevent, detect and mitigate harm, plus AI fluency — you can build a feature with AI – not just write PRDs.Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Den Haag op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Projectleider Beschermd Wonen en Maatschappelijke Opvang. Je vertaalt een bestaand advies naar een uitvoerbaar samenwerkingsmodel en zorgt ervoor dat het platform operationeel is bij de start van de nieuwe contractperiode. title: Senior Quality Engineer, Chassis and Powertrain
descriptionHtml:
Czinger Vehicles is redefining the future of automotive design and manufacturing. Founded in 2019, we're pioneering a new era of performance vehicles through revolutionary, proprietary technology that blends human-AI design with sustainable manufacturing. Our flagship 21C hypercar, celebrated as the world’s fastest production vehicle and for its record-setting runs at Goodwood Hill Climb, Circuit of the Americas, and Laguna Seca, showcases the innovation behind over 550 patents in AI-driven generative design, materials, and additive manufacturing. With our three core pillars of dominating performance, iconic design, and revolutionary technology, Czinger is at the intersection of deep technology, consumer products, and high-performance branding. We invite you to join our world-class talent in shaping the future of the automotive industry. Here, you'll be part of a groundbreaking journey that pushes the limits of performance, design, technology, and sustainability. 

Purpose

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality performance across the assigned products and supplier base throughout the full product lifecycle, from supplier development and production readiness through launch, current production and issue resolution.

The primary responsibility for this role is the Chassis vehicle system, with additional execution support for selected Powertrain suppliers and activities within the UK, including the Powertrain Controls interface. The role requires a high level of ownership, practical judgement and technical understanding.

Effective cross functional collaboration to identify quality risks early, develop effective solutions and ensure robust implementation. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers, the Senior Quality Engineer will take ownership of quality concerns, drive supplier performance and support the continuous improvement of Quality Engineering processes, standards and practices.

The Role

Supplier Development & Production Readiness

  • Support supplier selection by assessing manufacturing capability, process maturity and identify key quality risks and required actions before supplier nomination.
  • Apply the Supplier Qualification Framework and lead or coordinate the appropriate APQP, PPAP, audit and production-readiness activities.
  • Review key manufacturing controls, including FMEAs, Control Plans, inspection strategy, process capability and validation evidence, challenging gaps and driving actions where controls are not adequate.
  • Drive supplier-development actions and ensure significant supplier or manufacturing changes receive appropriate validation and requalification before implementation.

Supplier Execution & Current Quality

  • Own Quality Engineering follow-up for assigned suppliers and components  after launch, monitoring performance and emerging risks, proactively driving improvement.
  • Lead containment, root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant supplier-related concerns, verifying sustainable prevention of recurrence, including clear ownership, timing and evidence of effectiveness.
  • Determine when supplier visits, additional controls, escalation or supplier-development activities are required, using risk and data to determine the appropriate level of response.
  • Own and coordinate incoming inspection requirements for assigned parts when defined by the Supplier Qualification Framework or required as part of issue containment, including stock checks, increased inspection and verification of subsequent purchase orders until confidence in product quality is restored.
  • Provide local UK execution support for selected Powertrain suppliers while maintaining alignment with the Powertrain system owner and relevant Engineering teams.

Product Quality & Ticket Management

  • Own and coordinate the Product-quality ticket landscape for the assigned vehicle system, including Issues, Enhancements, FAR’s (Field Action Requests) and other applicable concerns.
  • Ensure concerns are clearly defined, prioritised and progressed with appropriate containment, technical ownership and corrective action.
  • Coordinate resolution across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers, clearly escalating significant or ageing risks when progress is insufficient.
  • Maintain alignment between supplier-level actions and Product-level resolution, including support to Powertrain activities when assigned.

Quality Documentation & Standards

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Quality Engineering standards and documentation, using lessons learned from practical supplier and product quality experience.
  • Ensure applicable requirements are understood and consistently deployed internally and within the supplier base.
  • Capture lessons learned from supplier and Product-quality concerns into standards covering areas such as qualification, APQP/PPAP, inspection, critical characteristics, supplier changes and structured problem solving.
  • Promote effective and proportionate quality controls without unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong ownership and a track record of taking complex issues through to effective closure, with the ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  • Practical experience in Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering or a related technical environment, ideally within a high-complexity manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience working with suppliers and manufacturing processes, with sound structured problem-solving capability.
  • Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans and production-process qualification, with the ability to apply these tools practically and proportionally.
  • Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications and technical requirements, and translate them into practical quality controls. Previous GD&T experience is a plus.
  • Confidence working cross-functionally and constructively challenging suppliers or internal stakeholders when required, whilst maintaining effective working relationships.
  • Ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment, combining a practical, data-driven approach with sound judgement, and focus effort on the highest quality risks.
  • Strong communication, curiosity and willingness to develop a detailed understanding of the product and manufacturing process, with the ability to communicate technical quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within automotive, motorsport, aerospace or other high-complexity manufacturing environments is essential.
  • Chassis or Powertrain experience is advantageous but not essential where strong transferable technical capability can be demonstrated.
  • Experience with low-volume, high value, high performance and technically complex products is particularly relevant to the role.

Work Environment

  • Onsite

  • Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
  • Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
