title: Senior Quality Engineer - MONOPOLY GO!
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join the MONOPOLY GO! team. The role can be based remotely in the UK, or in Barcelona or Seville on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day.

The MONOPOLY GO! Tech Vertical develops the platforms, services, and engineering capabilities that support a reliable, responsive mobile gaming experience.We are building a Quality Engineering organization that embeds quality throughout development through automation, continuous validation, and shared engineering ownership.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex problems, and building tools that help teams deliver with confidence. Reporting to the Quality Director of Tech, you will help establish our QE capabilities through hands-on development of automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and quality insights across mobile, Unity, APIs, integrations, performance, and CI/CD.

You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness.

What You Will Do

  • Build reusable engineering solutions. Write, review, debug, and maintain automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that other engineers can adopt and extend.
  • Improve testability from the start. Participate in technical design and code reviews to identify risks early and improve test hooks, service interfaces, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Balance building with hands-on testing. Perform manual, exploratory, and release testing where automation is not yet available or direct investigation provides greater value. Meet current delivery needs while building sustainable solutions.
  • Develop mobile and Unity automation. Automate Android, iOS, and Unity workflows, accounting for device differences, application lifecycle events, network conditions, and client performance.
  • Strengthen API and integration testing. Validate backend services, service contracts, client-server interactions, data integrity, and failure recovery through reliable automated tests.
  • Validate player-state consistency and recovery. Test interrupted sessions, reconnects, retries, and client-server synchronization to help protect player progress and data integrity.
  • Investigate failures across systems. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage.
  • Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers.
  • Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing.
  • Integrate validation into CI/CD. Deliver reliable automated feedback, useful diagnostics, and maintainable quality checks. Improve test stability and execution time, with clear ownership of failures.
  • Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce.
  • Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. Build and evaluate solutions for test generation, failure triage, regression selection, and coverage analysis, with human review and measurable outcomes.
  • Strengthen telemetry validation and quality visibility. Partner with engineering and analytics to validate telemetry accuracy, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, and data freshness. Query large datasets to investigate issues and build quality dashboards that inform risk assessment and release decisions.
  • Help establish the QE organization. Contribute standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and mentoring. Partner with developers, Quality Analysts, and technical leaders to strengthen shared ownership of quality.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated quality engineering, software development in test, or software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of automation used by other engineers.
  • Strong programming skills in C# or Python, with the ability to work effectively in Unity and automation codebases. Experience in source control, code reviews, debugging, and maintainable software design.
  • Practical experience testing and automating Android and iOS applications, including device coverage, operating system differences, and unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience developing API and integration tests, diagnosing failures across services and data flows, and integrating reliable automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Working knowledge of performance, risk-based, and exploratory testing, with sound judgment about what to automate and when to investigate directly.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with telemetry and big data, including querying large datasets, validating events and data pipelines, and using findings to guide testing and release decisions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.
  • Strong ownership and collaborative problem-solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions. A passion for quality, mobile games, AI, and technology.
  • Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to participate independently in technical discussions, explain engineering decisions, and write clear documentation with global teams.

Additional experience we value

  • Hands-on experience with Unity, C#, Unity Test Framework, or automated testing of Unity-based mobile games.
  • Experience with live-service games, player-state consistency, reconnect behavior, live configuration, or client-server synchronization.
  • Experience with mobile device farms, observability, quality dashboards, or establishing QE capabilities within a growing team.

What success looks like

Teams receive faster, more trustworthy feedback and clearer visibility into release risk. Immediate testing needs are met while dependable automation grows around critical player journeys and integrations. Performance regressions surface earlier, failures are easier to diagnose, and repetitive effort decreases. Your tools are maintained, documented, and adopted by other engineers, and AI capabilities demonstrate measurable value.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Benefits

Wir sind kein Konzern und keine Holding, kein Politik Theater, kein Quartals Reporting, das niemand liest. Wir haben ein Produkt, das funktioniert.

title: Senior Sales Coordinator - Berlin (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

At Lightspeed, smooth operations and proactive execution drive our commercial success. As a Senior Sales Coordinator, you are the strategic operational backbone of the Account Management (AM) team. Beyond basic coordination, you will drive operational excellence, safeguard high-value strategic key accounts, and relieve management of high-friction administrative obstacles.

You will act as a critical cross-functional hub - taking full end-to-end ownership of complex account workflows, streamlining standardized processes across the department, and enabling the wider AM team to focus on revenue-generating opportunities and key client relationships.

***Please note that we operate a hybrid working model, which requires you to work from the office three days per week.***

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Account Operational Ownership: Take complete end-to-end operational responsibility for critical major client accounts, coordinating complex hardware processes, international account interfaces, and location expansion rollouts seamlessly.

  • Management Shielding & Escalation Resolution: Proactively intercept, investigate, and independently solve complex account discrepancies (e.g., pricing errors, manual compensation, full returns) to shield management resources and protect strategic leadership bandwidth.

  • Cross-Functional Team Support: Serve as the centralized subject matter expert for high-friction operational procedures - such as complete end-to-end Contract Transfers across product lines - absorbing these time-intensive workflows to free up capacity for the broader Account Management team.

  • Process Standardization & Optimization: Identify operational bottlenecks in key account workflows, establish structured review routines, and implement standardized procedures to ensure long-term consistency and error-free execution.

  • Interdepartmental Interface: Partner closely with Go-To-Market (GTM) Operations, technical support, and international teams to ensure swift, accurate transaction execution and flawless new location openings.

  • Milestone & Project Alignment: Drive strategic project milestones and maintain high-level communication channels on major enterprise projects, minimizing routine admin clutter in favor of strategic impact.

What You Need to Bring

  • Proven Operational Track Record: Solid experience in a senior administrative, sales operations, or account coordination role - ideally within a fast-paced SaaS or tech environment.

  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to independently own complex, high-stakes tasks end-to-end without requiring day-to-day managerial supervision.

  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Advanced capability to untangle complex system errors, audit manual discrepancies, and establish sustainable standardized workflows.

  • Strong Interpersonal & Stakeholder Management Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both German and English.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to act as a supportive reference point for peer Account Managers, taking on heavy operational lifting to elevate overall department performance.

  • Education & Business Acumen: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

What's in It for You

  • Work from Anywhere: Work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 60 days per year.

  • Modern Ways of Working: A hybrid working model offering flexibility.

  • Stock Options: Participate in the Lightspeed Stock Option Program.

  • €400 Health & Wellness Budget: Supporting your physical and mental well-being.

  • Mental Health Support: Access to mental health resources through the Modern Health app.

  • Impact-Driven Environment: Join an agile team with a global vision.

Ready to scale impact in B2B SaaS?

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Senior Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Security Engineer 

London (Hybrid) | Technology & Engineering  | Permanent 

The Role

As a Senior Security Engineer at Capco, you'll lead hands-on security engineering delivery for clients across financial services and other complex environments. Depending on the engagement, you'll lead a technical workstream or operate independently as a Principal specialist. Your focus will span Application & Product Security, Cloud & Platform Security and DevSecOps, underpinned by strong security automation. You'll combine specialist depth with cross-domain judgement, client engagement and secure-by-design engineering. 

What You'll Do 

  • Lead the design, implementation and technical assurance of secure solutions across applications, cloud platforms and delivery pipelines; remain hands-on with complex engineering and integration challenges. 
  • Work directly with clients to understand requirements, lead technical workshops and shape practical security designs, delivery plans and technical proposals. 
  • Embed security-by-design across applications, APIs, cloud workloads and the secure SDLC through threat modelling, CI/CD controls, SAST, SCA, DAST and container scanning. 
  • Build and integrate scalable security automation using scripting, APIs, Infrastructure as Code and policy as code; improve control effectiveness and engineering workflows. 
  • Lead technical workstreams or specialist assignments, assure engineering quality and operational handover, mentor engineers and develop reusable standards and patterns. 
  • Leverage approved AI-enabled tools and automation to enhance security engineering efficiency and effectiveness, ensuring appropriate human oversight, security guardrails and validation. 

What We're Looking For 

  • Deep implementation expertise in one or more of Application & Product Security, Cloud & Platform Security or DevSecOps, with working knowledge of the other areas. 
  • Practical experience securing applications, APIs, cloud workloads or engineering pipelines, supported by sound knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management and secure SDLC practices. 
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) and cloud-native security principles, including an understanding of IaC, containers and workload identities. 
  • Strong security automation capability with scripting, APIs and CI/CD tooling, plus experience with IaC or policy as code and integrating security tools into engineering workflows. 
  • Broad awareness of network and infrastructure security, IAM, monitoring and data-protection controls; able to collaborate with specialists and explain technical trade-offs to clients. 
  • Strong understanding of security standards and best practices, including ISO 27001, NIST and OWASP, with the ability to translate security requirements into practical engineering controls and solutions. 

Bonus Points For 

  • Experience in financial services, energy or other regulated sectors; relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP or cloud security credentials. 
  • Depth across multiple priority engineering domains; experience in software supply-chain or container security, technical presales, or security engineering for AI-enabled systems. 

Why Join Capco 

  • Deliver high-impact security engineering solutions for leading financial institutions and other major clients. 
  • Work in a collaborative, entrepreneurial consulting culture with continuous learning, training and certification opportunities 
  • Help shape secure digital transformation across financial services and energy.

Benefits 

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life: 

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.
  • Family Care: Eight complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday Flexibility: Five weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.
  • Continuous Learning: Minimum 40 hours of training annually through workshops, certifications, and e-learning. You'll also be assigned a Business Coach from Day One to support your professional development.
  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.
  • Extra Perks: Wellhub (Gympass), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco 

We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know - we'll be happy to help. 

We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration - a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself.

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver

  • Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

  • Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

  • Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

  • Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

  • Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

  • Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

  • Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

  • Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

  • Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate

  • Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

  • Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

  • Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

  • Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

  • Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

  • Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

  • Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes


Job Requirements

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred

  • Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages

  • Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar

  • Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs

  • Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

  • Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex

  • Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry

  • Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies

  • SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne

  • SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar

  • Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation

  • Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment

  • Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases

  • Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar

  • Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments

  • Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response

  • Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations

  • General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

Job Specifics

  • Location: This is a hybrid role, while the role is primarily remote, typically 70% to 80% percent of the time, there will be a requirement to travel to customer sites and attend the Basingstoke office as required to support delivery, workshops and engagements.

    (free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!).

  • Hours are full-time: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm. There is no on-call requirement for this position.

Why would you choose to come and work with us?

You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment, working across a wide range of customer environments and technologies. The role offers exposure to real-world threats, modern detection approaches, and the opportunity to shape how Security Operations capabilities are designed and delivered.

Nomios offers a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and industry-leading benefits, along with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how we and our customers build and run Security Operations.

Nomios is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and sustaining an environment in which everyone is provided with an equal opportunity to grow and develop, and no individual will be unjustly discriminated against. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion and belief, sex and sexual orientation.

descriptionHtml:

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Security Operations Analyst to serve as our primary operational anchor for EMEA, bridging follow-the-sun operations across global time zones (APAC and the Americas). In this role, you will analyse security events, investigate potential threats, validate and manage high-priority incidents, and execute decisive containment actions to minimise overall impact while escalating unresolved incidents to security engineering teams.

This person will monitor and remediate security incidents across on-prem, identity, and cloud-based environments for internal corporate infrastructure and enterprise client engagements. As the primary responder on shift during EMEA business hours, you should possess deep operational muscle memory, strong technical composure under pressure, and the initiative to challenge assumptions and propose continuous improvements. This is a remote role from either the UK, Ireland, or Poland. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead triage, scoping, containment, and eradication for medium-to-high severity security incidents across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud environments.
  • Perform deep-dive investigations, threat isolation, and query hunting leveraging CrowdStrike Falcon (Host Timeline, Real Time Response).
  • Investigate identity compromises, phishing campaigns, and suspicious account activities using Google Admin Console (Investigation Tool, Email Log Search, Token Auditing).
  • Analyse ingress edge telemetry, CDN traffic patterns, WAF events, and web server logs (including Cloudflare and Acquia application environments) to detect, trace, and mitigate web attacks, DDoS conditions, and botnet/scraping abuse.
  • Maintain and continuously update incident response plans and runbooks for efficient incident response, collaborating with engineering to automate containment workflows.
  • Coordinate cross-departmental remediation tasks and escalate unresolved incidents with clear technical root-cause analysis (RCA) aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Collaborate with content production for security awareness and mentorship.

About You

The essentials:

  • 5+ years of direct experience in Security Operations (SOC), Incident Response, or similar hands-on technical operational roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering/Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep operational experience utilising CrowdStrike (investigation workflows, Host Timeline, Real Time Response, and query hunting).
  • Proven experience leveraging Google Admin Console (Investigation Tool, Email Log Search, Token Auditing) for phishing, BEC, and identity investigations.
  • Hands-on experience with industry-leading security tools across EDR, SWG, SIEM, and MDM platforms.
  • Solid understanding of network protocols, traffic flow, and the OSI model.
  • Experience with log analysis, malware triage, and digital forensics.
  • Proven track record of operating autonomously during incidents with minimal supervision.
  • Practical experience leveraging AI tools, LLMs, or agentic workflows to assist analysis, scripting, or automation.
  • Working ITIL knowledge and functional familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Courteous, articulate, and educated in interpersonal delivery. Maintains a polite, respectful, and calm demeanor with internal teammates, leadership, and external clients even during incident bridges.
  • Ability to confidently and politely present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-directed, resourceful, and critical thinker with proactive problem-solving instincts.
  • Strong personal anxiety management and self-organisation during high-pressure incidents.
  • Eager to learn, experiment with emerging tooling, and actively suggest process enhancements.

Not a must, but a plus:

  • Demonstrated hands-on and reflexive triage/containment instincts over theoretical knowledge or paper certifications (certifications like CISSP, Sec+, or CEH are welcome, but secondary to proven live-fire execution).
  • Experience analysing Cloudflare edge/WAF logs and Acquia/Drupal web server access logs for application-layer anomalies, scraping, and volumetric spikes.
  • Hands-on experience with modern SIEM / SecOps platforms:
  • Cloud security experience (GCP, AWS, Azure) in production environments.
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automated triage and API data collection.
  • Exposure to Blue/Red/Purple team simulation exercises.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Security Operations Engineer, you will help protect DiliTrust's SaaS platform, cloud infrastructure, networks and production environments. You will join the Infrastructure & Security team, a 12-person team spread across France, Canada and Spain, and work in an international context (Europe, North America and EMA). The infrastructure you will secure is managed in an automated way and counts more than 350 assets hosted across our cloud providers.

You will contribute to the continuous improvement of our security posture through monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, hardening and automation, and you will work closely with infrastructure, DevOps, development and product teams so that security is embedded into our architectures, operations and delivery processes.

Missions:

In this role, your main responsibilities will include:

Security monitoring & incident response

· Monitor the security of networks, cloud infrastructure, systems, applications and endpoints.

· Administer, configure and continuously improve our security tools, including CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA, PKI, antivirus and WAF solutions.

· Continuously evolve our detection mechanisms and threat-detection scenarios.

· Investigate security alerts and incidents, support incident handling, and contribute to root-cause analysis, remediation and post-incident reviews.

Hardening, vulnerabilities & secure architecture

· Implement hardening measures and support vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation and follow-up through action plans.

· Validate the security aspects of IT architectures and application projects.

· Actively participate in security audits and penetration tests: scoping, support during the exercise, remediation of findings and follow-up.

· Test products and run technical validations on prototype environments before they reach production.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

· Automate deployments and security / infrastructure operations using Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and scripting.

· Create and maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, operational documentation and technical standards.

Roadmap, watch & knowledge sharing

· Define and deliver the team's security roadmap together with the Hiring Manager and your peers.

· Keep an active watch on threats and security news, and share what you learn with the team.

Candidate Profile:

Experience & seniority

· You have at least 5 years of professional experience in Security Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security or a related field (network, systems or cloud engineering with a strong security component).

· You have practical experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, system hardening and operational security.

Mindset & collaboration

· You are passionate about cybersecurity and interested in automation and the DevOps culture; you would rather automate a process than repeat it.

· You are analytical, autonomous, versatile and rigorous, with a strong sense of service and good synthesis skills.

· You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and you are confident in your expertise without losing the team spirit.

· You enjoy working collaboratively in an international, distributed team and have a good command of English.

Technical Skills:

Required

· Good knowledge of Linux (Debian-based environments in particular), Docker and Kubernetes;.

· Good knowledge of networking, enough to design, routing and firewall rules: TCP/IP, DNS and TLS; static routing, VLANs, segmentation and NAT; stateful and application-level firewall rule design; reverse proxies and load balancers; VPN and overlay technologies (WireGuard, IPsec); ZTNA principles (identity-aware access, device posture, micro-segmentation); cloud networking (VPC, peering, private endpoints).

· Ability to manage network and security configurations as code, using Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible and AWX.

· Good knowledge of PKI and certificate management: CA hierarchies, certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, revocation, automation), TLS / mTLS, key and secret management.

· Administration of security tools: CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA and PKI, including interpreting security events and alerts.

· Hands-on experience with WAF (policy and rule tuning).

· Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog.

· Ability to script and automate repetitive operational or security tasks.

Nice to have

· Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud environment.

· An active interest in security news, emerging threats, conferences and meetups.

Our Security & Infrastructure Environment:

· Cloud: Google Cloud Platform and other cloud providers, with automated infrastructure management (700+ assets)

· Systems & containers: Linux (Debian), Docker, Kubernetes

· Automation: Ansible, AWX, Terraform

· Network & access: ZTNA, bastion

· Security tooling: SIEM, EDR, WAF, antivirus, PKI

· Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog

Process:

· Interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team (30–45 minutes)

· Technical interview with the SecOps Team Lead and the Team manager, including a practical case study (about 90 minutes)

· Final interview with the CTO (30 minutes)

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Engineer

Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer I - Senior Engineer II

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is diverse depending on the team, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP, and Scala, so we index on product-minded problem solving over language purity. As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

  • Own a slice of the product end to end: shape the problem with product and design, build the interface and the services behind it, ship it, and run it in production.

  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

  • Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

  • Stay close to the people who use what you build, directly or through our forward-deployed engineers: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Instrument what you ship so you can see how it’s used, and turn what you learn into shipped changes.

  • Make good work the default: shape the codebase, conventions and automated checks so that agents and new teammates produce the right thing without anyone catching it in review.

  • Mentor, review, and share what you know.

What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our top engineers and value deeply, but we don't expect everyone to tick every single box. If you're excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience shipping production software: You bring real depth to either the front or back end of a modern stack, and potentially an openness to stretch across both as you navigate our diverse ecosystem.

  • A daily agentic development practice: You build with tools like Cursor or Claude Code, can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and review AI output as rigorously as a colleague’s PR.

  • Able to navigate a complex, high-stakes domain: You keep complex energy logic legible across microservices, knowing exactly when to use sync vs async to prevent cascading failures.

  • Cloud and operational ownership: You're comfortable deploying on major cloud platforms using shared tooling. You fully own your software in production, which includes participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota.

  • Strong product sense: You relentlessly ask "why" before building, and can point to times when direct user feedback or metrics materially changed what you ultimately shipped.

  • Clear written communication: You write specs, PR descriptions, and post-mortems with enough clarity and context that either a human teammate or an AI agent can immediately act on them.

  • A multiplier for your team: You mentor peers and proactively shape how the team works; introducing conventions, checks, or shared context that makes everyone else’s output consistently better.

Nice to have: you’ve built tooling around coding agents (MCP servers, skills, CI checks); experience in energy or another real-time, regulated domain.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET Ecosystem)
descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. Each client has a primary owner, but no client belongs to one person: we review and co-maintain across languages and decide cross-client questions together.

The role

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own the ClickHouse .NET client. You'll decide what the client should do by talking to the developers who use it, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep .NET expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: ADO.NET, Dapper and Entity Framework Core users, and the tools and integrations that depend on your client.

What you'll do

  • Know who uses the client and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap.

  • Be the voice of ClickHouse for .NET developers. Speak at .NET conferences and meet-ups, and write the posts, tutorials and samples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from .NET (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them.

  • Own the .NET client and its ecosystem: the client, the EF Core provider and ORM integrations, NuGet releases and support. Evolve it without breaking the people who depend on it.

  • Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features.

  • Bring what .NET and Windows users need to the ODBC driver, since that's how many Windows and BI tools reach ClickHouse. If you write C++, contribute to it directly.

  • Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

  • Make the client enterprise-ready: TLS and certificate handling, authentication including Microsoft Entra ID, safe credential handling, signed and reproducible packages, and the audit and compliance questions large .NET shops ask before they adopt.

  • Shape the client for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

  • Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.

About you

  • Product-minded. You decide what to build from user evidence, measure whether it worked, and can explain what you chose not to build.

  • 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, data access, ingestion or analytics.

  • Deep C# and .NET expertise: memory management, async and the TPL, Span and pooling, profiling and benchmarking. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks.

  • Fluent in C#, and productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++). You'll review and co-own across clients, not only .NET.

  • You've built or substantially extended a library other engineers depend on, and shipped NuGet packages across .NET Framework and modern .NET. You treat breaking changes accordingly.

  • Fluent in .NET data access (ADO.NET, Dapper, EF Core) and at home in the wider .NET ecosystem: ASP.NET Core, Aspire, NuGet.

  • Security-minded. You've shipped a library into enterprise environments and know what security, compliance and procurement teams look for in a dependency.

  • Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it.

  • Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out.

  • Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs.

Nice to have

  • ClickHouse, especially its type system, or another OLAP engine.

  • C++ and ODBC driver internals.

  • Building or maintaining an ADO.NET or EF Core provider.

  • Open-source contributions to .NET or data infrastructure.

  • Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer.

  • Protocol or wire-format work on a database driver or network client.

Learn more

  • Introducing the (blazing fast!) native TCP client for .NET: zero-copy columnar reads, 1.5 to 2x faster than HTTP, over 99% fewer GC allocations (Oct 2026)

  • What's new in the ClickHouse .NET Driver: the road from 1.0 to 1.3 (Aug 2026)

  • Meet GroeneAI: our autonomous contributor to ClickHouse (Oct 2026)

  • Building a .NET API Gateway with ClickHouse and Aspire (Jun 2026)

  • The .NET client on GitHub and its documentation

  • ClickHouse Workload for Microsoft Fabric, now in public preview (Sep 2026)

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team

At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.

What you’ll be doing

  • Architect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles.
  • Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues.
  • Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling.
  • Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.
  • Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems.
  • Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.

We’re excited if you have

  • Minimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20).
  • Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers.
  • Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus.
  • Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.
  • Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Senior Software Engineering Platform Engineer – Spec-Driven Development
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte die nächste Generation der Softwareentwicklung

Für einen führenden Schweizer Finanzdienstleister suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Software Engineering Platform Engineer – Spec-Driven Development.

Im Zentrum der Rolle steht nicht der Betrieb eines einzelnen Tools, sondern der Aufbau einer modernen Engineering-Plattform und Arbeitsweise: Anforderungen und Spezifikationen sollen künftig so strukturiert, versioniert und technisch nutzbar gemacht werden, dass daraus unterstützt durch moderne AI- und Engineering-Werkzeuge möglichst effizient Code, Tests und weitere Software-Artefakte entstehen können.

Heute werden Anforderungen unter anderem in Polarion ALM geführt. Künftig soll daraus schrittweise eine durchgängige, Spec-Driven Engineering-Toolchain entstehen – von Requirement und Spezifikation über Implementierung und Testing bis hin zu Deployment und Traceability.

Dabei arbeitest du mit zahlreichen Delivery Teams, Architekten, Business Analysten und weiteren Engineering-Rollen zusammen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne Softwareentwicklung im Unternehmen künftig funktioniert.

  • Du gestaltest den Aufbau einer modernen Spec-Driven Development Plattform und entwickelst die dazugehörige Engineering-Toolchain weiter.

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte und technische Lösungen, um bestehende Anforderungen aus klassischen Requirements-Management-Systemen in strukturierte, versionierbare und maschinenlesbare Spezifikationen zu überführen.

  • Du verbindest Requirements, Spezifikationen, Architekturvorgaben, Code, Tests und Deployment zu einem möglichst durchgängigen Engineering-Prozess.

  • Du entwickelst Integrationen, Automatisierungen und Plattform-Komponenten entlang des Software Delivery Lifecycles.

  • Du evaluierst und integrierst moderne AI-gestützte Engineering-Werkzeuge und Coding Agents in bestehende Entwicklungsprozesse.

  • Du entwickelst Prototypen und Referenzimplementierungen, insbesondere im Umfeld von Java und Spring Boot.

  • Du gestaltest Standards und Best Practices für Spezifikationen, APIs, Testing, Softwarequalität und Developer Experience.

  • Du arbeitest an einer nachvollziehbaren End-to-End Traceability von der Anforderung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.

  • Du unterstützt Delivery Teams dabei, Spec-Driven Development und AI-gestützte Engineering-Praktiken in ihre tägliche Arbeit zu integrieren.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in Architektur-, Tooling- und Technologieentscheide ein und hilfst, aus ersten Prototypen robuste Enterprise-Lösungen zu entwicke


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineer, Tech Lead, Software Architect oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle.

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen.

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Java und Spring Boot.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen REST APIs, Testing, Git, CI/CD und Software Delivery.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

  • Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

  • Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

  • Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

  • Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

  • Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

  • Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

  • Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

  • Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

  • Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

  • Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

  • Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

  • First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

  • First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

  • First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

  • You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

  • You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

  • We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

  • We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

  • We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

  • Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

  • A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

  • Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

  • Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

  • Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

  • Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

  • The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

  • Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

  • Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

  • Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups

  • Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce)

  • Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

  • Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Shape the platform, not just tickets: your insights from customers will directly impact what our engineering teams build.

  • Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched.

  • Help build the team: you'll join a small team at an inflection point, with real ownership over how Solutions Engineering works at WeTravel.


    Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events.

  • Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden and right by Rokin metro.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account.

  • Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation

Ready to build something meaningful? Apply now.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

Product and industry expertise

  • Develop deep vertical knowledge, establishing yourself as a subject matter expert and building trust with executive buyers.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from current, static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem collaboration

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Platform
descriptionHtml:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

The role

Physical engineering is one of the hardest domains for AI. Designs have to meet standards, calculations must be deterministic and checkable, and a wrong number can end up in a power system or a data centre. CurieOS is built to let agents do real engineering work and to show exactly how every output was produced.

The platform team builds the foundation that every workflow, agent and product on CurieOS depends on, and runs it in production for people who need to trust it. Your work sets the floor for how reliable our AI is, and the ceiling for what it can do.

This is a small team, and you'll shape what we build as well as how. You'll see the results of those decisions in production within days. If you want a narrow, well-defined slice of a large system, this isn't the role. If you want to own a platform while it scales, it is.

How we work

We build with agents, not just for them. Everyone on the team works with the latest frontier models and coding agents every day, and token budgets won't hold you back. Part of what we build is CurieOS's ability to work on itself: triaging defects, proposing fixes and opening pull requests for engineers to review. So engineers here spend more of their time on design, review and judgement, and less on typing. If you already work this way, you'll feel at home. If you want to see how far it can go, this is the place to find out.

You'll also work alongside our AI researchers, turning cutting-edge research and evals into things that run in the platform and in production.

What you'll work on first

In your first six months you'll work across the parts of CurieOS that customers have to be able to trust. Like everyone on the team you'll touch most of them, and go deepest where your interests take you:

  • Tenancy, isolation and identity. How CurieOS keeps each customer separate, from shared multi-tenant accounts to dedicated single-tenant deployments. That covers data isolation, SSO and access control. You'll also be an engineering voice in customer security reviews.

  • Release and production. How changes get to production safely: release gates, staged rollouts and rollback, automated smoke tests, on-call and incident response. We ship often, and you'll build what lets us keep doing that without breaking what customers rely on.

  • Agent quality in production. Measuring how well agents perform on real customer workflows, working with our researchers to bring the latest evals into the platform, and using those measurements to decide what is good enough to release. A model or prompt change should have to pass the same gate as a code change.

  • Observability and cost. Knowing the platform is healthy and what it costs. That means SLOs, tracing and alerting, plus cost telemetry and usage metering for every workflow and every customer, so we can see where model and compute spend goes and make deliberate choices about it.

  • Infrastructure and deployment. One standard for how CurieOS is deployed, configured and upgraded in each environment, across our own cloud accounts, GPU capacity and customer-dedicated deployments.

Where the platform is going

Once those foundations are solid, there's a lot to shape next:

  • Traceable results. Provenance for every number an agent produces: which inputs, tools, models and versions went into it, so our users can check it and sign it off.

  • Agent runtime and context. How agents plan, call tools, manage context across long-running work and hand off to people at the right moment.

  • Durable workflows. Orchestration that survives failures, retries and runs lasting hours, mixing agent steps with deterministic calculations.

At Staff level, you'd set technical direction across these areas, not just within one. You'd own one of them end to end, run the design reviews that our research and forward deployed teams build on, make the architecture calls that are hard to reverse, and help shape how we hire and grow engineers.

Our stack

Python services on Kubernetes, running on AWS plus specialist GPU clouds for heavy compute. Strong engineers from Go, Kotlin, Java or a comparable stack will pick up the language quickly. What matters more is that you've run real systems in the cloud.

You'll have most of these

  • Designed and built backend services that other teams or customers relied on, and made the key decisions yourself.

  • Owned a system in production after it shipped: the cloud infrastructure it ran on, on-call, incidents, how changes went out, and the monitoring that told you it was healthy.

  • Built and run something where LLMs do real work for real users, and dealt with the cost, latency and quality trade-offs that come with it.

  • Used coding agents heavily in your own work, with opinions on where they help and where they break.

  • Led a project end to end, made trade-offs you can explain, and raised the bar for the engineers around you.

Bonus points

  • Shipped software to external enterprise customers: SSO, tenant isolation, per-customer deployments, security reviews.

  • Run infrastructure as code at scale, or GPU workloads across more than one cloud provider.

  • Helped a system or a company through a scaling phase, such as a platform going from internal use to many external customers.

  • Worked closely with researchers, scientists, engineers or other domain experts and built what they actually needed.

  • For Staff: a track record of setting technical direction beyond your own team, such as architecture other teams adopted, a migration you led across several teams, or engineers you've grown into senior roles.

You don't need a background in materials, chemistry or engineering. You'll pick up the domain from the people who have it.

Why Orbital

Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company. We put frontier AI into the making of critical physical products, from advanced materials to data-centre engineering. Our research team works at the cutting edge, from universal interatomic potentials to GPU-native simulation, and we turn that research into tools engineers use every day. CurieOS is the platform that brings it together: the AI operating system the whole company runs on, which customers are starting to depend on for their own engineering work too.

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
