title: Sr. Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As a Senior Data Scientist at Hims & Hers, you are a core driver of technical execution and innovation within our data organization. You take complex business challenges and translate them into robust, scalable data products and machine learning models. You will be trusted to operate with high autonomy, owning your projects from the initial exploratory analysis through to production deployment.

In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize our operations, refine our marketing efforts, and enhance the customer experience. You will not only build powerful models but also help uphold the engineering rigor and standards of our data team.

You Will:

  • Build from Scratch: Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment. You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write complex SQL, engineer your own features, and deploy baseline models (heuristics or simple ML) quickly to prove value before iterating toward complex solutions.

  • End-to-End Execution: Own the complete model lifecycle, from data extraction and feature engineering to deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to define technical requirements and translate model outputs into clear, actionable business insights.

  • Uphold Technical Standards: Write clean, modular, and production-ready code. Actively participate in peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical best practices.

  • Drive Project Delivery: Navigate technical ambiguity within your domain, breaking down complex project requirements into manageable, executable milestones.

  • Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and support to junior data scientists and analysts, helping them troubleshoot roadblocks and adopt best practices.

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years of applied experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, with a track record of delivering production-ready models that drive measurable business value.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Python and SQL. Deep familiarity with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and standard ML frameworks (such as PyTorch, XGBoost, or LightGBM).

  • Engineering Rigor: Proven ability to build for production. Experience working in cloud-based environments (AWS or GCP) and familiarity with CI/CD workflows, version control (Git), and ML Ops principles.

  • Analytical Problem Solving: Strong ability to connect technical metrics to business outcomes. You know how to choose the right algorithm for the right problem rather than just the most complex one.

  • Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Education: BS, MS, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, Applied Math, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 0-to-1 Execution: Experience taking the very first machine learning models in an organization from exploratory notebooks to reliable, automated production pipelines.

  • Advanced Business ML (Experience in 1-2 of the following):

    • Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: Building predictive models for churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) to directly drive targeted marketing and product interventions.

    • Applied Forecasting: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or handling non-stationary data for demand or revenue planning.

    • Optimization: Building engines for marketing spend, inventory management, or resource allocation.

    • Causal Inference: Designing robust experiments (e.g., quasi-experiments, difference-in-differences) to measure true business impact beyond standard A/B testing.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

  • Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

  • Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

  • Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

  • Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

  • Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

  • Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

  • Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

 

What you bring

  • You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

  • Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

  • Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

  • Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

  • Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

  • Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

  • Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate is a self-starter and problem-solver, skilled at leveraging technology and data to deliver top-tier analytics solutions. They thrive on addressing complex business challenges and are consistently effective in making high-judgment decisions at a rapid pace, even in the face of ambiguity and uncharted scenarios. title: Staff Software Engineer - Workloads
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Team

Launchables is CoreWeave's platform for building Physical Intelligence. We bring simulation, training and evaluation tools into a common platform, allowing robotics, autonomous systems and engineering teams to focus on their applications while Launchables handles common execution and infrastructure needs.

We turn specialist Physical AI software into capabilities that researchers and engineers can use, adapt and build upon. Our work combines strong software engineering with applied domain knowledge to make complex workloads accessible, reproducible and useful in real-world environments.

As a Staff Software Engineer, Workloads - Physical AI, you will develop engine integrations, application code, adapters, templates and developer tools that make specialist software available through Launchables. You will work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their tasks, assumptions, dependencies and expected outcomes, translating these into interfaces and configurations that preserve the capabilities they need.

You will take ownership of how users configure, run, customise and evaluate workloads. This includes defining meaningful inputs, defaults, constraints and outputs; building command-line and API interfaces; and creating examples and documentation that help users extend existing templates or author their own. You will establish appropriate validation for packaging, execution and application outcomes, working with domain specialists to make evaluation criteria and their limitations clear.

You will profile workloads to improve preparation time, GPU utilisation, concurrency and data movement while preserving the intended computation. You will also capture the inputs, versions, settings and execution conditions needed to reproduce runs, with logs, metrics and artefacts that help users diagnose failures, compare experiments and interpret results.

Working alongside engineers responsible for the shared runtime and platform services, you will turn feedback from early users into better interfaces, defaults, tests and guidance. You will identify reusable patterns across integrations, shape shared platform capabilities, review designs and mentor colleagues. You will use coding agents and automation to accelerate development, applying the review, testing and domain judgement needed to ensure the resulting software behaves as intended.

Qualifications:

  • Strong software engineering skills, demonstrated through dependable software or developer tools used by other people.
  • Applied depth in at least one relevant area, such as robotics simulation, autonomous-vehicle evaluation, reinforcement learning, synthetic-data generation or engineering simulation.
  • Experience making specialist or research software usable beyond its original author, including configuration, testing, documentation and diagnosis.
  • Sound judgement about experimental assumptions, evaluation criteria, reproducibility and the conclusions a result supports.
  • Familiarity with containerised execution and experience tracing problems across application and infrastructure boundaries.
  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and domains, working closely with specialists and recognising when their expertise is needed.
  • Evidence of improving shared tools or engineering practices across multiple projects, with clear reasoning about what should be common and what should remain application-specific.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience developing software in Python, Go or C++.
  • Familiarity with simulation and machine-learning frameworks.
  • Experience profiling GPU workloads and identifying performance or resource bottlenecks.

Nous sommes la seule maison de couture portant le nom de Karl et nous nous efforçons d’être à la hauteur de cette responsabilité dans tout ce que nous réalisons, chaque jour, avec la plus grande joie et passion. Nos sièges de Paris et d’Amsterdam accueillent une équipe diversifiée et motivée de membres de la famille KARL venant de plus de 35 pays différents. Ensemble, nous visons à créer des histoires pleines de sens ainsi que des concepts de produit liés au monde et aux attributs emblématiques de Karl. Le prêt à porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont gérés directement depuis notre siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que d’autres catégories, incluant le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie et autres, sont développés avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS est de la même manière gérée en dehors de notre siège d’Amsterdam et est notre gamme connaissant la croissance la plus rapide. Nous sommes en contact avec nos consommateurs à différents niveaux, nous assurant que notre approche à la fois en ligne et hors ligne aillent de pair. Nous nous efforçons d’optimiser l’engagement de nos clients avec plus de 200 magasins KL dans le monde, nos partenaires grossistes premium, et notre couverture numérique, avec à sa position le flagship store KARL.COM, qui est disponible dans 96 pays. Nos canaux numériques représentent plus de 30% de notre activité à plein tarif. Nous sommes une entreprise dynamique, à la croissance rapide et inclusive construite sur le professionnalisme et des valeurs fortes. Chez KARL KAGERFELD, nous nous engageons à travailler avec les plus hautes normes en matière de durabilité et d’intégrité dans tous nos domaines d’activité. En 2019, KARL LAGERFELD a rejoint la Fashion Pact, une initiative de durabilité mondiale cherchant à transformer le secteur de la mode par le biais d’objectifs dans trois différents domaines : climat, biodiversité et protection des océans, en tant que membre fondateur.

C’est dans ce but que nous proposons des stages conventionnés à temps plein pour une période de 6 mois en tant qu’assistant(e)s de ventes. PROFILE

title: Stage Finance & Control
descriptionHtml:
Studenten opgelet:

Stage Finance & Control beschikbaar!
Wil jij een kijkje in de keuken van een internationale organisatie? Onderdeel zijn van ons finance team waarbij je leert over diverse finance aspecten? En ben je pro-actief, leergierig en hou je ook wel van een geintje op zijn tijd? Lees dan snel verder!

Dit is P1

P1 Travel is het grootste sportevenementen Ticketing bureau van Europa en wij werken officieel samen met de grootste voetbalclubs, stadions en toernooien ter wereld. Denk aan clubs als Manchester United, Liverpool, FC Barcelona en SSC Napoli, maar ook de Olympische spelen, Formule 1 en Wimbledon. Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team. Feeling met sport en cijfers? Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby!

Het finance team
Het zeskoppige finance team, onder leiding van Martijn, draagt met elkaar zorg voor alle financiële processen binnen de organisatie. Zoals je je wellicht kunt voorstellen is de event/travelbranche een dynamisch speelveld waarbij geen dag hetzelfde is. Aan het finance team de taak om in samenwerking met de rest van de organisatie te zorgen voor kloppende cijfers waarop gestuurd kan worden.

Finance & Control stage
Gedurende je stage zal je compleet onderdeel zijn van het team en zorgen we voor een gevarieerd takenpakket. Je eerste weken staan in het teken van kennismaken met onze processen en werkwijzes. Daarna zul je aan de slag gaan met je eigen takenpakket. Hierbij kun je denken aan:

  • Maken van periodieke en ad hoc rapportages;

  • Meewerken aan financiële maand- en jaarafsluitingen;

  • Uitvoeren van checks en controles op o.a juistheid en volledigheid van financiële data en processen;

  • Maken van resultaatboekingen op events en het analyseren daarvan.

Naast het op doen van waardevolle ervaring in de organisatie gaan we graag met je in gesprek over grote en uitdagende projecten die P1 en jou verder helpt in de ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld het zelf opzetten van managementrapportages.


Jouw profiel

  • Je volgt momenteel een financiële studie in de richting van Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfsadministratie, Finance & Control o.i.d. en bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage per januari/februari 2027.

  • Je bent pro-actief, wil zoveel mogelijk leren en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal.

  • Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook!

Waar kom je terecht?

We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 80 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. Je zult dus zeker niet de enige zijn die van start gaat.

Dit krijg jij ervoor terug!

Naast een afwisselende stage en goede begeleiding wordt er verder goed voor je gezorgd. Denk hierbij aan een gaaf kantoor voorzien van alle gemakken, verzorgde lunch, sportmogelijkheden en de vetste uitjes met de hele toko. Elke stagiair die wij hebben gehad kijkt terug op een onvergetelijke tijd.

''It’s all about unforgettable experiences!''

Enthousiast geworden? Goed om te horen! Laat snel van je horen via de solliciteerknop door je CV en een motivatie te sturen. Is deze stage niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Check dan zeker ook nog even de andere stagevacatures.

title: Stage: Innovative Strategic Business Design
descriptionHtml:
Jouw ideeën. Echte uitdagingen. Zichtbare impact. Welkom bij Lab271.

Ben jij een gedreven (master) student Industrial Design Engineering en op zoek naar een hands-on stage in strategic business design en innovatie, waarbij je écht het verschil kunt maken? Dan is deze kans bij Schuberg Philis iets voor jou! Bij ons werk je niet alleen aan projecten voor toonaangevende klanten zoals PostNL, NS en Heineken, maar draag je ook bij aan het innovatieve kloppend hart van onze organisatie: Lab271. 

Over Schuberg Philis
Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we trots op wat we doen. Lab271 is het innovatielab waar toekomstgerichte oplossingen worden ontwikkeld voor uitdagende vraagstukken. Hier draait alles om experimenteren en het toepassen van opkomende technologieën om echte problemen aan te pakken. Je zult werken aan onderzoek, conceptontwerp, prototyping, business modelling, visualisaties en workshops voor diverse klanten. Ben je benieuwd naar wat één van je voorgangers heeft gedaan? Bekijk dan hier het verslag! 

Wat ga je doen

  • Onderzoek en analyse van complexe klantvragen.
  • Vertalen van businessproblemen naar creatieve oplossingen.
  • Conceptontwerp en prototyping van innovatieve producten en diensten.
  • Faciliteren van workshops en events.
  • Bijdragen aan de groei en innovatie van Schuberg Philis.   

Wie wij zoeken

  • Een enthousiaste en proactieve student, bij voorkeur volg je de Master Industrial Design.
  • Affiniteit met technologie, innovatie, design en digital.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een “can do”-mentaliteit.
  • Creatief denkvermogen en probleemoplossend vermogen.
  • Beschikbaarheid voor minimaal 5 maanden fulltime (startdatum in overleg, bij voorkeur september of februari). 

Wat wij bieden

  • Je bent onderdeel van een multidisciplinair team met innovators en onconventionele denkers, die je graag helpen om te ontwikkelen.  
  • Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en creativiteit.
  • Eens per kwartaal een innovatietrip en andere uitjes.  
  • Lekker en gezond ontbijt, lunch en avondeten.
  • Kantoren in Schiphol-Rijk en het centrum van Rotterdam.

  • Macbook Pro & een iPhone tot je beschikking tijdens de stage.  

Interesse?
Bij Schuberg Philis krijg je de kans om vanaf dag één impact te maken. Van het vertalen van een businessprobleem naar een eerste prototype, wij geloven in jouw potentieel om échte verandering teweeg te brengen. Ben jij klaar om jouw talenten te laten zien en deel uit te maken van ons innovatieteam Lab271?

title: Stage Sales & Accountmanagement (B2B) | Flagship Events Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
descriptionHtml:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Sales & Accountmanagement Stagiair(e) ondersteun je Flagship Events bij het binnenhalen van nieuwe zakelijke evenementen. Je helpt bij het vinden en benaderen van potentiële klanten, het opvolgen van aanvragen en het voorbereiden van offertes en voorstellen. Je richt je onder andere op evenementenbureaus, hotels en andere zakelijke klanten. Zo leer je hoe een zakelijk verkooptraject werkt: van het eerste contact tot een succesvolle boeking. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het in kaart brengen van evenementenbureaus in Amsterdam en het voorbereiden van een voorstel voor een bedrijf dat een privéboottocht wil organiseren.

Wat ga je leren?

  • Nieuwe zakelijke klanten en potentiële opdrachtgevers in kaart brengen;

  • Prospectlijsten opbouwen en leads benaderen;

  • Aanvragen opvolgen en contact onderhouden met potentiële klanten;

  • Offertes en commerciële voorstellen voorbereiden;

  • De CRM-pijplijn bijhouden en contactmomenten registreren;

  • Meedenken over commerciële kansen en nieuwe samenwerkingen;

  • De voortgang van leads en verkoopresultaten bijhouden en rapporteren.

Praktisch

Startdatum: Vanaf februari 2027, of eerder in overleg;

Duur: minimaal 5 maanden;

Type stage: meewerkstage;

Stagevergoeding: € 350 per maand;

Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam.

Wat we aanbieden

  • Een leerzame meewerkstage waarin je commerciële en communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt;

  • De kans om het volledige zakelijke verkoopproces te leren kennen;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen bij uiteenlopende zakelijke evenementen;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • Een verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding.

Functievereisten

  • Je volgt een opleiding in de richting van Commerciële Economie, International Business, Bedrijfskunde of Event Management;

  • Je bent proactief, nauwkeurig en representatief;

  • Goede beheersing van het Engels;

  • Interesse in de evenementenbranche is een plus;

  • Ervaring met Customer Relationship Management-systemen is mooi meegenomen.


Over Flagship Amsterdam

Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

title: Stage Spécialiste Environnement (6 mois) - F/H - Nantes
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Vos missions :

Vous serez support au pilotage et à l'animation d'études d'impacts sur l'environnement de parcs éoliens et centrales solaires comprenant notamment le volet naturel, le volet paysager et des études spécifiques.

Vous serez en lien avec l'équipe projet, les autorités et les spécialistes pour identifier et traiter l'ensemble des risques environnementaux des projets.

Vous participerez à la concertation de tous les acteurs permettant de réaliser la conception de projets la plus adaptée au territoire.

Vous proposerez des axes d'amélioration sur les mesures E-R-C-A (Eviter, Réduire, Compenser, Accompagner) des projets éoliens et solaires.

En particulier les axes d'amélioration suivants ont été identifiés :

  • Amélioration du bilan carbone des projets (outils, méthodologies) et proposition de mesures de réduction de l’impact carbone des projets.
  • Amélioration de la gestion des risques dans les projets solaires développés en SIS (sites et sols pollués).
  • Amélioration de la synergie entre projets solaires et stockage batterie-BESS (projets d’hybridation).

Vous participerez au dépôt des dossiers de demande de permis de construire et à leurs instructions (Commission CDPENAF, Enquête Publique, Réponse avis MRAe,...).

Vous aurez l'occasion de suivre la mise en place concrète de mesures environnementales en phase chantier/construction sur une centrale solaire.

HSE :

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement 
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques

Qualité :

  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité 
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil :

  • Vous préparez un bac + 5 dans une formation d’ingénieur.e en environnement, agriculture, agronomie ou un Master en Ecologie, Biodiversité, Développement Durable
  • Vous utilisez quotidienne le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale.

The Mission 🪐

While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

    • Key Responsibilities ✨

    Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).

  • Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.

  • Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

    • Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

  • Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
  • Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

  • A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
  • Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
  • Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
  • Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
  • C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
  • Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.

    • The Self-Selection Filter ❓

    This role is perfect for you if:

  • You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
  • You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
  • You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

    • This role is NOT for you if:

  • You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
  • You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
  • You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

    • 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
  • Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
  • Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
  • Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance. Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
  • Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo, to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
  • Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - Télétravail horaires décalées (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;
  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;
  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;
  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;
  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;
  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;
  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;
  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;
  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;
  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels
  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;
  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;
  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;
  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 5 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;
  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;
  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;
  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;
  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;
  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;
  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;
  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;
  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;
  • Poste exercé en 100 % télétravail ;
  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;
  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;
  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;
  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

eingeführten, in projo integrierten Support-KI. Im Mittelpunkt steht dabei

unsere Wissensbasis: Du schreibst im Rahmen eines KI-Workflows agentisch

unterstützt Artikel zu den Inhalten und zur Anwendung von projo, hältst sie

Proaktive Betreuung: Initiieren von Folgegesprächen, um die Zufriedenheit

der Kunden sicherzustellen und bei Bedarf Unterstützung anzubieten.

Das bringst du mit

Kommunikation: Du kannst sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich sehr gut auf

Deutsch kommunizieren und bist freundlich sowie geduldig im Umgang mit

Kunden.

Souveränität und Resilienz: Du behältst auch in angespannten oder

und wertschätzend gegenüber den Kunden. Eine hohe Termindichte mit

wechselnden Frage- und Problemstellungen schreckt dich nicht ab .

Problemlösungsfähigkeit: Du bist in der Lage, analytisch zu denken und

Probleme eigenständig zu lösen oder an die zuständige Abteilung

weiterzuleiten.

Technisches Verständnis: Du hast die Fähigkeit, technische

Zusammenhänge einfach und verständlich zu erklären.

Teamgeist und Eigeninitiative: Du arbeitest gern im Team, hast aber auch

Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute

Ein Hintergrund in der Planungs-Branche und idealerweise im Bereich

Controlling.

Erfahrung im Support oder Kundendienst in einem technischen Umfeld.

Allgemeine Software Affinität und Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber neuen

Dein erstes Jahr bei projo

Damit du sicher in deine Rolle hineinwächst, begleiten wir dich mit einem

strukturierten Onboarding. So könnte dein erstes Jahr aussehen:

Nach 1 Monat: Du kennst die Kernfunktionen von projo, unsere

title: System Software/Embedded Engineer (Munich)
descriptionHtml:
System Software / Embedded Engineer (Munich)

About Tensordyne

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours.

Responsibilities

The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers.
  • Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred.
  • Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions.
  • BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always; Being open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each others' differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
descriptionHtml:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Role Overview

As our Talent Acquisition Manager, you’ll be ScorePlay’s only recruiter, with full ownership of how we find, assess and hire the people who fuel our growth. You’ll work directly with the founders and every hiring manager, and you’ll see the impact of each hire on the business.

The bar is high, and you own it. We’d rather keep a seat open than fill it with the wrong person, and we count on you to hold every hiring manager to that standard, from engineers in Europe to sellers in the US.

Most of your week is running searches with a sales mindset: sourcing, screening, closing. The rest is making them work better, with sharper funnel data, better hiring-manager habits and smarter use of AI.

This is a hands-on, high-impact IC role for a strong generalist recruiter with solid sourcing experience in tech environments, who combines execution with data and process rigor. Experience hiring technical profiles is a big plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hiring Execution: Run 4 to 6 searches at a time across tech, product and go-to-market, from role definition and sourcing through screening, interview coordination and closing. This is where most of your time goes.

  • Proactive Sourcing & Pipelines: Go after candidates directly rather than waiting for inbound, and build relationships with strong engineering and commercial profiles before roles open.

  • Funnel Data: Track response rates, conversion by stage, time to fill and offer declines in our ATS, keep the data clean, and use it to show hiring managers where a search is stuck and what to change.

  • Hiring Quality & Manager Accountability: Run and improve our structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs, and hold hiring managers to the standards we agreed on.

  • Recruiting Productivity & AI: Test automation and AI to save time on sourcing, screening prep and candidate communication. Measure time saved and quality kept, not the number of tools deployed.

  • Candidate Experience & Employer Brand: Make every candidate journey sharp and human, from first message to offer, and help leadership and marketing grow ScorePlay’s visibility as an employer.

Key Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in talent acquisition or sourcing, ideally in fast-scaling tech companies. Technical hiring experience is a big plus.

  • Sourcing Expertise: Proven ability to identify and engage niche talent, with a track record of successful outreach and conversions.

  • Data-Driven Recruiting: Comfortable using funnel metrics (conversion, time to fill, offer acceptance) to diagnose issues and influence hiring managers’ decisions.

  • Structured Hiring: Experience running structured interviews and scorecards, and holding hiring managers to agreed standards.

  • Builder Mindset & AI: Curious and hands-on with AI and automation. You try new ways of working and keep what actually makes you faster or better.

  • Collaboration Skills: Strong ability to partner with hiring managers, challenge assumptions, and guide them to sharper decisions.

  • Communication: Fluent English, written and spoken, at a level where you can lead calls and close candidates with ease. French is a plus.

  • Location: Based in Paris or remote from France or UK.

Why ScorePlay?

  • Own the function: you decide how ScorePlay hires, with direct access to the founders and leadership team.

  • Hire internationally: roles across Europe and the US, from engineers to enterprise sellers, for teams spread between Paris and New York.

  • Work on a high bar: quality comes before speed here, and you’re the one who keeps it that way.

  • Room to experiment: try new tools and AI workflows, and keep what actually works.

  • A product people love talking about: sports media, with clients like UEFA, FIBA and the PGA Tour.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und Knapp

Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen, und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in München. Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.
  • Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.
  • Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.
  • Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.
  • Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.
  • Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.
  • Bringe deine Ideen ein: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.

Das bringst du mit 

  • Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen. 
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und basic Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.
  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.
  • Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen. 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now.

The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build.

The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job.

You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel.

What you'll do

Architecture above DATEV

  • Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath.

  • Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck.

  • Make integration a capability, not a project: every client brings their own upstream systems, and today each connection is built by hand. Build the layer those systems plug into, so what makes a client different arrives as context the agents read, never as custom code. One more client must never mean one more integration project.

Reproducibility and control

  • A tax advisor must get the same result twice, and an auditor must be able to trace it. Probabilistic where there is variance, deterministic where there are numbers.

  • Build the control layer so that a certified professional sees within seconds what an agent did (version, source, decision) and can sign off on it.

  • Build evaluation on decades of audited, completed work.

Team and scale

  • Make the architecture calls: design, stack, build or buy for the layer. Nobody has decided it for you, and nobody will overrule it by committee.

  • Hire and lead the engineering team. The budget for your first engineers is approved. You start hiring in your first quarter.

  • Make every acquired firm land on the same base, so technology scales with every acquisition. And stay in the code: you commit and you review.

Questions you'll answer

  • Where exactly does probabilistic end and deterministic begin?

  • How does a system learn from closed cases without losing its reproducibility?

  • A new client arrives with their own systems. What may change in the system, and what may not?

What success looks like

  • 6 months: Architecture decided. One real use case from the core business runs in production and is used daily. Your first engineers are hired.

  • 12 months: Several agentic use cases in regular operation. The control layer holds up in a real review, and evaluation runs against closed cases, not test data.

  • 24 months: Automation is a capability of the organization, not of individuals. Every acquired firm runs on the same base, and your team ships without you in the room.

Where it leads: the full CTO mandate, a management career earned by contribution, not by years served.

What you bring

  • You have built something that ran in production and was used by people who did not build it, as founding engineer, engineering lead, technical co-founder or in a comparable role.

  • You have taken agentic systems into production and know where they break.

  • You have integrated against systems that fight back: legacy ERPs, banking backends, badly documented interfaces.

  • You write production code. AI is your everyday tool, and your position on the stack comes from what you built and threw away.

  • You work in German, because our clients and tax advisors do, and you build in person in Munich.

  • You learn from practitioners, and you set the highest standard in everything you ship, not because someone checks, but because mediocrity bothers you.

A plus, not a requirement

  • A regulated field where mistakes have consequences: fintech, banking tech, payments (N26, Trade Republic, Solaris, Klarna, Mollie, Pleo) or software for professional services (Personio, Workato).

  • Knowledge of accounting, tax or DATEV.

  • No conventional CV required: a technical co-founder of a sold or failed product, or someone who can show publicly what they have built, is explicitly invited. We assess contribution, not labels. The salary range shown refers to the primary profile; a different background starts at a different market price and converges after twelve months of proven performance.

What this role is and what it isn't

  • Building, not managing. You lead engineers and stay in the code. If you want to run managers, this is the wrong role.

  • An operating company, not a software vendor. The users are our own teams. IT operations, tool rollouts and the product work sit with Operations; what we build and in which order is decided together with management. You own how it is built and run.

  • In person in Munich, not a distributed team. An architecture being decided and a team finding its standards need a shared room.

Why join us

  • Turn our data into the edge. Decades of audited, completed work become the test every agent has to pass before a human sees its result.

  • Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build. One decision of yours reaches several thousand clients from day one, and more with every acquisition.

  • Yours to decide. The architecture and the stack of this layer are open. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater.

  • Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your team exists.

The FAQ below is in German, as is our working day.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

title: Technical Support Engineer (L2) - Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Mistral AI is building a new Compute Support team to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our GPU clusters in a Kubernetes environment. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its processes, standards, and culture.

In this hybrid L1/L2 support role, you will be the first point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for compute-related inquiries. You’ll also serve as the escalation point for complex issues, leveraging your deep systems knowledge, Kubernetes expertise, and operational debugging skills to ensure our AI workloads run smoothly at scale.

This is a support-focused role that blends system administration, customer-facing communication, and compute infrastructure expertise. While coding is not the primary focus, familiarity with Go for debugging and automation is a plus.

  

Key Responsibilities

First Customer’s Point of Contact

  • Act as the first interlocutor for customers and internal teams, providing timely and effective responses to compute-related inquiries.

  • Triage and prioritize incoming requests, ensuring SLAs are met for acknowledgment, first response, and resolution.

  • Gather and analyze initial issue details (e.g., logs, error messages, system metrics) to diagnose problems efficiently.

  • Provide clear, actionable guidance to customers and internal users, including temporary workarounds where applicable.

  

Technical Support

  • Serve as the L2 escalation point for Linux, Kubernetes, and compute infrastructure issues, providing deep technical troubleshooting for:

    • GPU/TPU workloads (e.g., CUDA errors, memory leaks, job failures).

    • Kubernetes clusters (e.g., pod crashes, node failures, networking misconfigurations).

    • Bare metal and cloud environments (e.g., AWS EC2, GCP VMs, HPC clusters).

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, hardware failures, and resource contention in distributed systems.

  • Analyze system metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi, Prometheus, Grafana) to identify root causes of issues.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical compute systems

  • Nice to have: Optimize system configurations (e.g., kernel parameters, filesystem tuning, network settings) for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.

  

Kubernetes & Containerization

  • Debug Kubernetes clusters with a focus on:

    • Pod and node issues (e.g., CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes, StorageClasses).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes, node affinity).

  • Troubleshoot container runtime issues (Docker, containerd) such as image pull failures, OCI compliance, or runtime errors.

  • Collaborate with SRE teams to understand and improve existing IaC (Terraform, Ansible) and Go-based tooling.

  

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation for common compute issues (e.g., GPU debugging, Kubernetes troubleshooting).

  • Contribute to post-mortems with actionable follow-ups to prevent recurring incidents.

  • Train internal teams on best practices for compute infrastructure and debugging.

  • Help define and refine support processes as a founding member of the new Compute Support team.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in system administration, technical support, or infrastructure operations, with a strong focus on compute-heavy environments (bare metal, cloud, HPC, or virtualization).

  • Deep Linux/Unix expertise:

    • Debugging kernel-level issues (e.g., OOM killer, I/O bottlenecks, CPU throttling).

    • Performance tuning (e.g., sysctl, ulimit, filesystem optimizations).

    • Networking troubleshooting (e.g., iptables, tcpdump, DNS, NFS, SSH).

    • Storage management (e.g., LVM, RAID, NVMe, GPU-local storage).

  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience is mandatory:

    • Debugging pods, nodes, and clusters (e.g., kubectl describe, kubectl logs, crictl).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes).

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, containerd) and basic IaC awareness Proficiency with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

  • Basic scripting/automation skills (preferably Go, but Bash or Python are acceptable for ad-hoc tasks).

  • Experience with bare metal, virtualization, or HPC environments (e.g., Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast) is a strong plus.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for resolving issues efficiently and improving system reliability.

  • Ability to work in on-call rotations and handle high-pressure situations with a structured, calm approach.

  • Commitment to meeting tight SLAs for issue acknowledgment, triage, and first response.
